Title: Global Data Solutions Delivery Analyst
Description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

General Description Of The Role

In the Technology & Services organization, the Data & Analytics Team enables data-driven decisions by turning data into reliable insights that support business strategy and performance.

The team works with business and technical stakeholders to manage the data lifecycle, deliver analytics solutions, strengthen data governance and literacy, and define value-driven data strategies and use cases.

The team partners with business and technical stakeholders to manage the data lifecycle, deliver analytical solutions, promote data governance and literacy, and support the definition of data strategies and use cases aligned with business priorities.

Within the Data & Analytics team, the Data Solutions Delivery Analyst - Sales & Marketing supports the delivery and evolution of Sales & Marketing data products, reporting solutions and data integrations. The role helps translate business needs into clear requirements, supports delivery activities, monitors data product performance and collaborates with business, technical teams and external partners.

Key Responsibilities And Activities

Data Platform, Modelling and Architecture Support


Support data integration scope definition and documentation for Sales & Marketing sources such as Nielsen, CRMs, external marketing agencies and commercial enterprise systems
Contribute to data modelling by documenting entities, relationships, business definitions and use-case requirements


Data Reporting and Analytics Delivery


Support delivery and enhancement of Sales & Marketing Data Reporting & Analytics solutions, including Power BI, Azure pipelines and Databricks
Gather and validate reporting requirements, KPI definitions and analytical perspectives with business stakeholders
Support testing, issue resolution, status updates and adoption of reporting enhancements


Data Pipeline Operations and Monitoring


Monitor refresh processes, pipeline execution and reporting availability for assigned data products
Support investigation of data quality, refresh and reporting issues, coordinating with technical teams as needed


Data Product Delivery and Business Alignment


Support backlog, priorities and delivery activities for Sales & Marketing data products
Translate business needs into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional documentation


Data Engineering, AI Enablement and Stakeholder Coordination


Assist in onboarding new data sources and documenting data flows, ingestion needs and processing logic
Support reuse of semantic models and curated datasets for advanced analytics and AI-enabled use cases
Coordinate working sessions, documentation, action logs and follow-ups with IT, business teams and partners


Required Skills And Experience

Experience & Background


3-5 years of experience in Data Analytics, BI delivery, CRM analytics, commercial reporting or data product support
Experience with Sales & Marketing, CRM, customer or commercial analytics use cases, preferably in a global environment
Hands-on experience with requirements gathering, tech documentation drafting, testing, issue tracking and stakeholder coordination


Business Skills


Good understanding of Sales & Marketing processes, CRM data, commercial KPIs and analytics-driven decisions
Ability to translate business needs into structured data, reporting and analytics requirements
Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail and clear communication with business and technical stakeholder


Technical Skills And Awareness


Working knowledge of BI and analytics tools, preferably Azure, Power BI and Databricks
Understanding of data pipelines, ingestion, data modelling and data quality controls
Ability to collaborate with data engineers, architects, BI developers and external delivery partners


Key competencies


Analytical mindset and ability to connect data outputs to business questions
Strong attention to detail, accuracy and documentation discipline
Structured problem-solving and ability to investigate issues methodically
Good stakeholder management and coordination skills in cross-functional environments
Ability to communicate data and analytics topics clearly to both technical and non technical audiences
Pragmatic execution focus and ability to follow up on actions, risks and dependencies
Team-oriented attitude and ability to work effectively with business, IT and external partners
Integrity and respect for data confidentiality
Fluent in English


The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within 38K-50K + 10% STI, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall profile.

The role is classified in accordance with the collective labor agreement – level 1

The position might also include a variable compensation component and a benefits package in line with applicable company policies.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.

Note to applicants:

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Notice to third party agencies:

Please refrain from cold-calling or emailing our executive leadership team or the HR community directly. The Talent Acquisition department manages centralized recruiting operations globally, including the selection and management of external suppliers. Currently, our preferred supplier list is at full capacity. To ensure we have your information on file for future consideration, we kindly request that you complete the online form provided here.

Title: Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist - Zona Milano
Description:
Cerchiamo un Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist

L’Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist è responsabile del supporto al miglioramento delle prestazioni energetiche attraverso analisi dei dati, sistemi di controllo per la building automation e gestione della connettività IoT, con un focus specifico sull’integrazione e gestione delle macchine e degli impianti nella piattaforma IoT Abound.

Il ruolo assicura la disponibilità, la qualità e l’utilizzabilità dei dati operativi ed energetici provenienti da sistemi HVAC, Plant Control, BMS e sistemi di misura, abilitando attività di energy analytics, energy audit, monitoraggio delle performance e servizi di ottimizzazione data-driven.

La posizione opera in stretta collaborazione con i team Controls, Service, Engineering e Sales per fornire soluzioni energetiche affidabili, scalabili e digitalmente abilitate.

Analisi Dati Energetici & Monitoraggio delle Performance


Analizzare dati energetici e operativi provenienti da BMS, sistemi di Plant Control, dispositivi di misura e piattaforme digitali.
Sviluppare e monitorare KPI energetici, trend, baseline e benchmark.
Individuare inefficienze, anomalie e opportunità di ottimizzazione tramite analisi data-driven.
Supportare la validazione e il monitoraggio dei miglioramenti delle prestazioni energetiche nel tempo.


Controlli & Ottimizzazione dei Sistemi


Supportare la definizione e la validazione di strategie di controllo orientate all’efficienza energetica e all’affidabilità degli impianti (HVAC, chiller plant, sistemi integrati).
Contribuire alle attività di commissioning, retro-commissioning e ottimizzazione funzionale.
Verificare l’allineamento tra logiche di controllo, comportamento reale dell’impianto e performance misurate.


Connettività IoT & Gestione Piattaforma Abound


Gestire l’onboarding di macchine e impianti sulla piattaforma IoT Abound.
Supportare la configurazione dell’architettura di connettività (gateway, protocolli di comunicazione, punti dati e mappatura segnali).
Verificare continuità, accuratezza e qualità della trasmissione dati dai sistemi di campo verso Abound.
Supportare la diagnosi e la risoluzione di problematiche di connettività, perdita dati o incoerenze informative, coordinandosi con team Controls, Technical Support e Field Service.
Assicurare che i dati acquisiti siano pronti per analisi, dashboard, energy audit e servizi digitali.


Energy Audit & Supporto Tecnico


Supportare l’esecuzione di energy audit con particolare attenzione all’analisi dati e alla valutazione dei sistemi di controllo.
Contribuire all’identificazione e quantificazione delle Energy Conservation Measures (ECM).
Supportare la preparazione di report tecnici, documentazione e sintesi delle performance.


Strumenti Digitali, Standard & Collaborazione


Contribuire alla definizione di data model, standard di connessione e best practice per progetti digitali e IoT.
Supportare la valutazione della digital readiness degli impianti e la definizione di roadmap di digitalizzazione per sistemi inizialmente non connessi.
Collaborare con i team Sales e Service nelle fasi di pre-sales e delivery di soluzioni data-driven e digitali.
Promuovere la condivisione della conoscenza e il miglioramento continuo all’interno del team.


Formazione e certificazioni


Diploma tecnico (preferibilmente elettronico, elettrotecnico o termotecnico).
Laurea in Ingegneria (Energetica, Meccanica, Elettrica, Automazione o equivalente).
Esperienza in ambito building automation, controlli HVAC, energy management o analisi dati energetici.
Conoscenza di sistemi HVAC e centrali energetiche, architetture BMS/BAS/DDC, analisi dati energetici e monitoraggio delle performance.


Esperienza e competenze richieste


Esperienza in attività di energy audit e valutazioni di efficienza energetica.
Familiarità con architetture IoT applicate alla Building Automation.
Esperienza o esposizione a piattaforme digitali per energy monitoring e analytics.
Conoscenza di standard e linee guida energetiche (es. ASHRAE, ISO 50001 – preferenziale).
Spiccate capacità analitiche e di problem solving.Approccio data-driven e orientato ai risultati.Metodo di lavoro strutturato e attenzione al dettaglio.Attitudine al lavoro trasversale in team multidisciplinari.Orientamento all’innovazione digitale e al miglioramento continuo.Familiarità con strumenti digitali (reporting, piattaforme di gestione interventi, CRM o ERP.


Requisiti logistici


Residenza preferibilmente in Lombardia.
Patente B in corso di validità.
Disponibilità a trasferte su territorio nazionale.

Title: Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist
Description:
Job Title

Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist

Descrizione del ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist da inserire nel team di Asset Services-Client Finance con l’obiettivo di supportare il business nelle decisioni strategiche ed evolvere i processi di reporting.

La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nel trasformare le informazioni disponibili in strumenti chiari, accessibili e orientati all’azione, favorendo una lettura integrata delle performance e migliorando la qualità e la tempestività dei processi decisionali e l’uniformità del dato.

Sarà inserito/a e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di business e con le funzioni tecniche, agendo come punto di collegamento per tradurre le esigenze operative in soluzioni strutturate di reporting e monitoraggio, con un focus sul settore Real Estate.

Principali responsabilità


Supportare il monitoraggio economico-finanziario e la gestione di OPEX/CAPEX, contribuendo a migliorare visibilità e controllo delle performance.
Collaborare con i team di business per comprendere bisogni informativi e priorità decisionali, traducendoli in strumenti di reporting efficaci.
Evolvere la reportistica esistente verso modelli più dinamici, intuitivi e orientati al business, facilitandone l’utilizzo da parte degli stakeholder attraverso applicativi quali Power BI.
Contribuire alla definizione di indicatori chiave e modelli di analisi per il monitoraggio delle performance degli asset (es. turnover, footfall, redditività, costi).
Favorire una maggiore integrazione e coerenza delle fonti informative a supporto delle analisi.
Supportare la diffusione e l’adozione degli strumenti di reporting all’interno dell’organizzazione (es. Client Portal e Dashboard condivise).
Garantire l’evoluzione continua degli strumenti di reporting in funzione delle esigenze del business.


Requisiti


Esperienza in ambito reporting e analisi, performance management o supporto alle decisioni.
Capacità di comprendere esigenze di business e tradurle in soluzioni analitiche e di reporting.
Ottima conoscenza delle principali applicazioni MS Office (Excel in particolare, Word, PPT etc) incluso SharePoint.
Solida esperienza in Power BI (in particolare Power Query / ETL, DAX e data modeling) o altri strumenti di BI (ad esempio Tableau).
È preferenziale maturata esperienza con Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL e nella gestione di database relazionali.
Esperienza nella gestione e integrazione di informazioni provenienti da fonti diverse.
Conoscenza del settore Real Estate (property/asset management, advisory o contesti affini).
Familiarità con logiche di budgeting e monitoraggio economico (OPEX/CAPEX).
Forte orientamento al business, capacità analitica e attenzione al dettaglio.
Ottime capacità relazionali e di collaborazione con stakeholder diversi (business e tecnici).
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Compensation and Transparency

We believe in an open and transparent approach to compensation. For this role, the base salary range is between €38,250 and €45,000 gross per annum (RAL). Positioning within the range will depend on experience, skills, and the expected impact in the role. Candidates at an early stage in their career are typically positioned towards the lower end of the range, while candidates with significant experience and the ability to deliver immediate impact may be positioned towards the upper end. We also offer a comprehensive compensation package which, in addition to benefits, may include discretionary performance-based bonuses in line with company policies. Our compensation decisions are based on clear, objective criteria, aligned with market benchmarks and internal equity.

Sarà inserito/a e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di business e con le funzioni tecniche, agendo come punto di collegamento per tradurre le esigenze operative in soluzioni strutturate di reporting e monitoraggio, con un focus sul settore Real Estate.

Principali responsabilità

  • Supportare il monitoraggio economico-finanziario e la gestione di OPEX/CAPEX, contribuendo a migliorare visibilità e controllo delle performance.
  • Collaborare con i team di business per comprendere bisogni informativi e priorità decisionali, traducendoli in strumenti di reporting efficaci.
  • Evolvere la reportistica esistente verso modelli più dinamici, intuitivi e orientati al business, facilitandone l’utilizzo da parte degli stakeholder attraverso applicativi quali Power BI.
  • Contribuire alla definizione di indicatori chiave e modelli di analisi per il monitoraggio delle performance degli asset (es. turnover, footfall, redditività, costi).
  • Favorire una maggiore integrazione e coerenza delle fonti informative a supporto delle analisi.
  • Supportare la diffusione e l’adozione degli strumenti di reporting all’interno dell’organizzazione (es. Client Portal e Dashboard condivise).
  • Garantire l’evoluzione continua degli strumenti di reporting in funzione delle esigenze del business.

Requisiti

  • Esperienza in ambito reporting e analisi, performance management o supporto alle decisioni.
  • Capacità di comprendere esigenze di business e tradurle in soluzioni analitiche e di reporting.
  • Ottima conoscenza delle principali applicazioni MS Office (Excel in particolare, Word, PPT etc) incluso SharePoint.
  • Solida esperienza in Power BI (in particolare Power Query / ETL, DAX e data modeling) o altri strumenti di BI (ad esempio Tableau).
  • È preferenziale maturata esperienza con Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL e nella gestione di database relazionali.
  • Esperienza nella gestione e integrazione di informazioni provenienti da fonti diverse.
  • Conoscenza del settore Real Estate (property/asset management, advisory o contesti affini).
  • Familiarità con logiche di budgeting e monitoraggio economico (OPEX/CAPEX).
  • Forte orientamento al business, capacità analitica e attenzione al dettaglio.
  • Ottime capacità relazionali e di collaborazione con stakeholder diversi (business e tecnici).
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

Compensation and Transparency

We believe in an open and transparent approach to compensation. For this role, the base salary range is between €38,250 and €45,000 gross per annum (RAL). Positioning within the range will depend on experience, skills, and the expected impact in the role. Candidates at an early stage in their career are typically positioned towards the lower end of the range, while candidates with significant experience and the ability to deliver immediate impact may be positioned towards the upper end. Build and maintain structured, auditable business and financial models to support benefits and value quantification.
Define KPIs, baselines, targets, and monetization parameters in collaboration with Portfolio, Finance, and Business Owners.
Develop Benefits Realization frameworks covering baseline definition, target setting, tracking, and realized value analysis.

Design and maintain Power BI dashboards for executive-level reporting and decision-making.

At least 5 years of experience in business modelling, benefits realization, value quantification, or financial analysis.
Knowledge of Excel, Power BI, forecasting, scenario modelling, variance analysis, KPI definition, baseline setting, and value attribution methodologies.
Italian and English fluent.
Strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work with Portfolio, Finance, Business, and project teams in a dynamic environment.

Nice to have:

Previous experience in portfolio management, executive reporting, or large-scale transformation initiatives would be a plus.

An international community bringing together 110+ different nationalities.
An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities.
A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250+ available modules.
A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events, including afterworks and team buildings.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙

At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.

We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.

Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.

We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Data Analyst out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄

Our Data Analyst projects usually include:


Collecting, cleaning, and transforming data from various sources to ensure quality and usability
Writing and optimizing SQL queries and/or using Python to analyze and process data
Building and maintaining dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI) to support business decision-making
Translating business needs into data requirements and actionable insights
Performing exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
Collaborating with data engineers and other teams to ensure data availability and reliability
Contributing to the improvement of data models, datasets, and reporting processes
Ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and documentation of your work
Supporting stakeholders by explaining insights in a clear and structured way
But being a consulting company, we can’t know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be🤷‍♀️



You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:

Background:


Masters degree related to computer science, data or AI or business engineering.
1-4 years of experience as a data analyst, BI engineer or a related role.
Previous experience building or maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes is considered a plus.
Exposure to working with large datasets from multiple sources (e.g., CRM, web analytics, call logs, transactional systems).



Technical Skills:


Solid hands-on experience with Python, and SQL.
Experience with dashboarding & visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Databricks is a plus.
Experience with a cloud is a plus: Azure, AWS or GCP.
Experience with SAS is a plus for the finance industry.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and best practices.
Basic understanding of version control (e.g., Git) and automated workflows/scheduling.



Soft Skills:


Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Good communication skills and attention to detail.
Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-moving environment.



Languages: Fluent in English and French and/or Dutch

We know that finding the right job isn't just about the role, it's about what's in it for you, too. While we're a start-up, we're big on taking care of our people right from day one.

Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:

💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated


Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time



🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive


Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕



✨ And most importantly, an organic-growing company where you are in control of your own path!

Our Recruitment Process:

📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

💜Culture check: HR Interview (30')

🛠️Technical check: Wizard assessment (25') & Technical Interview with our wizards (1h)

🤝Partner Meet-up (30')

Why this process?

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.

➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.

➡️Please note: As a consulting company, our recruitment process can be either project-driven or based on strong profiles we believe in. The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we'll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions, and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst

Every IT decision worth making starts with the right data behind it, someone who can turn raw numbers from systems, applications and infrastructure into insights that actually change how the business operates.




At Darwind, we don't fit consultants into projects, we look for the project that fits you. You'll join a community of Darwinders who value autonomy, ownership, and genuine professional growth, and who believe the best work experience should always be the next one.




What you will do

As Data Analyst, you'll turn data from IT systems and business applications into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across the organisation. Concretely, you will:

Collect, clean and structure data from IT systems, applications and databases
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik
Analyse IT service usage, system performance and cost data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
Write and optimise SQL queries to extract and combine data from multiple sources
Translate business questions into data driven answers for IT and business stakeholders
Support the development of ETL processes and data pipelines together with data engineering colleagues
Validate data quality and flag inconsistencies before they reach decision makers
Present findings and recommendations in a clear, actionable way to both technical and non technical audiences
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting standards and data governance practices

Who you are

We look beyond the CV. For us, motivation and curiosity matter just as much as the technical box-ticking, but to thrive in this role, you'll likely recognise yourself in most of the following:

You hold a master's degree in data science, IT, statistics, business engineering or a related field
You have at least 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst in an IT environment
You are proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large, complex data sets
You have hands on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik
Knowledge of Python or R is a plus
You have an eye for detail and a structured, analytical mindset
You can explain technical findings in a way that makes sense to non technical stakeholders
You are fluent in Dutch, French is a plus




What we offer

Competitive benefits package

Hospitalization insurance
Group insurance
Meal allowance
Your choice between a company car with EU fuel card or the federal mobility budget

Learning and growth

Continuous coaching
Technical and soft-skills training
Room to grow across different domains and technologies

Culture

A human, transparent and collaborative environment
Real ownership and influence on the projects you contribute to
A team that lives its values, initiative, authenticity and open communication, every day

Ready for your next step?

If the traditional consultancy model never quite resonated with you, and you're looking for a place where people, impact and growth genuinely matter, let's talk.

Title: Data Analyst Confirmé (H/F)
Description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une entreprise qui place l’humain au cœur de ses préoccupations ? On vous attend chez Extia !

Société de conseil spécialisée dans les métiers de l’IT et du digital, Extia privilégie depuis sa création en 2007 une approche qui allie performance et bien-être au travail. Une vision de l’entreprise partagée aujourd’hui par plus de 2 500 Extiens en France et à l'international et récompensée par le label Great Place to Work® depuis 15 ans dont 10 ans sur le podium et 3 années consécutives à la première place du palmarès !

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et nous offrons à chaque candidat la possibilité de révéler son potentiel, sans distinction et de quelque nature qu'elle soit. Chez Extia, c’est « D’abord qui, ensuite quoi » alors, allons-y !


Créatif, vous avez toujours une solution inédite mais adéquate à proposer
Curieux, poser des questions est votre seconde nature
Analytique, vous avez une âme d’enquêteur et les énigmes n’ont aucun secret pour vous


Description Du Poste

Vous serez intégré(e) dans une équipe de consultants innovants et motivés, composée de Business Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers spécialisés sur les problématiques Data Analytics. À ce titre, vous interviendrez de façon opérationnelle sur des missions de conseil autour des sujets de transformation Data Analytics, de retraitement et modélisation de données et de représentation visuelle de la donnée pour adresser des problématiques métiers.

Vous serez notamment en charge de :


Comprendre les problématiques métier,
Collecter et traiter les données en vue de l'analyse, incluant notamment la création de variables agrégées et complémentaires aux données brutes,
Automatiser et d’industrialiser les retraitements effectués sur les données,
Représenter les résultats dans un outil de restitution visuelle de façon ergonomique et intuitive,
Restituer les analyses au client notamment pas la création d’indicateurs pertinents pour les questions stratégiques des entreprises


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieurs ou équivalent (Bac +5), vous justifiez d’a minima 2 ans d’expérience réussis en tant que data analyst :


Vous possédez une bonne connaissance des outils et méthodologies de Data Analytics, incluant notamment des bases techniques (modèles de données, langage SQL, …) mais également méthodologiques,
Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie d'Excel et maitrisez les langages statistiques tels que R, Python ou SAS,
Une connaissance d'un logiciel ou langage dédié à la Data Visualization (Tableau, Qliksense ou Qlickview, Microsoft Power BI…) ainsi que des compétences en automatisation (VBA par exemple) seraient un plus.


PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT


Échangez avec un ou une chargée de recrutement pour un premier contact téléphonique
Rencontrez un ou une Ingénieure d’Affaires (Business Manager) sur vos souhaits d’évolution
Approfondissez avec nos responsables et directeurs d’agence pour connaître la vision de l'agence


Selon votre profil, des tests ou entretiens techniques pourront vous être demandés. Tout au long du processus, vous pourrez échanger avec nos consultants pour en savoir + sur leur quotidien chez nous !

PACKAGE SALARIAL

Chez Extia Belgique IT, la transparence fait partie intégrante de l'expérience positive, voici un aperçu des éléments de package salarial dont peuvent profiter nos collaborateurs, sous réserve d'éligibilité

👛 Voiture de société ou budget mobilité ✨ Chèques repas & Ecocheque 🎁 Assurance groupe 🎉 Frais de représentation 📈 Plan cafétéria / Flex Income Plan 🚀 Primes d'apport d'affaire, de cooptation et de formation 🌍 20 jours de congés légaux + 12 jours de récupération

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are




Phinest is a Belgian Management Consulting firm providing tailor-made services for Bel20 and Bel20-like companies.

We help these leading companies deliver their key strategic projects across various sectors (Utilities, Pharmaceutical, Banking & Insurance, Retail, Transport, Public, Telecom).

We combine a human-sized organisation with large-scale impact. You are not just a consultant: you grow with us while making an impact for our clients.

At Phinest, you’ll find the right balance between professional growth, meaningful projects, and a collaborative environment.




Position: Data Analyst




Responsibilities:

Collect, clean and analyze data from multiple sources to support business decision-making.
Develop dashboards, reports and KPIs to monitor business performance.
Identify trends, patterns and insights to support strategic initiatives.
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into actionable analyses.
Ensure data quality, consistency and accuracy across reporting processes.
Contribute to data-driven transformation projects and continuous process improvement.




Skills and Qualifications:

Master Degree.
3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Excel, SQL and BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Knowledge of data modelling and data visualization best practices.
Experience working with large datasets.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent in French and English; Dutch is an asset.

Our focus is to develop a long-term collaboration with our talented consultants. Therefore we invest in our people as of day one to support them into a blossoming career within Phinest.

Our Talent Management Services department (a.k.a TMS) is fully dedicated to the development and well-being of our employees.




We also offer:

A company culture focused on well-being.
Continuous learning and career development opportunities.
A collaborative and dynamic working environment.
The opportunity to work with a fast-growing firm and talented people.
A competitive remuneration package with fringe benefits.
Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site.




Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Regio Gent | Data Analyst | Power BI | Bouwsector | 1114100




Over de organisatie




Hays is voor een toonaangevende en groeiende groep binnen de bouwsector op zoek naar een Data Analyst. De organisatie zet sterk in op digitalisering, datagedreven werken en verdere groei via zowel autonome uitbreiding als overnames.




Vanuit een centraal digitaal team ondersteun je diverse bedrijven binnen de groep. Je maakt deel uit van een team van acht specialisten, waaronder collega's binnen IT, business applications, PIM, BI en data.




Door de verdere uitbouw van het dataplatform en de toenemende vraag naar betrouwbare managementinformatie gaat het bedrijf op zoek naar een extra BI-professional die business en technologie met elkaar weet te verbinden.




Jouw nieuwe functie




Als Data Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van businessvragen naar schaalbare data- en rapporteringsoplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met managers en stakeholders uit verschillende afdelingen zoals sales, supply chain en operations.




Jouw takenpakket bestaat onder andere uit:




Analyseren van businessprocessen, KPI’s en rapporteringsbehoeften
Vertalen van noden naar duurzame data- en BI-oplossingen
Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapporten in Power BI
Modelleren en integreren van data uit onder andere ERP-, CRM- en andere bedrijfsapplicaties
Bewaken van datakwaliteit, definities en performantie van rapporteringen
Samenwerken met business, IT-collega’s en externe partners
Ondersteunen van projecten rond digitalisering, harmonisatie en integratie van data
Meedenken over nieuwe technologieën zoals AI




In deze rol ben je regelmatig aanwezig bij interne stakeholders om behoeften te begrijpen en om te zetten naar bruikbare inzichten. Je combineert dus een sterke analytische aanpak met een communicatieve en klantgerichte mindset.




Jouw profiel




Voor deze functie zoeken we een BI-professional die zich vlot beweegt tussen business en technologie.




Je beschikt over:

Een bachelor- of masterdiploma
Minstens 2 jaar relevante ervaring binnen BI, data of analytics
Sterke kennis van Power BI en DAX
Goede kennis van SQL
Ervaring met het uitwerken van end-to-end BI-oplossingen
Een analytische en probleemoplossende ingesteldheid
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een professionele uitstraling




Daarnaast heb je interesse in innovatie en nieuwe technologieën. Kennis van datamodellering, ETL-processen, Azure DevOps, Copilot of Power Automate is een pluspunt.




Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en kan je professioneel behelpen in het Frans. Je bent bereid om af en toe verschillende vestigingen te bezoeken.




De arbeidsvoorwaarden




Je krijgt de kans om een zichtbare rol op te nemen binnen een ambitieuze en groeiende organisatie waar data een steeds belangrijkere plaats inneemt.




Je mag rekenen op:




Een vast contract
Een bruto maandsalaris afhankelijk van ervaring
Bedrijfswagen
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Groepsverzekering
Ecocheques
GSM en abonnement
40-urenweek met 12 ADV-dagen
Glijdende werkuren
Een functie met veel autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid
Nauwe samenwerking met beslissingsnemers binnen de organisatie
Impactvolle projecten rond BI, rapportering, digitalisering en innovatie

Title: Data Analist
Description:
Hallo toekomstige collega, je bent van harte welkom bij Comfort Energy Group!

Bij Comfort Energy Group geloven we dat goede data leiden tot betere beslissingen. Als Data Analist vertaal jij data naar heldere inzichten, betrouwbare rapporten en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards. Daarmee help je collega’s in Finance, Sales, Operations en HR om sneller en slimmer te werken.

Jouw analyses ondersteunen zowel dagelijkse operationele beslissingen als de strategische keuzes van het management. Zo draag je rechtstreeks bij aan een efficiëntere organisatie én een betere dienstverlening aan onze klanten.

Zo krijg jij energie


Rapporten bouwen die écht gebruikt worden: Je ontwikkelt heldere en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards in Power BI voor verschillende teams binnen onze organisatie. Van het opvolgen van openstaande brandstofleveringen en operationele KPI’s tot de maandelijkse managementrapportering: jij zorgt ervoor dat de juiste informatie op het juiste moment beschikbaar is.
Sterke datamodellen ontwerpen: Je gaat verder dan mooie visuals. Je bouwt doordachte semantische modellen in Power BI, met sterschema's, correcte relaties en de juiste granulariteit. Je schrijft DAX-measures die betrouwbaar werken in elke filtercontext en werkt met onder andere row-level security. Een goed model is voor jou geen technische luxe maar de basis voor betrouwbare en performante rapportering.
Meegroeien met ons datawarehouse: Achter onze rapporten zit een dbt-datawarehouse op Azure SQL Server. In het begin ben je vooral gebruiker van dit warehouse. Naarmate je groeit in de rol, krijg je alle ruimte om ook zelf mee te bouwen en je kennis verder uit te breiden.
Waken over datakwaliteit: Je neemt datakwaliteit serieus. Je documenteert definities, controleert en test je cijfers voordat rapporten bij eindgebruikers terechtkomen en zorgt ervoor dat je oplossingen duidelijk en overdraagbaar zijn.

Title: Corporate Data Analist
Description:
Onze klant, een toonaangevende en mensgerichte organisatie gespecialiseerd in dienstverlening voor ondernemers, zoekt een Corporate Data Analist om complexe data te vertalen naar strategische groei. In deze rol combineer je technische expertise met business-inzicht om de digitale maturiteit en operationele efficiëntie van de organisatie direct te beïnvloeden.

Responsibilities

Je werkt nauw samen met corporate diensten, data engineers en data architects om de vertaalslag te maken van ruwe data naar waardevolle sturingsinformatie. Je rapporteert over de voortgang van de analytics roadmap en adviseert stakeholders op basis van jouw bevindingen.


In kaart brengen van businessbehoeften en deze vertalen naar relevante analyses, dashboards en datagedreven inzichten ter ondersteuning van strategische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelen, testen en optimaliseren van dataproducten die trends, opportuniteiten en risico’s visualiseren voor het management.
Beheren van de prioriteiten binnen de analytics roadmap, rekening houdend met budgetten, GDPR, security en technische haalbaarheid.
Bewaken van de datakwaliteit en consistentie door het toepassen van standaarden en kwaliteitscontroles.
Omzetten van data-inzichten naar concrete beleidsaanbevelingen voor de verdere uitbouw van de organisatie.
Opvolgen van innovaties binnen data en analytics om processen en besluitvorming continu te professionaliseren.


Requirements


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een analytische richting of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met het modelleren van datasets en het bouwen van rapportages in Power BI.
Je beschikt over een diepgaande kennis van DAX om complexe logica te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
Je hebt ervaring in het samenwerken met diverse stakeholders en kunt vlot schakelen tussen business-noden en technische IT-oplossingen.
Je bent in staat om complexe materie begrijpelijk over te brengen aan verschillende doelgroepen.
Je bent kritisch, nieuwsgierig en proactief ingesteld om verbeterpotentieel binnen de organisatie te detecteren.
Je beschikt over uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden om diverse projecten en deadlines efficiënt te beheren.
Je bent communicatief vaardig en vloeiend in het Nederlands.
Affiniteit met data-architectuur en databeveiliging is een pluspunt.


Offer


Contract: vast contract van onbepaalde duur.
Extra-legale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met laadpas en laadinstallatie, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, cadeaucheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, pensioenfonds, loonbonus en een flexibel verloningssysteem (o.a. fietsleasing).
Arbeidsregime: voltijds (38u) met een glijdend uurrooster.
Werkmodel: hybride (telewerk mogelijk na de inwerkperiode).
Vakantie: 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.
Opleiding: uitgebreid aanbod aan e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen voor persoonlijke groei.
Atmosfeer: een professionele werkomgeving met een sterke focus op welzijn en een informele compagnon-cultuur.

Title: [NL] Senior Data Analyst (M/V/X) - Brussel
Description:
Profiel

Wie ben jij?

Je behaalde een masterdiploma of je kan een gelijkwaardig niveau aantonen door relevante ervaring.
Het opbouwen en optimaliseren van datasets, views en pipelines in SQL kent geen geheimen voor jou.
Je bent vertrouwd met het ontwerpen en implementeren van robuuste data-modellen volgens de Kimball-methodologie.
Je bent een expert in het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van Power BI-dashboards en rapportages.
Je hebt reeds een aantoonbare ervaring in het coördineren van data-projecten en bewaken van planning, kwaliteit en oplevering.
Je beschikt over een basiskennis van data governance, met oog voor datakwaliteit en standaarden.
Je kan toezien op de correcte toepassing van data security, inclusief GDPR-richtlijnen in cloud-omgevingen.
Je kan ondersteuning bieden bij het correct gebruik van moderne data-tools zoals dbt, Git en Databricks.
Je kan autonoom efficiënt werken maar hebt tevens oog voor het werken in teamverband.
Je communiceert vlot, weet ideeën uit te wisselen en hebt oog voor overleg.
Je bent verantwoordelijk, flexibel en je hebt zin voor initiatief in een dynamische werkomgeving.
Je beheerst het Nederlands uitstekend, zowel gesproken als geschreven. Daarnaast heb je een passieve kennis van het Frans en een goede kennis van het Engels.




Functie

Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit?




Als Senior Data Analyst maak je deel uit van het data-team dat verantwoordelijk is voor de implementatie van het gemeenschappelijk dataplatform.




Je definieert de conceptuele datamodellen op basis van de businessvereisten, en samen met de andere collega’s binnen het team (analisten, data engineers, BI developers) zorg je ervoor dat deze data-oplossingen afgestemd zijn op de noden van de organisatie.




Als brug tussen het data-team en de business stakeholders verzamel en analyseer je de noden, vertaal je de business requirements naar technische specificaties en draag je actief bij aan een vlotte communicatie en afstemming binnen een transversale organisatie.




Je speelt een actieve rol in het exploreren van data om diepgaande analyses, dashboards en decision-ready insights te produceren. De bruikbaarheid van dashboards evalueer je samen met data-consumers. Door iteratief te werken aan visualisaties en story-telling zorg je ervoor dat de informatie niet alleen correct, maar ook helder en toegankelijk gepresenteerd wordt.




Dankzij jouw analytische aanpak worden complexe datasets omgezet in waardevolle informatie voor de organisatie.




Binnen deze functie ben jij ook de drijvende kracht achter het Centre of Excellence Power BI. Als centraal aanspreekpunt voor de Power BI user community speel je een sleutelrol in het versterken van data literacy en het gebruik van BI-oplossingen binnen de organisatie.




Je werkt actief aan de zichtbaarheid en herkenbaarheid van onze informatie-oplossingen (via newsletters, intranet,...), zodat deze optimaal aansluiten bij de noden van de organisatie.

Je werkt op een pragmatische en Agile manier.




Je taken:

Je werkt mee aan het definiëren en berekenen van KPI’s op basis van governed semantic layers en gestandaardiseerde methodologieën.
Je voert ad-hoc analyses uit, onderzoekt root causes van problemen en valideert hypotheses om businessvragen snel en accuraat te beantwoorden.
Je respecteert de processen rond masterdata management en referentiegegevens.
Je organiseert hands-on workshops voor de eindgebruikers, biedt opleidingen en praktische tips & tricks aan, en stimuleert kennisdeling rond best practices.
Je bouwt de Self Service environment verder uit.
Je zorgt ervoor dat de voorgestelde data-architectuur voldoet aan de vereisten inzake databeveiliging, privacybescherming.




Voordelen

Zin om als Smals-gedetacheerde bij de RVA te werken?

Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid.
We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,…
IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur of hypothecaire lening.
Via ons 'Benefits at Work'-platform geniet je van mooie kortingen op mode, elektronica, daguitstappen, vakantieverblijven, …
We voeren een gelijkekansenbeleid en vinden o.a. equal pay belangrijk.




De organisatie

Over de RVA




De RVA is een organisatie met aanzienlijke en voortdurend evoluerende IT-behoeften, vooral in een tijd waarin technologie razendsnel verandert. Onze ICT-afdeling speelt daarin een cruciale rol en biedt een hoogwaardige service via wendbare en oplossingsgerichte werkwijzen.




Als professionele partner van de RVA biedt Smals haar inhouse ICT-diensten aan ter ondersteuning van onze missie. Zo kunnen we binnen de RVA rekenen op meer dan 300 ICT-medewerkers, verspreid over drie verschillende teams.




Als gedetacheerd Smals-medewerker ga jij als expert aan de slag binnen één van deze teams. Zo combineer je het aantrekkelijke aanbod aan voordelen van onze ICT-partner met de burgerzin en maatschappelijke impact van onze socialezekerheidsinstelling.

Title: Data Analyst - European Agency
Description:
🔹Role🔹

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to analyse, transform, and visualise complex datasets while contributing to enterprise data platforms and Business Intelligence solutions within an international environment.

🔹Who We Are🔹

Altia is a high-value digital transformation services company that has undertaken, changed, and reformulated international projects for nearly a thousand clients, leaders in their sectors, who have understood that their businesses can be revolutionized through digitalization. Over its 30 years of experience, it has proven to be a robust company with a future, a capacity for innovation, and adaptability.

🔹The project🔹

You will contribute to data analysis, data modelling, Business Intelligence, and data integration activities within an international project supporting a prestigious European agency, ensuring the quality, consistency, accessibility, and effective visualisation of enterprise data.

Data Analysis & Processing: Analyse, transform, and manipulate complex datasets using modern data analysis and programming techniques, supporting business and operational requirements.

Data Warehousing & Modelling: Contribute to the design and development of Data Warehouse environments and apply structured data modelling approaches to support reliable and scalable analytical solutions.

Business Intelligence & Visualisation: Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualisations that transform complex information into clear and actionable insights for different stakeholders.

ETL & Data Integration: Design and maintain data transformation processes, pipelines, and workflows using modern integration and orchestration technologies.

Data Quality & Reporting: Contribute to data quality, validation, reporting, and optimisation activities, ensuring the reliability and consistency of information across enterprise data environments.

Description:
À propos de nous

Nous sommes le premier industriel de la donnée en Europe. Notre métier est de créer, manager et exploiter le patrimoine data de nos clients.

Nous avons la conviction que chaque entreprise peut adopter une démarche innovante de gestion de la donnée et créer des cas d’usage disruptifs en réduisant l'impact écologique et en diminuant la dette technique.

Nous comptons plus de 900 collaborateurs en mission chez nos clients grands comptes dans tout secteur d’activité : banque, assurance, santé, énergie, e-commerce, automobile, luxe, retail, transport, agritech…

Avantages à travailler chez JEMS


Une JEMS Académie au service de votre montée en compétences (formations et certifications sur les technologies de pointe)
Un accompagnement personnalisé et un management de proximité pour vous proposer des évolutions de carrière
Une intégration dans des communautés techniques et de pratiques JEMS (encadrement par des experts, échanges sur les bonnes pratiques, favoriser l'innovation...)
Une entreprise reconnue "Great Place To Work"
Des évènements et séminaires inoubliables, des soirées d'agence conviviales


Mobilité

Une mobilité nationale et internationale pour vous accompagner dans vos projets de vie.

Diversité

Le Groupe JEMS porte fièrement sa valeur "Diversité" en se mobilisant pour l'inclusion et l'égalité des chances et en luttant contre toutes formes de discrimination.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Mission

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst expert(e) MIG6 capable d'accompagner les directions métiers et opérationnelles de l'énergie dans l'exploitation, la modélisation et la valorisation de leurs données pour l'aide à la décision.

Vous Aurez La Charge De


Guider et recommander le Métier dans l’exploitation des données issues des processus du marché de l'énergie (MIG6, comptage, consommation, données de marché Atrias) afin d'identifier des leviers d’optimisation.
Être l‘intermédiaire privilégié entre le Métier et la DSI au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires ou Agile.
Accompagner les projets décisionnels et de migration de données : analyse des besoins décisionnels, modélisation des données, création de flux de données (ETL/pipelines) et élaboration de tableaux de bord.
Réaliser des études sur les bases de données métiers, veiller à la qualité des données et contribuer à la maintenance opérationnelle des solutions BI/Analytics existantes.
Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des outils de reporting et réaliser les documentations fonctionnelles et techniques.


Profil

En Tant Que Data Analyst Vous Maitrisez


Le secteur énergétique belge et les processus du marché libéralisé (MIG6, rôles des acteurs de marché, données de comptage/flux de marché).
Le requêtage SQL avancé et les concepts de modélisation / préparation de données (ETL, entrepôts de données).
Au moins un outil majeur de Datavisualisation / BI (Power BI, Tableau, WebI, etc.).
La conduite d'études analytiques et la traduction de besoins métiers en solutions Data à valeur ajoutée.
Niveau Néerlandais C2 (CECR) indispensable (écrit et oral) pour les échanges quotidiens avec le métier.


Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un parcours universitaire technique, vous justifiez d’au minimum 3 à 5 années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que Data Analyst ou Consultant BI dans l'environnement de l'énergie.

Welkom in het team

Als data analist zorg je mee voor een visie, strategie en praktische oplossingen voor datagebruik en data-evolutie binnen de directie Sparen & Betalen. Zo zorg je ervoor dat alle activiteiten en beslissingen gerelateerd aan deze afdeling kunnen gebeuren op basis van kwalitatieve, toegankelijke data.

Jouw rol in het team:


Je verzamelt en definieert datanoden om zo input te geven voor de datastrategie en -visie. Deze strategie zal ons toelaten om projecten te lanceren en bij te sturen zodat Argenta meer toekomstgericht kan evolueren.
Je onderzoekt en ontwikkelt oplossingen die het hele management voorzien van nuttige data om meer datagedreven beslissingen te kunnen nemen.
Je bouwt gesimplificeerde en vooraf berekende datamarts om de business snel toegang te geven tot kwaliteitsvolle data en analyses en zo de rapportering te versnellen.
Als data analist draag je bij aan boeiende data science initiatieven.
Je activeert een (proactieve) data driven cultuur om de strategie van operaties binnen Argenta naar een hoger niveau te tillen.


Argenta en jij: een match?

Als je bij Argenta komt werken, word je Argentaan. Maar Argentaan zijn is meer dan een job hebben bij Argenta.

Bij alles wat je doet, verlies je nooit onze focuswaarden uit het oog: we werken samen, in alle eenvoud, voor onze klanten.

Dat doe je met kennis van zaken, en altijd met twee voeten op de grond. Als Argentaan geef je elke dag opnieuw het beste van jezelf. Je komt terecht in een veilige omgeving waarin je fouten mag maken. En waarin we elkaar durven uitdagen en feedback geven. We zijn ambitieus en leggen de lat hoog. Door elkaar te helpen raken we samen over die lat. Zo maken we een positief verschil voor onze medewerkers, onze klanten en de samenleving.

Wees gerust: bij Argenta kun je gewoon jezelf zijn. Jouw talenten en ambities staan centraal. Groeien en samen winnen, daar gaan we voor.

Een aantrekkelijk brutoloon
Maaltijdcheques
Groepsverzekering
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Netto onkostenvergoeding van 165 euro per maand
Een cafetariaplan waarmee je het bedrag van je 13de maand flexibel kunt inzetten om aan voordelige voorwaarden bijvoorbeeld een smartphone te leasen of extra verlofdagen aan te kopen
Keuze tussen een bedrijfswagen (inclusief tankkaart of laadoplossing) of een aantrekkelijk mobiliteitsbudget dat je kunt spenderen aan duurzame mobiliteitsalternatieven, zoals de aankoop van een fiets, het gebruik van een deelauto of de terugbetaling van je huisvestingskosten

Zin in de job? Voel je de match? Check nog even of je ook de juiste ingesteldheid en achtergrondkennis hebt en ga ervoor.


Je hebt een masterdiploma op zak en hebt reeds ervaring in een relevante functie.
Je voelt je comfortabel als brug tussen business en data. Je kan de noden van onze business partners gemakkelijk vertalen naar de nodige datarapportage en dashboards.
Je bent communicatief en legt gemakkelijk connectie met de nodige stakeholders.
Je hebt kennis van Tableau, SQL of gelijkaardige tools.
Je hebt interesse in Databricks en AI tools.
Raakvlakken met data science schrikken je niet af.
Je bent resultaatgericht, ondernemend en kritisch.
Je hebt een zeer analytische geest en kan daardoor gemakkelijk het datalandschap rationaliseren en optimaliseren.
We zoeken iemand met een passie voor data en een gezonde interesse in het business aspect van de directie Sparen & Betalen.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Sunrise Group

Sunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care. We started in 2015 with a straightforward idea: sleep diagnosis should happen in the comfort of your own home, not in a hospital. To make that possible, we created a first-of-its-kind chin sensor, carefully validated through clinical research, reviewed by leading sleep experts, and cleared by the FDA.

Since then, Sunrise Group has grown from a single innovation into a complete sleep health company. We now design advanced diagnostic and treatment solutions, and we deliver care directly to patients through Dreem Health, our digital sleep clinic. By serving patients in all 50 states with reimbursed care, we are making sleep treatment more accessible, more personal, and much simpler than it has ever been.

Your Opportunity

The Data Analyst owns analysis delivery across the business, spanning Acquisition, Clinical Operations, Revenue, Product and Supply. This is the second position in the analytics function, and a generalist one. Requests arrive from different teams as open questions, and the role is responsible for scoping them into defined analytical problems, producing the analysis, and turning the insights into a recommendation the business can act on.

Beyond the analyses themselves, the role builds and maintains the data model and the BI layer: the datasets and dashboards that let stakeholders track and report on their own work independently. That self-sufficiency is a deliberate objective to keep the analytics team focused on exploratory and investigative work. Metric definitions and modeling standards are maintained collaboratively within the team, so numbers stay consistent wherever they are used. The role also occasionally touches the data pipelines feeding those datasets, setting up new ones so the data exists, improving existing ones, or investigating transformations that fail.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
As part of its sustained growth, Gaming1 is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join its Lab team.

The Lab drives two kinds of innovation that feed each other.




On one side, a Transversal team reads signals across every player journey to catch cross-area patterns, builds the shared

methodologies and tools the whole Lab relies on, and pushes AI-driven experimentation company-wide.




On the other side, each Data Analyst is a named data partner for an area/journey; You become the owner and expert of your player journey: a driver of the journey, not just a do-er. Your work is anchored to the journey rather than ad-hoc requests, giving

you real depth, real continuity and a genuine seat alongside the Head Of, PM, Data Engineers and Data Scientists of your Area. You anticipate what's coming before it's asked for, spot the friction and opportunities that aren't on the roadmap yet.




YOUR ROLE

Proactively detecting emerging trends, value opportunities, or organizational "blind spots" that have not yet been
formalized.
Analysing complex, ambiguous issues to objectify debates with facts and accelerate high-impact decision-making.
Seek to understand the actual friction behind every player’s behaviour and its root causes — going beyond simply
delivering a report.
Conducting targeted explorations and Proof of Concepts (including AI) to test hypotheses and qualify the potential of
new approaches before industrialization.
Designing visual, convincing deliverables (insight notes, Power BI dashboards, analytical frameworks) that are directly
exploitable by decision-makers.
Collaborating with Head Of, PM, Data Engineers & Data Scientists of your Area; build that relationship and own that
communication




YOUR MINDSET

We are looking for a professional who has moved beyond following instructions to taking initiative and for explorers who
love to make data "talk" to challenge the status quo.
You enjoy formulating hypotheses, confronting them with reality, and accepting when facts contradict your initial
assumptions.
You are not wedded to a routine; you adapt your level of formalism and your tools to the urgency and impact of the
subject.
You don’t just deliver a report; you seek to understand the actual friction behind every player’s behaviour and its root
causes.
You know how to step away from the daily flow to conduct long-term research that will structure the company's future.
You are comfortable making dysfunctions visible and challenging existing solutions.
You thrive in a team environment and interact daily with various departments to refine your understanding of the
business reality




YOUR PROFILE

Typically, 6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence or a related analytical role, with demonstrated
ownership of analytical products and the ability to lead analytical directions while remaining hands-on
Advanced SQL skills and experience building maintainable, production-grade queries, semantic models and data
products
Strong data visualization tool expertise, including semantic model design, DAX, dataflows, and report governance (e.g.
Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
Solid data modelling practices, including star schema, documentation, data quality standards with a focus on
reproducible and scalable work
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms
Python proficiency for analytical work beyond SQL: statistical analysis, cohort modelling, data wrangling, exploratory
automation and lightweight prototyping
Experience analysing player or customer behavioural data — funnels, retention, journey mapping, segmentation
Professional proficiency in English
A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent
practical experience







Interested in learning more?

Koda Staff is managing this search exclusively on behalf of GAMING1.

If the role aligns with your experience, or you'd like to explore fit and scope in more detail, applications and confidential conversations are welcome.

Title: Commercieel Data Analist
Description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Ben jij iemand die moeiteloos verbanden legt tussen cijfers, marktinformatie en commerciële opportuniteiten? Krijg je energie van analyses die een directe impact hebben op klanten, groei en strategie? Dan is dit jouw kans om data om te zetten in waardevolle inzichten.

Voor een internationaal actieve organisatie binnen de consumer goods-sector zijn we op zoek naar een Commercieel Data Analyst. In deze functie werk je op het kruispunt van sales, marktanalyse en business intelligence en ondersteun je commerciële teams met inzichten die écht het verschil maken.

Als Commercieel & Data Analyst help je commerciële teams om beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen. Je brengt data samen uit verschillende bronnen, analyseert trends en vertaalt complexe informatie naar heldere aanbevelingen. Dankzij jouw analyses krijgen accountmanagers, category specialisten en business stakeholders een beter inzicht in markt dynamieken, consumentengedrag en commerciële opportuniteiten.


Je verzamelt en combineert gegevens uit verschillende databronnen zoals verkoopresultaten, marktinformatie, klantdata en promotiecampagnes.
Je analyseert prestaties, evoluties en trends binnen productcategorieën en klantsegmenten.
Je vertaalt cijfers naar concrete aanbevelingen die commerciële groei ondersteunen.
Je levert inzichten aan voor klantgesprekken, strategische business reviews en commerciële presentaties.
Je helpt accountmanagers bij het identificeren van groeikansen en optimalisaties.
Je ondersteunt bij assortimentsanalyses en aanbevelingen voor klanten.


Profiel kandidaat


Je werkt graag met cijfers, rapporteringen en datasets.
Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt kritisch.
Je bent nieuwsgierig en gaat actief op zoek naar verbanden en inzichten.
Je werkt gestructureerd en behoudt overzicht over verschillende projecten tegelijk.
Je hebt interesse in consumentengedrag, retail en commerciële strategie.
Je bent zeer sterk in Excel.
Ervaring met Power BI of andere reportingtools is zeer grote troef.
Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.


Geboden wordt


Een functie waarin jouw analyses rechtstreeks bijdragen aan commerciële groei en strategische beslissingen.
Veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en verbeteringen voor te stellen.
Nauw samenwerken met ervaren professionals binnen sales, category management en business operations.
Een internationale werkomgeving waar data een belangrijke rol speelt in de besluitvorming.
De kans om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen business intelligence, commerciële analyse en category management.
Een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, samenwerking en innovatie centraal staan.
Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket aangevuld met extralegale voordelen.
Een omgeving waar jouw inzichten zichtbaar impact hebben op klanten, resultaten en toekomstige groei.

Sterke analytische vaardigheden, gestructureerde manier van werken én het talent om data te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten.

De Data Analyst is de schakel tussen operations, business en IT. Door data, automatisering en AI te verbinden met de operationele realiteit, zorgt deze rol voor meer transparantie, betere besluitvorming en efficiëntere processen. Title: (Tech) Data Analyst
Description:
WHO IS EDENRED?

Edenred is the global leader in Benefits & Engagement and Mobility. With more than 1 million client companies across 44 countries, Edenred's platform gives more than 60 million users access to the services and products of more than 2 million partner merchants. Edenred offers digital solutions dedicated to employees (meal vouchers, commuting, gift cards, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers), fleet managers (multi-energy solutions including EV charging, maintenance services, tolls, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards).




'Enrich connections. For good.'

Guided by the Group's purpose, these solutions enhance employees' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers. They promote access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. Finally, they improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses while vitalizing the employment market and local economies.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2025, thanks to its unique technology platform, the Group generated a business volume of €49 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms, and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index and DJSI World Index.







YOU WILL VIBE WITH US

As part of Edenred BeLux, you will be working as Data Analyst in our Tech Data Team

The main scope of Tech Data Team is to create data products on our Global Edenred Azure Data Platform, build data sets, provide strategic dashboard & reports in Power BI and enable self-service reporting across the organization/

As a Data Analyst, you are aprofessional specialized in the design, implementation, and management of the systems, architectures, and tools necessary for the collection, storage, transformation, and distribution of data. The primary role of a Tech Data Analyst is to develop and maintain the technical infrastructure that allows companies to organize and efficiently exploit their data.




The key stakeholders for this position are:




Internal: End-users & key users, Data & Product managers and executives, process owners/team leaders and managers, Agile Teams (Scrum Masters and Product Owners).
External: HQ’s corporate IT, Remote Development centers, customers and partners.
Reporting Line: you report directly to the IT Back-end & Data Product Owner and your N+2 will be the CTO Edenred BeLux.




As Data Analyst, you will be in charge of Collecting & organizing the data on an efficient, compliant & secured way (pricing analytics, Client / merchant segmentation, Business Review reporting :




Business analysis & modelling: understanding, documenting, supporting, and analyzing procedures that support the business functions performed in the different departments of the company..
Data management: Takes responsibility for the accessibility, retrievability and security of specific subsets of data
Data visualization: develop reports & dashboards in PowerBI or other Data Visualization tools
Requirements definition & management: defining user stories and acceptance criteria with the key users, Product Owners, Product Managers and Business Sponsors.
Development & implementation: participate actively with the dev. team, lead the validation efforts with the end users and proactively help the team members on their tasks to finish each Sprint.
Application support & Customer service support: as a team, take full responsibility of changes put into production
The quality of the deliverables: testing of Business Process & applications.







WE WILL VIBE WITH YOU

We are looking for individuals with a proven track record (3+ years) in data analysis in financial services industry or gained in a consultancy environment, or a similar relevant experience.




A person who can bridge business needs and data solutions by translating business requirements into structured data models, specifications, and analytics use cases.

Ideally, the candidate has experience working in an Agile/Scrum/SAFE context.




You have proficiency in:




Data Modeling & Data Architecture

Understanding of conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Ability to design and document data flows and business data rules.
Knowledge of data warehouses, data marts, APIs, ETL/ELT processes, and integration patterns.
Understanding of master data, reference data, and data lifecycle management.




Programming and Data Visualization Languages

Proficiency in SQL and data analysis languages.
Strong understanding of DAX and analytical calculations.
Mastery of Power BI and data visualization best practices.
Ability to design meaningful KPIs and dashboards.
Capacity to translate business requirements into efficient reporting solutions




Data Integration & Ecosystem

Understanding of APIs, file exchanges, and integration mechanisms between business applications.
Ability to analyze source-to-target mappings and data transformation rules.
Experience working with ERP, CRM, Finance, and Data platforms.
Understanding of data lineage and end-to-end data flows across systems.




Data Collection and Management

Extraction of relevant data from large volumes
Ability to perform root cause analysis and data investigations
Experience in data reconciliation and data quality controls




Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Analysis of information from dashboards and reports.
Identification of trends, anomalies and data issues.
Data quality assessment and root cause analysis.




Functional Analysis & Requirements Management

Collection, analysis, and formalization of business requirements.
Translation of business needs into functional specifications and user stories.
Definition of acceptance criteria and support during User Acceptance Testing.
Validation of business rules, data transformations and reporting outputs
Impact analysis across systems, processes, and data flows.
Facilitation of workshops between business and technical stakeholders.




Data Security, Legislation and Data Governance

Mastery of data security requirements and standards (GDPR, ethics)
Knowledge of the legal framework for the use of algorithms and profiling (CNIL)
Guardian of Data governance & data quality management
Understanding of data governance concepts and ability to enhance the role and importance of data within the company.




Communication and Presentation: Skills in written and verbal communication, adaptability of the message depending on the audience, and creation of clear and persuasive presentations.

French and English Proficiency: At Edenred, advanced English proficiency is an essential skill, enabling smooth and effective communication within teams.




You can demonstrate:

Strong, assertive personality capable of leading through challenging situations.
Ability to analyze complex information, extract key ideas, & synthesize for decision
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of engaging and influencing.
Strong customer orientation with capability to understand business requirements and convert it to tasks for implementation
Sharing Edenred’s values (Entrepreneurial Spirit, Passion for Customers, Simplicity, Imagination and Respect).




At Edenred, we recognize, recruit, and develop all talents while respecting each individual's uniqueness.

We encourage and consider all applications without distinction of origin, gender, identity or expression of gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other protected criteria as defined by Unia.







START DATE

ASAP







OTHER INFORMATION

Permanent contract (38 hours/week)
Location: Brussels (Auderghem)
A stimulating position within a dynamic organization that focuses on technological innovation to enhance workers' purchasing power.
The opportunity to work remotely 2 days a week with your manager's approval, including a homeworking allowance of 115€.
You are covered with hospitalization and ambulatory care insurance (with the option to extend it to your family).
You benefit from all Edenred-solutions, such as vouchers but also Edenred Engagement (including Edenred Discounts).
Your package includes a car or a mobility budget, depending on what you prefer.

Title: Data Analyst — Service Performance Dashboards for NATO with security clearance
Description:
An enterprise service performance dashboard has come out of prototype and now has real users, real feedback and a growing list of service providers who need to feed data into it. A small analytics team is being formed to take it further: more features, a better interface, and pipelines that can absorb far more service data than they do today.

You would be one of five analysts in that team, working alongside a service level manager, on site with the customer's own technical staff.

What You Would Be Doing


Analysing how services are performing and turning that into metrics people will actually act on.
Designing and building new dashboard features, from the first look at user feedback through to the released version.
Improving the experience of using the dashboard — the visualisations, the accessibility and the plain usability of it.
Designing the data collection interface: formats, measurements and controls, written up as a specification and taken through a formal review with the people who will use it.
Building, testing and deploying that interface so several service providers can supply their own performance data to one standard.
Building and automating the pipelines behind it with Python and modern ETL tooling, so the dashboard scales as more services are added.
Operating and maintaining what you build — incidents, access requests, user questions and training — against agreed availability and resolution targets.
Keeping the as-built documentation, use cases and data model accurate as the thing changes.


What you would bring


A relevant degree from a recognised university and at least four years of related experience, as a data analyst, data scientist or UX designer.
Demonstrable Python, and SQL against relational databases such as SQL Server.
Real depth in data visualisation, principally Power BI.
Experience building and integrating APIs so that monitoring can be driven by data rather than by hand.
Experience managing data flows with ETL and ELT tooling — Apache NiFi specifically is required.
Sound knowledge of KPIs and formal reporting through dashboards, including how to design user-experience metrics and monitor them.
Practical UX and UI design skills, and experience of IT service management.
The ability to write technical documentation, requirements and user guides, and to translate between what users ask for and what gets built.
Excellent spoken and written communication, with good briefing skills.
