Title: V.I.E Sales Business Analyst - Eucerin
Description:
Your Tasks

Please note that this opportunity is offered as part of the VIE (Volontariat International en Entreprise) Programme, providing a unique international career experience within a global organization. Applications can only be considered from candidates who meet the formal eligibility criteria and participation requirements of the VIE Programme.

Your role

Acting as business partner for all Sales functions and driving data driven decision making for strategic topics. Responsible for the monitoring and KPI analysis of e.g. Sell-In & Sell-Out Data Dashboards, Promo activities, Category Management and the activities of the field sales team as well as working on strategic projects.

Main Responsibilities

Enable data driven Shopper & Customer Marketing


Uses data & insights to support the S&CM team in making best in class in-store shopper activations & maximizing offtake on Eucerin across all available shopper contact points
Monitors progress of promotional activities and handles Pre & Post analyses of promos to generate insights to be used to strengthen existing plans and maximize future activation plans - Supports on overall coordination of launches and helps deliver sales, market share & category growth for Eucerin
Continuous analysis of the market and competitors, e.g. to be inspired by new trends


Optimize & maximize Sales activities in the (e-)POS and category management via use of data


Analyses monthly sell out/ sell in data and prepares data in custom built Power BI tool
Uses data & insights to support on optimizing assortment ranking & distribution and shares gap analyses
Runs ad-hoc analyses as part of business partnering for the whole sales team


Enable high team performance by increasing effectiveness & efficiency


Supports team capacity planning and sector allocation in the field team by using data to find the most efficient set up
Tracks all relevant Sales KPIs as well as the Sales targets as defined by Sales Manager and shares updates with team
Handles weekly, monthly and quarterly Sales tracking and bonus incentive follow-up


Drive the future of the business via Sales Projects


Participates in / lead (strategic) sales projects to set the path for future success via e.g. improving the way of working, increasing efficiency & effectiveness etc.
Cooperates with the regional & global teams as well as teams from other countries to find synergies and share + make use of best practices


Your Profile

What it takes to join us?


Eligibility to VIE contract - conditions: https://mon-vie-via.businessfrance.fr/en/what-is-the-vie-french-international-young-talent-program
Available for 12 months (starting date 1 January 2027)
University degree (Sales, Business Administration, Marketing)
First experience as Business Analyst / Category Manager / RGM Manager or Business Controller
Analytical mindset & ability to handle multiple projects with medium to high complexity
High-level skills in Microsoft Office, Excel and Business Analytics
Problem solving and hands-on mentality
Team player with good communication skills
Multilingual preferred : English, Dutch, French


At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society. Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

Title: Data Functional Analyst - FR
Description:
Description de la fonction

En tant que Data Functional Analyst, vous intégrez le Data Office au sein duquel travaillent des équipes agiles multidisciplinaires (Data Engineer, Chefs de Projet, Data Architects, Data Governance et Data Quality spécialistes, Experts en IA, …).

Rôle & responsabilités :


Mener des discussions avec les différents SME (Subject Matter Expert) pour comprendre leurs besoins business.
Identifier, évaluer et comprendre les processus métier, les flux de données opérationnelles et analytiques (entrants et sortants).
Traduire les besoins de l'entreprise en données et exigences techniques.
Concevoir et valider les modèles de données en collaboration avec les Data Architects.
Établir la conception fonctionnelle de nos développements en collaboration avec l'équipe de gouvernance des données, les responsables techniques BI et les équipes informatiques.
Être en contact avec le responsable Data Protection pour assurer la conformité au RGPD et à la sécurité des données.
Assurer le testing des solutions data développées.
Informer et former aux matières data et encourager l’utilisation et l'adoption des solutions dévelopées.


Profil

Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master en informatique ou expérience équivalente et disposez de minimum 5 ans d'expérience dans l'analyse fonctionnelle des données. Vous faites, par ailleurs, valoir une expérience concrète dans la modélisation de Data Warehouse (approche Kimball) et avez de l’expérience dans la conception et l'analyse des flux de données. Une expérience préalable en tant que Data Engineer est un plus.

Vous disposez de minimum 3 ans d'expérience concrète avec MS on-premise stack (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, PowerBI). Une expérience avec Azure Databricks est un plus.

Vos excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation vous permettent de traduire les besoins de l'entreprise en solutions techniques.

Vous disposez de bonnes compétences conceptuelles et commerciales.

Orienté solutions, votre approche pragmatique vous permet de mettre en œuvre les actions nécessaires à l’atteinte des objectifs.

Bon team player, vous êtes par ailleurs capable de fédérer autour d’un objectif commun.

Vous vous montrez persévérant, résistant au stress et flexible, aimez apprendre et êtes ouvert d'esprit.

Vous maîtrisez, par ailleurs, les deux langues nationales.

Nous offrons


Nous vous offrons un emploi varié, stimulant et socialement engagé vous permettant de contribuer à la réalisation de solutions informatiques ayant un impact sur la société. « ICT for society » n’est pas notre slogan par hasard.
Vous recherchez un bon équilibre vie privée - vie professionnelle ? Profitez de nos horaires de travail flexibles et de notre politique de télétravail très étendue.
Nous offrons de nombreuses possibilités de formation interne et externe vous permettant de perfectionner en permanence vos compétences techniques et vos aptitudes personnelles.
Nous vous proposons un salaire compétitif, complété par des avantages extralégaux tels qu'une assurance hospitalisation, un plan de pension complémentaire, des chèques-repas, des éco-chèques, etc.
Les fonctions IT peuvent bénéficier d’un budget mobilité avec le choix d'une voiture de société et/ou le remboursement des frais de transport en commun. Sous certaines conditions, ce budget peut même être utilisé pour le paiement de votre loyer ou de votre crédit hypothécaire.
Vous profitez via notre plateforme « Benefits at Work » de réductions avantageuses sur diverses marques de mode, d’électronique, diverses excursions et divers séjours de vacances…
Nous menons une politique d'égalité des chances et estimons notamment que l'égalité salariale est importante.

Title: Data Functional Analyst - NL
Description:
Functiebeschrijving

Als Data Functional Analyst maak je deel uit van het Data Office, waar multidisciplinaire agile-teams werken (Data Engineer, Project Leader, Data Architects, Data Governance- en Data Quality-specialisten, AI-Experts, enz.).

Rol & verantwoordelijkheden


Gesprekken voeren met verschillende SME (Subject Matter Expert) om hun business behoeften te begrijpen.
Bedrijfsprocessen en operationele en analytische dataflows (inkomend en uitgaand) identificeren, evalueren en begrijpen.
De behoeften van de organisatie vertalen naar data en technische vereisten.
In samenwerking met de data-architecten datamodellen ontwerpen en valideren.
In samenwerking met het datagovernanceteam, de technische BI-verantwoordelijken en de IT-teams het functionele ontwerp van onze ontwikkelingen vaststellen.
In contact staan met de Data Protection Manager om de naleving van de GDPR en de gegevensbeveiliging te waarborgen.
Zorgen voor het testen van de ontwikkelde dataoplossingen.
Informeren en opleiden over datagerelateerde onderwerpen en het gebruik en de acceptatie van de ontwikkelde oplossingen stimuleren.


Profiel

Je hebt een master in IT of een gelijkwaardige ervaring en minstens 5 jaar ervaring in functionele data-analyse. Bovendien beschik je over concrete ervaring in het modelleren van datawarehouses (Kimball-aanpak). Ook heb je ervaring in het ontwerpen en analyseren van dataflows. Eerdere ervaring als data-engineer is een pluspunt.

Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar concrete ervaring met MS on-premise stack (SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, PowerBI). Ervaring met Azure Databricks is een pluspunt.

Dankzij jouw uitstekende communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden kun je de behoeften van het bedrijf vertalen naar technische oplossingen.

Je beschikt over goede conceptuele en commerciële vaardigheden.

Je bent oplossingsgericht en dankzij jouw pragmatische aanpak kun je de nodige maatregelen nemen om de doelstellingen te bereiken.

Je bent een goede teamspeler en kunt mensen verbinden rond een gemeenschappelijk doel.

Je bent een doorzetter, stressbestendig en flexibel persoon, die graag leert en openstaat voor nieuwe ideeën.

Je beheerst bovendien beide landstalen.

Wij bieden


Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid.
We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,…
IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur of hypothecaire lening.
Via ons 'Benefits at Work'-platform geniet je van mooie kortingen op mode, elektronica, daguitstappen, vakantieverblijven, …
We voeren een gelijkekansenbeleid en vinden o.a. equal pay belangrijk.

Title: Senior Consultant in Data Science
Description:
Belgium (Policy Consulting) / Full-time / Permanent employee







Technopolis Group is looking to grow its data science team. We are now looking to recruit a motivated and experienced specialist to join our Brussels team as a Senior Consultant.




ABOUT TECHNOPOLIS




Founded in 1989, Technopolis Group is an independent research and consultancy company, European leader in providing strategic policy advice to public sector institutions at the local, regional, national, and international levels (such as the European institutions) – as well as to third sector organisations, public-private partnerships and research organisations.




Our Group is active in many areas such as R&I, Health, Higher Education, Green economy, Industry and entrepreneurship, Regional and urban development, Digital economy and Open science.




We have grown steadily over the past 30 years and have and a track record of over 4,000 projects. Technopolis Group has offices in ten European cities and offices in Colombia (Bogotà) and Ivory Coast (Abidjan). Our team of consultants brings an educational mix in a variety of policy, social, environmental science disciplines, and linguistic richness, originating from 40+countries and covering 30+ languages.




For more information: www.technopolis-group.com




THE TEAM




The selected person will be part of the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work in different country offices. The growing team of DSU data scientists have diversified academic backgrounds but a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The unit works in policy consulting jobs for our clients but also conducts R&D to develop new, untested and exciting applications, potentially in collaboration with internal and external partners.




The DSU is active in all types of data science applications in policymaking. See https://www.technopolis-group.com/solutions/data-analytics/. Examples include record linkage, building classifiers, semantic and sentiment analysis, web scraping and dynamic visualisations. Additionally, the team is looking forward to expanding its portfolio of techniques using real-time indicators, causal AI and generative AI. Experience in these last techniques, or a general understanding of their functioning combined with a demonstrable willingness to master them, is highly desirable.







ABOUT THIS JOB




Main tasks

The typical tasks of the Senior Consultant in data science are:

Leading the design and implementation of suitable data science methodologies
Perform analyses to answer policy questions leveraging R, Python and other programming and data science tools
Write own code to perform analyses
Extract and transform data from multiple sources, and develop processes for data cleaning, integration, and validation
Develop dashboards using visualization tools such as Tableau / PowerBI to communicate findings
Report on the findings and present to clients







YOUR PROFILE




Experience and skills

Applicants suitable for a Senior Consultant in data science position should have:

Master’s Degree in data science, Computer Science or related subjects
A minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in a consulting or research environment in data science
Proficient in R and Python
Experience with NLP and text knowledge extraction
Knowledge and interest in Machine Learning methods including classification, clustering and predictive modelling
Hands-on experience using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) programmatically through APIs, including their integration into automated data processing, text analysis and knowledge-extraction pipelines
A very good knowledge of economics and statistics, together with familiarity with business, industrial and innovation-related data, is essential to ensure analytical outputs are interpreted and communicated in a policy-relevant way.
Proven experience in designing composite indicators and scoreboards and hands-on knowledge of the COINr package, is a major asset.
Knowledge of various open data sources, the collaborative platform Github, database consolidation and processing and web scraping
A general overview of the Science Technology and Innovation domain and proven track in working together with policymakers in this area is desirable
Applicants should have good communication skills and be able to work in an international and multicultural environment







OUR OFFER




What we offer

A full time, permanent position
An attractive salary package with benefits including hospitalisation insurance and a pension scheme
A positive working atmosphere within a team of like-minded professionals in Brussels, while also being part of a larger international Group with multiple opportunities for international cooperation
Good opportunities for career progression, from both a content perspective (thought leaders, methodological specialists) and in the areas of business development and company leadership




Interested? Apply directly




We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons with a residency and work permit in Belgium.







HOW TO APPLY




Applications can be done directly on Technopolis website or sent to recruitment_be@technopolis-group.com (reference: DS26) and include a cover letter and an Europass-style CV.




Application deadline: 09 October 2026. Early applications are encouraged. Applications will be assessed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.




Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.




Applicants should have the EU citizenship or a valid work permit to apply.










ABOUT US




At Technopolis Group, we began our journey as pioneers in the evaluation of science, technology and innovation policies. While evaluation remains a cornerstone of our identity, we’ve evolved into a trusted partner for evidence-based decision-making across a wide spectrum of policy areas.




Today, our multidisciplinary experts offer strategic advice, forward-looking foresight, and robust project and network management, even in the most complex contexts. We combine cutting-edge data analytics with a deep understanding of policy to deliver insights that are both rigorous and actionable. From assessing policy effectiveness to measuring impact and communicating results to diverse audiences, we ensure clarity, relevance and reach.




We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Instead, we collaborate closely with our clients to design tailored approaches that truly meet their needs.

Our work spans the globe and the governance spectrum, partnering with international institutions such as the European Commission and multilateral development banks, as well as with national, regional and local authorities. We also support universities, research centres, business networks, clusters, and incubators, helping them navigate complexity and drive impact.

Title: Data & Process Consultant
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description

As a Data & Process Consultant, you play a key role in achieving our clients' strategic objectives by analyzing, optimizing, and implementing both business processes and data-driven solutions. You lead complex transformation projects from start to finish, bridging the gap between operations, IT, data teams, and business stakeholders.

You understand how processes generate and consume data and how data, in turn, drives smarter processes. You combine business insight, technological expertise, and analytical thinking to design solutions that are practical, scalable, and measurable.

Working closely with clients and internal teams, you guide initiatives from requirements analysis through implementation and performance monitoring, ensuring that process improvements are supported by robust data foundations.

What You Will Do

Process Excellence


Apply our methodology to efficiently specify, analyze, design, and implement business processes.
Independently lead projects and initiatives, providing substantive guidance to teams of professionals.
Translate complex organizational structures into understandable, workable solutions and ensure smooth collaboration within projects.
Develop product breakdown structures for large-scale, long-term programs (budgets ranging from €3–50 million).
Model business processes using BPM tools and perform simulations and analyses for optimization.
Advise clients on best practices in process design, operational excellence, and digital transformation.
Provide training and support to ensure effective adoption of newly designed processes.


Data-Driven Transformation


Analyze data flows across systems to identify inefficiencies, inconsistencies, and optimization opportunities.
Design data models and define data requirements aligned with business process improvements.
Translate business needs into data architecture, reporting, and dashboard requirements.
Perform data analysis to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement potential.
Support the implementation of data governance frameworks, ensuring data quality, ownership, and compliance.
Define KPIs and performance measurement frameworks linked to optimized processes.
Work with BI, analytics, and IT teams to ensure seamless integration between process design and data infrastructure.
Leverage advanced analytics and automation to enable predictive and prescriptive process improvements.


Personal & Professional Growth


Actively invest in personal development and deepen expertise in both process management and data analytics.
Communicate independently and confidently with clients at different organizational levels.
Take ownership of (sub)projects, proactively manage expectations, and escalate when needed.
Guide 1–2 analysts and coordinate their contributions within the project.
Act as a culture bearer within the organization, promoting collaboration, ownership, and excellence.


Contributing to Sia’s Growth

Commercial


Identify commercial opportunities within projects and share them with the responsible project manager.
Contribute to proposals and client discussions related to data and process transformation.


Knowledge


Share acquired knowledge internally and contribute to thought leadership in process excellence and data-driven transformation.
Support internal capability development in analytics, data governance, and digital process innovation.


Portfolio


Connect client challenges to Sia’s broader service portfolio, including digital transformation, data & AI, operational excellence, and enterprise transformation.


Qualifications

Profile


Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or related field.
1–3 years of experience in process consulting, data consulting, or digital transformation.
Strong analytical mindset with experience in BPM, data modeling, and performance measurement.
Proficient with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), SQL, or data analysis tools is a plus.
You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Fluent in Dutch, French and English (additional languages like German are a plus).


In return, you can expect:


An international company that gives importance to diversity, inclusion, employee well-being and corporate social responsibilities actions.
A great working atmosphere with friendly and professional colleagues where innovation and entrepreneurship are encouraged
A personal development plan with a regular follow-up as well training opportunities to develop yourself
A competitive salary with great advantages, like mobility budget/company car, hospital insurance, performance -related bonus,...


Additional Information

We are unable to provide a work permit for this position

Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Business Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Are you ready to shape the future of energy trading and sales? As a Business Analyst at Axpo, you will play a vital role in driving efficiency, reducing operational risks, and supporting strategic projects within the Axpo Solutions Group. Join us to make an impact in a dynamic and innovative environment.

What you will do:


Support the invoicing processes for Full Supply and PPA business.
Coordinate with Market Operations (MO), Front Office Services (FOS), and Front Office (FO) to ensure seamless contract onboarding into internal systems.
Reduce operational risks and enhance efficiency by implementing strategic decisions within Back Office Services and Business Support teams.
Lead and support individual business transformation and strategic projects.
Analyze processes, tackle complex P&L inquiries, and resolve operational challenges to ensure smooth daily delivery.
Collaborate on IT specifications and manage IT changes for Back Office Services.
Drive automation, quality improvements, and lead-time optimizations using your technical expertise.
Develop and maintain management reporting tools (e.g. KPI reports) and contribute to development and design of invoicing system.
Follow up on audit findings to ensure timely implementation.



What you bring & who you are:


Education & Experience:
Higher education in Business Management or Information Technology.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in energy trading and sales.
Business fluency in English (C1/C2); additional European languages are a plus.

Technical Expertise:
Strong knowledge of energy and financial markets (e.g., contract mapping, trading products, financial settlements, collaterals, and margins).
Expertise in deal lifecycle management for Full Supply and PPA business, including deal booking, contract modeling, and invoicing.
Proficiency in data analysis and coding (e.g., SQL, C#, Python).
Experience with BI tools like PowerBI or SSRS for data visualization and analysis.
Familiarity with ETL development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, DATAIKU) is a plus.

Other Skills:
Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder alignment abilities.
High customer and result orientation, even under time pressure.
Ability to balance compliance and innovation effectively.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Analytics Engineer




Are you passionate about turning raw data into powerful insights?




As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll be the mastermind behind creating trusted, reusable, and analytics-ready data products that drive smarter decisions across the consumer business unit. You’ll design key business metrics, build semantic models, and develop reliable datasets that form the backbone of self-service analytics, executive strategies, and cutting-edge AI capabilities.




Operating at the crossroads of business performance, data engineering, and governance, you’ll ensure that data isn’t just available — it’s clear, trustworthy, and scalable for everyone.




Without your expertise, teams would still be stuck with fragmented KPIs, manual reports, and inconsistent data — holding back growth, trust, and the future of AI-driven innovation.




Your Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain trusted, business-focused data products, KPIs, and datasets; translate business ideas into reusable metrics; collaborate with Data Engineering to industrialize and support self-service analytics.
Own KPI definitions and business rules, collaborate with Data Governance to ensure data quality and compliance, contribute to metadata and data lineage initiatives, and promote a single source of truth for CBU performance.
Develop trusted, reusable data assets for self-service analytics, automate reports and processes, enhance the analytics stack and semantic layer, and improve scalability, performance, and maintainability of solutions.
Prepare data for AI-driven analytics and natural language access, develop trusted datasets, evaluate new technologies to enhance user experience, and support the shift toward augmented analytics and self-service decision-making.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their challenges, support analysts with reliable data assets, and promote standard metrics and automation to improve performance management.




Requirements:

Experience & Education: At least a few years of experience in analytics engineering, BI development, or data product design; Bachelor's or Master’s in engineering, data, statistics, or related fields.
Business & Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of telecom or commercial analytics, operational performance drivers, and ability to link analytics to business outcomes.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in advanced SQL, data modeling, cloud platforms (preferably BigQuery), semantic modeling, and BI ecosystems; experience with data governance tools (e.g., DataGalaxy), transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt), and data quality management.
Data Product & Asset Development: Proven ability to design reusable data products, industrialize analytical assets, and manage KPIs and business metrics effectively.
Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities. Fluent in English (knowledge of French is also desirable)
Emerging Technologies & AI: Understanding of Generative AI use cases, LLM-based querying, conversational analytics, AI copilots, and ability to operate within human + AI workflows.
Governance & Scalability: Strong knowledge of data governance principles, scalability, and ensuring data solutions meet governance and scalability standards.
Fluent in English (knowledge of French is also desirable).




We offer:

You will develop your full potential by working with highly skilled and passionate colleagues and through continuous training.




You will have the opportunity to shape the future of data at Orange Belgium and lead AI transformation projects in the country.




Moreover, you can count on a highly competitive and versatile compensation (market competitive salary, company car or legal mobility budget, homeworking and net allowance, performance bonus, meal vouchers) and benefits package.

Title: Senior Data Science Analyst - OptimusAI
Description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:


Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


Your Impact

As a Data Science Specialist, you’ll collaborate in a dynamic, multi-disciplinary team of 3–6 experts, using your creativity and analytics expertise to drive client performance in areas like energy efficiency, product quality, and capacity. You’ll work side-by-side with client process engineers and analytics specialists, presenting your insights directly to executive audiences.

Internally, you’ll partner with our talented product engineers to develop innovative products and algorithms that address both current and future client needs. You’ll play a key role in codifying best practices, amplifying our impact both inside and outside the firm, and shaping the product roadmap.

You’ll be based in our Brussels office as part of McKinsey’s manufacturing AI solution, OptimusAI, which sits at the intersection of three practices: Global Energy and Materials, QuantumBlack, and Operations.

Global Energy and Materials: Advises production and investor companies across chemicals & agriculture, paper & packaging, metals & mining, oil & gas, and power generation on strategic, operational, and growth issues.

QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey: The AI arm of our firm, helping clients transform faster, innovate smarter, and anticipate the future.

Operations: Assists clients in solving complex operational challenges by developing and implementing strategies and solutions for their most critical problems—connecting boardroom strategies to shop floor operators.

At the intersection of these groups, OptimusAI is a team of ~10 expert consultants, data scientists, and engineers focused on improving processing plant productivity through data analytics. We develop real-time AI advisory systems to support decision making in plant control rooms, optimize process control systems, and unlock plant bottlenecks through data-driven process changes.

OptimusAI also supports a global community of consultants by developing an innovative machine learning toolkit and codifying our approach to deliver significant and lasting client impact.

You’ll benefit from world-class training in business problem structuring and client advisory, working closely with senior manufacturing and analytics experts. Experience unparalleled career growth, with significant ownership and responsibility from day one, all within a collaborative, diverse, and non-hierarchical environment. Plus, seize the opportunity to travel to client sites—locally and around the world.

There is a flexibility to hire at different role level, depending on your experience.

Your Qualifications and Skills


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, or a related field
3+ years of hands-on experience in advanced analytics, ideally within heavy industry environments
Advanced Python programming skills, with a passion for writing clean, efficient, modular, and maintainable code
Proven ability to implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for seamless model integration and deployment
Strong DevOps and backend engineering capabilities, including experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Self-starter with excellent organizational abilities—able to independently initiate tasks and drive them to completion
Skilled in making rational, data-driven decisions based on facts and logical reasoning
Ability to create high-quality work products, such as PowerPoint presentations, Excel models, articles, or other written outputs
Exceptional time management skills to thrive in a complex, largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to work or attend meetings outside traditional business hours, and to take on projects at short notice when needed
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to tailor your style to different audiences and seniority levels

Title: Data Solution Designer Microsoft SR
Description:
La responsabilité principale du Data Solution Designer Microsoft Senior est d'assurer le design des solutions Power BI en se basant sur les besoins identifiés par le business, l'implémentation des rapports intégrés, des tableaux de bord et des éventuelles alertes sur la base de Microsoft (Data Factory, Power BI, Databricks,...) pour les reportings suivants :


Reporting financier interne sur base des données SAP ECC6 et autres sources
Reporting en relation avec le service clientèle sur base des données SAP ISU et autres sources
Reporting de type RH (comme, par exemple, les tableaux de bord et rapports relatifs à l'absentéisme et aux accidents du travail), en utilisant différentes bases de données, y compris des technologies anciennes comme Software AG, WinDev,
Reporting annuel au niveau de CSRD & Taxonomie
Reporting vers notre régulateur Brugel



Et ceci, spécialement d'un point de vue technique (ETL, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Data Consumption, Data Publication et Data Forecasting), et en respectant l'architecture data définie.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Per un gruppo industriale internazionale con sedi in Italia e Svizzera, in fase di forte evoluzione e digitalizzazione dei processi, selezioniamo un/una Data Analyst da inserire all'interno della funzione IT di Gruppo.




Scopo del ruolo La figura sarà il punto di riferimento trasversale per la raccolta, la pulizia, la strutturazione e l'analisi dei dati provenienti dai diversi sistemi aziendali (ERP, gestionali di stabilimento, CRM, file operativi). L'obiettivo principale è trasformare dati eterogenei e distribuiti su più società in reportistica affidabile, dashboard di KPI e analisi a supporto delle direzioni Finance, Controllo di Gestione, Operations e Commerciale.




Responsabilità principali

Raccogliere, consolidare e validare dati provenienti da più fonti e società del Gruppo (ERP/SAP, gestionali locali, CRM, Excel), garantendone qualità e coerenza.
Sviluppare e mantenere dashboard e reportistica periodica su KPI commerciali, andamento crediti, capitale circolante, marginalità per commessa e provvigioni agenti.
Supportare il Controllo di Gestione nella predisposizione di reporting mensile, budget, forecast e nell'analisi degli scostamenti tra consuntivi e previsionali.
Predisporre reportistica a supporto dei progetti di integrazione e automazione dei flussi dati tra i gestionali del Gruppo, riducendo il lavoro manuale di riconciliazione.
Fornire analisi all'area Commerciale su performance della rete vendita, punti vendita e tracking della lead generation.
Automatizzare i processi di reportistica ricorrenti tramite Excel avanzato, query SQL e strumenti di Business Intelligence per garantire tempestività e affidabilità dei dati.
Predisporre dataset e report per l'integrazione all'interno di futuri progetti basati su AI e automazione.
Documentare fonti dati, logiche di calcolo e procedure per rendere i processi di analisi ripetibili.
Presentare periodicamente risultati e insight alla direzione a supporto del processo decisionale.




Requisiti richiesti




Laurea in ambito economico, statistico, ingegneristico, informatico o esperienza equivalente.
2–5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di data analysis, business intelligence o reporting, preferibilmente in contesti industriali o multi-societari.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL per l'estrazione e l'interrogazione in autonomia dei database.
Padronanza avanzata di Excel (formule complesse, tabelle pivot, macro) e familiarità con strumenti di BI (es. Power BI, Tableau o analoghi).
Capacità di lavorare con dati provenienti da sistemi eterogenei per ricondurli a un modello unico e coerente.
Rigore analitico, precisione e attitudine al problem solving.
Buone capacità comunicative per tradurre analisi complesse in informazioni chiare per interlocutori non tecnici.
Italiano fluente e buona conoscenza della lingua inglese per l'interazione con le società svizzere del Gruppo.




Titoli preferenziali

Esperienza pregressa in ambienti SAP o in progetti di estrazione e analisi dati da ERP.
Conoscenza di strumenti di automazione e scripting (es. Power Query, Python) per il trattamento dei dati.
Esperienza in contesti di gruppo multi-società e multi-valuta (realtà italo-svizzere o multinazionali).
Pregressa esposizione a tematiche di credit management, working capital o controllo di gestione industriale.
Partecipazione a progetti in ambito AI.




Offerta dell'azienda

Ruolo trasversale con visibilità diretta sul management e impatto concreto sulle decisioni strategiche.
Inserimento in un contesto industriale solido, in crescita e con progetti attivi di trasformazione digitale e Advanced Analytics.
Percorso di sviluppo professionale in un ambiente che valorizza l'autonomia e l'iniziativa.




Sede di lavoro: Lugano con disponibilità a trasferte saltuarie nel Nord Italia.

HTML:
Dans le cadre d’un nouveau besoin pour une banque privée basée à Genève, nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Analyst pour rejoindre les équipes.   • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques et solutions Data de l’organisation.


Qualifications

Nous recherchons un(e) professionnel(le) disposant d’une expérience confirmée en Business Analysis / Data Analysis, idéalement acquise dans le secteur bancaire.

  • Expérience significative en tant que Data Analyst / Business Analyst Data
  • Expérience bancaire obligatoire
  • Bonne maîtrise de SQL
  • Maîtrise de Power BI ou Tableau
  • Des compétences en Python constituent un réel plus
  • Bonne compréhension des problématiques Data et de reporting
  • Une expérience sur Microsoft Fabric ou dans des environnements similaires est un plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst: Multiple Teams based in Switzerland.

You will work at the intersection of data, product, and machine learning, helping teams turn complex datasets into actionable business and product insights.

Your analysis will support a range of teams working across data science, ranking, recommendations, personalization, AI-powered shopping, search optimization, and retail media.

You will investigate user behavior, identify opportunities, and evaluate how product changes affect both customer experience and business performance.

A key part of the role will be designing experiments, defining meaningful metrics, and using statistical analysis to guide product decisions.

You will work with large-scale datasets using SQL and Python while building dashboards and analytical tools that make data accessible to decision-makers.

The role offers broad exposure to engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving environment where analytical thinking, ownership, clear communication, and measurable impact are highly valued.

Accountabilities


Analyze user behavior and large-scale datasets to uncover patterns, identify issues, and surface opportunities for product and business improvement.
Design, run, and analyze A/B tests to evaluate product changes and quantify their impact on key business metrics.
Define, validate, and monitor metrics that capture both user experience and business outcomes.
Build dashboards, reports, analytical tools, and other data resources that support informed decision-making across multiple teams.
Partner with engineers, data scientists, product managers, customers, and business stakeholders to translate analytical findings into actionable product improvements.
Investigate product funnels, performance trends, and user behavior to identify opportunities for optimization.
Apply SQL, Python, and distributed data systems to process, explore, and analyze large volumes of data.
Contribute analytical expertise across different domains, which may include data science integrations, ranking, recommendations, AI shopping agents, search optimization, personalization, and retail media.
Help teams understand machine learning-related data, including training data quality, model evaluation, and relevant performance metrics.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly, adapting the level of technical detail to different audiences and stakeholders.
Take ownership of analytical projects from problem definition and investigation through to recommendations and measurable outcomes.


Requirements


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated experience using data to address business and product questions.
Solid knowledge of SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets.
Professional experience using Python for data analysis, including tools such as pandas, NumPy, and data visualization libraries.
Good understanding of A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, and core statistical concepts.
Experience defining and analyzing product metrics, metric trees, funnels, and other frameworks for measuring product performance.
Understanding of machine learning pipelines, training data quality, and model evaluation.
Familiarity with search relevance, ranking, or recommendation systems is a plus.
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of projects, and proactively identify opportunities to improve products and processes.
Experience in a customer-facing role is a plus.
Previous experience in e-commerce or product analytics is a plus.


Benefits


Fully remote working environment, giving you flexibility over where you live and work.
Unlimited vacation time, with employees strongly encouraged to take at least 3 weeks per year.
Work-from-home stipend to help you create an effective home-office setup.
Apple laptop provided for new employees.
Annual training and professional development budget.
Maternity and paternity leave for eligible employees.
Opportunity to work with talented and empathetic colleagues while contributing to meaningful, high-impact projects.
Regular team offsite events to connect and collaborate.
Base salary of $80,000–$120,000 USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.
Stock options offered in addition to the base salary.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Talan est un groupe international de conseil et d’expertises technologiques, qui accompagne et accélère la transformation digitale de ses clients par les leviers de la technologie, de la data et de l’innovation.



Depuis plus de 20 ans, Talan conseille et accompagne les entreprises et les institutions publiques dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de leurs projets de transformation et d'innovation en Suisse et à l'international.



Présent sur 5 continents dans 21 pays, le Groupe, certifié Great Place To Work, compte plus de 7000 collaborateurs.



Doté d'un Centre de recherche et d'innovation, Talan met l'innovation au cœur de son développement et intervient dans les domaines des mutations technologiques telles que l'Intelligence Artificielle, la Data Intelligence, la Blockchain, pour servir la croissance des grands groupes et des ETI dans une démarche engagée et responsable.



En plaçant la “Positive Innovation” au cœur de sa stratégie, Talan est convaincu que c’est en étant au service de l’humain que la technologie amplifie son impact sur la société tout entière.



#TalanSuisse





Job Description



Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée, notamment :



Analyser et documenter les données issues de différentes sources et systèmes existants.
Concevoir et faire évoluer les modèles de données : conceptuels, logiques, physiques et dimensionnels.
Participer à des projets de migration et d’intégration de données.
Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des Socles de Données.
Réaliser des analyses exploratoires : profilage, volumétrie, complétude, anomalies, cohérence.
Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles des flux de données : mappings source/cible, règles de transformation et cas limites.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data/Engineering sur la conception et la mise en œuvre des flux.
Produire des analyses, indicateurs et tableaux de bord pour répondre aux besoins métiers.

Maintenir et enrichir le catalogue de données.
Accompagner les utilisateurs et contribuer à la formalisation des besoins.


Qualifications


10 à 15 ans d’expérience minimum dans les domaines Data / BI / Data Analysis.
Expertise en Data Modelling.
Expérience concrète en migration de données.

Capacité à rédiger des spécifications fonctionnelles et à formaliser des règles de transformation.
Bonne compréhension des problématiques de Data Quality.

Capacité à être autonome et force de proposition.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Per conto di un'importante realtà aziendale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una:




BUSINESS INTELLINGENCE ANALYST




La risorsa sarà responsabile della raccolta, analisi e interpretazione dei dati aziendali, trasformandoli in informazioni utili per supportare decisioni operative e strategiche. Collaborerà con diversi dipartimenti aziendali per identificare indicatori chiave, monitorare le performance e promuovere una cultura decisionale basata sui dati.




Principali responsabilità:




Raccogliere, validare e analizzare dati provenienti da fonti interne ed esterne.
Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere dashboard e report periodici per il management e le diverse funzioni aziendali.
Monitorare KPI commerciali, finanziari, operativi e di mercato.
Individuare trend, anomalie, opportunità e aree di miglioramento attraverso l'analisi dei dati.
Collaborare con Finance, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain e IT per comprendere le esigenze informative e definire metriche condivise.
Garantire qualità, coerenza e tracciabilità dei dati utilizzati nei report.
Automatizzare processi di reporting e attività ricorrenti, riducendo tempi operativi e rischi di errore.
Supportare attività di forecasting, pianificazione e analisi ad hoc.
Preparare presentazioni e report destinati al management.
Documentare dataset, logiche di calcolo, fonti dati e definizioni dei KPI.




Requisiti:




Laurea in Economia, Statistica, Data Science, Informatica, Ingegneria Gestionale o discipline affini.
Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruoli di Business Intelligence, Data Analysis, Controlling o funzioni analitiche equivalenti.
Ottima conoscenza di Excel e dei principali strumenti di Data Visualization (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik o similari).
Buona conoscenza di SQL.
La conoscenza di Python o R sarà considerata un plus.
Familiarità con sistemi ERP, CRM e database aziendali.
Capacità di interpretare dati complessi e tradurli in raccomandazioni chiare e orientate al business.
Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese.
Forte capacità di analisi quantitativa.
Approccio strutturato al problem solving.
Precisione e attenzione alla qualità del dato.
Ottime capacità organizzative
Spiccate doti comunicative e relazionali
Capacità di interagire efficacemente con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici
Attitudine al miglioramento continuo e all'innovazione




Cosa offriamo:




Inserimento in un contesto dinamico e orientato ai dati.
Opportunità di contribuire concretamente alle decisioni strategiche aziendali.
Collaborazione trasversale con diverse funzioni aziendali.
Percorso di crescita professionale e sviluppo delle competenze analitiche.

Title: Industrial Data Analyst
Description:
Akkodis, est un acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et de l'IT et un leader dans la smart industrie. Présents dans 30 pays, nos 50 000 experts allient expertise technologique et connaissance sectorielle pour bâtir un avenir durable, portés par une culture d'inclusion et de diversité.

Akkodis est la marque technologique de The Adecco Group (TAG).

Description du poste :

Pour la division Production de notre partenaire, une entreprise renommée, nous recherchons un Analyste de données industrielles (H/F) dont la mission sera de traiter les données relatives à la production.

Vos responsabilités :

Analyse et reporting : Concevoir, automatiser et maintenir des tableaux de bord de suivi de production dans Tableau (suivi des stocks, délais, taux de service, coûts, etc.).
Collecter, nettoyer et structurer les données issues de différentes sources (ERP, WMS, MES, systèmes internes, etc.) via KNIME.
Produire des analyses quantitatives et qualitatives pour soutenir la prise de décision stratégique et opérationnelle.
Identifier les indicateurs de performance (KPI) pertinents et assurer leur cohérence dans le temps.
Mettre en place des modèles prédictifs ou statistiques simples (prévision de la demande, optimisation des stocks, performance transport) via KNIME ou Python/R.

Profil du candidat

Profil recherché :

Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en analyse de données, idéalement dans un environnement industriel, sur des données industrielles.
Bac +5 en Data Analytics, Statistiques, Supply Chain Management, Informatique de gestion ou équivalent.
Une expérience au sein d'une grande entreprise internationale est un atout.

Title: Data Analyst / BI Expert, 80-100%
Description:
Vous êtes formé-e aux sciences informatiques et avez un talent pour faire parler les données ? Rejoignez-nous en tant que Data Analyst, vous serez au cœur de projets innovants et transversaux, porteurs de la transformation numérique de la BCVS.




Concrètement ?

Vos responsabilités vous mèneront à échanger avec les utilisateurs-trices, à analyser leurs besoins et à les soutenir dans la prise en main de nouveaux outils. Votre savoir-faire et votre pédagogie permettront des prises de décisions optimales par les managers. Dans le développement de solutions, vous collaborerez donc aux ateliers de conception avec le métier.
Vous participerez activement aux développements technologiques dans la gestion des données ; en particulier la mise en place des rapports, ainsi que les flux et la plateforme d’analyse de données elle-même. Vous analyserez, modéliserez et créerez les datamarts et les flux ETL ; par ce biais, vous serez une force de proposition dans l’apport de solutions innovantes.
Dans le cadre du cycle de projets, vous assurerez le suivi en production et rédigerez la documentation technique.




Le défi vous tente ?

Ce poste est fait pour vous si…

Vous disposez d’une formation supérieure dans le domaine informatique (EPFL, HES ou équivalent) et disposez de plusieurs années d'expérience à un poste similaire (la connaissance du secteur bancaire serait un atout).
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques, notamment ODI, SAP BO, Power BI ou Databricks, et possédez de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles.
Personne impliquée et proactive, votre métier vous passionne et vous suivez les dernières tendances du secteur.
Votre maîtrise de l’allemand constitue un atout.

Vous souhaitez nous rejoindre ? Nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre candidature.

Pour ce faire, envoyez votre dossier complet à l’adresse : recrutement@bcvs.ch.

Full-time

Description

The Data and Reporting Analyst will be responsible for helping to build and improve the processes that keep the business growing. You’ll be part of a team that enables information which empowers various internal customers, improving the experience for our policyholders.

This is a role for someone interested in growing with us to transform the way the business views itself. You’ll be counted on gathering requirements from stakeholders and ensure that they get what they need to move the business forward with attention to detail.

Berkshire Hathaway biBerk offers a collaborative company culture with outstanding benefits and competitive compensation. Our success is founded on our strong reputation, and we have received an A+ “Superior” grade by the leading independent insurance rating organization. Backed by our ultimate parent company, Berkshire Hathaway Inc., our brand is founded upon trust, service, and innovation. If you’re looking for an employer with integrity and flexibility, keep reading to learn about our benefits and job openings.

Job Responsibilities


Support regulatory / financial / business reporting.
Document Report Requests and Updates.
Profile downstream data to find anomalies and potential data issues
Create SQL scripts for reporting.
Utilize PowerBI / other dashboarding programs


Requirements

Qualifications

We Are Seeking Candidates With The Following


Bachelors w/ 2+ years relevant experience.
Ability to understand data structures / find relationships.
Experience with Visio / Process Flows
Experience with version control systems (Github, Devops, etc)
Experience with Analytics / BI platforms such as PowerBI, Tableau, or Cognos
Collaborate with internal customers and communicate key insights and findings to the appropriate individuals

Passionate about information


About Us

biBerk is where commercial insurance buyers can obtain coverage for their businesses from insurers of the Berkshire Hathaway group of Insurance Companies, one of the best capitalized insurance groups in the world. Our ultimate parent, Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (berkshirehathaway.com) is a holding company with diversified interests in a host of industries, including insurance, energy, transportation and manufacturing. Most policies issued through biBerk.com will be underwritten by Berkshire Hathaway Direct Insurance Company ("BHDIC"), which is an AM Best rated A++ insurer.

BHDIC is domiciled in Omaha, Nebraska. BHDIC and the team at biBerk are focused on helping small business owners quickly and easily buy affordable insurance directly from a financially strong insurance company they can trust.

BHDIC is excited to announce our comprehensive benefits package with some new and enhanced features for 2026 that include:


Medical (PPO/HDHP), vision, disability, and life insurance.
Enhanced dental plan with orthodontia coverage in addition to a standard plan.
Generous PTO plan for all benefit-time eligible employees.
Paid company holidays and 4 floating holidays.
Paid parental leave.
Employee Retirement Savings Plan/401(k) with company match and immediate vesting.
Education Assistance Program that offers 100% upfront tuition reimbursement after 6 months of service for approved degree programs.
Service Recognition Program that provides a monetary award to be used toward a vacation every 5 years of employment.
Wellness Initiatives that include Fitness Center and Weight Watchers Reimbursement programs.
Voluntary benefits that include accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity.
Employee discount and rewards program on travel, tickets, electronics, home, and more.

Final compensation will be based on candidate qualifications, geographic location, and other considerations permitted by law.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the fraud analytics side of a growing user segmentation system.

You’ll analyze behavioral and fraud-related signals to distinguish legitimate users from suspicious activity.

Your work will directly support product decisions, revenue-sharing models, and user verification strategies.

You’ll collaborate closely with product, data, and analytics colleagues to turn insights into practical fraud controls.

Because fraud patterns continuously evolve, you’ll regularly refine detection signals and monitor how effectively segments perform over time.

You’ll also investigate ambiguous cases and identify opportunities to improve review processes and fraud prevention tools.

The role is part of a fast-moving, international environment where analytical thinking and cross-functional collaboration have a direct impact.

Accountabilities


Review and continuously refine fraud signals, adding, removing, and adjusting indicators to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users.
Analyze signals such as IP spoofing, VPN usage, unusual gameplay patterns, and other behavioral indicators to identify potential fraudulent activity.
Own the fraud-related components of the user segmentation system, including defining how signals should be interpreted and monitoring segment performance over time.
Partner with product and data teams to determine appropriate verification approaches for different markets, including facial verification, ID scanning, phone verification, and other methods.
Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases, and identify opportunities to make the review process more efficient and effective.
Identify gaps in available fraud signals and assess third-party tools or solutions that could strengthen the product roadmap.
Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations and operational fraud controls.


Requirements


Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and influence fraud detection or prevention decisions.
Experience designing, refining, or evaluating fraud signals, user segmentation frameworks, detection rules, or review processes.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex or ambiguous user behavior using data.
Understanding of how fraud tactics evolve and an interest in continuously adapting detection approaches accordingly.
Ability to collaborate effectively with product, data, and other cross-functional teams to turn analysis into actionable solutions.
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to investigations.
Ability to communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to participate in meetings, work with documentation, and communicate clearly in a fast-paced international environment.


Benefits


Remote working opportunity within Europe, with Warsaw preferred for collaboration with team members based there.
Opportunity to take ownership of an important fraud analytics function within a growing product area.
Direct exposure to product strategy, user segmentation, fraud prevention, and verification technologies.
Collaboration with experienced product, data, and analytics professionals in an international environment.
Opportunity to influence fraud detection processes and contribute to decisions across multiple markets.
Exposure to evolving fraud patterns, analytical challenges, and emerging verification solutions.
A role where data-driven insights have a direct impact on product and business decisions.

The Senior Data Analytics Consultant will act as a trusted advisor for clients and internal stakeholders, supporting the design and implementation of data-driven solutions that enable effective decision-making and business transformation.

Data Modeling & Data Architecture

Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to define scalable analytics architectures.
Support data governance, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
Ensure consistency, integrity, and sustainability of analytical data platforms.


SQL Development & Data Analysis


Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and database objects.
Perform advanced data analysis and profiling activities.
Conduct data reconciliation and root cause investigations.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives.


Power BI & Business Intelligence

Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, measures, and semantic models.
Implement reporting best practices and governance standards.
Support executive reporting and management dashboards.
Ensure performance optimization and scalability of reporting solutions.

Collaborate with project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables.

Strong expertise in SQL development and relational databases.
Solid experience in conceptual, logical, dimensional, and physical data modeling.
Proven experience designing and developing solutions with Microsoft Power BI.
Strong knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and semantic model design.
Experience interacting directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent English and Italian.

Python for data analysis, automation, and data processing.
Microsoft Fabric.

Data Warehouse architectures.
ETL / ELT frameworks and tools.
Cloud analytics environments.
Banking or Financial Services experience.
Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Regulatory Reporting frameworks.

Exposure to complex Data & Analytics transformation programs.
Meritocratic environment with clear career progression opportunities.
Continuous investment in professional development and certifications.
Dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment.
Participation in the growth of FORFIRM's Data & Analytics practice.

Location: Zurich (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time

Job Summary

eClerx is seeking a Data Analyst to support one of our leading global financial services clients. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy, integrity and governance of critical reference data, including Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes, while supporting data quality remediation initiatives across multiple business functions.

Working closely with global Operations, Technology, Change, and Data teams, you will identify, investigate and resolve data quality issues, maintain documentation, monitor production processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and data accuracy.

Responsibilities


Ensure the accurate population and ongoing maintenance of Legal Entity (LEM) IDs and Industry Codes for in-scope clients.
Develop a strong understanding of the underlying data model and support data quality remediation programmes to resolve identified issues.
Partner with global teams to deliver excellent client service and seamless operational support.
Continuously monitor production processes to identify exceptions, anomalies and potential data quality issues in real time.
Investigate, analyse and resolve data discrepancies across multiple databases, applications and operational systems.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of front-to-back architecture, data remediation methodologies, processes and outcomes.
Collaborate with Technology, Data Owners, Change teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement effective data remediation strategies.
Generate regular and standardised reports covering data quality metrics, remediation activities and progress against data quality objectives.
Support reporting, analytics and management information requirements for key stakeholders.
Identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation and continuous improvement.
Work closely with Change teams to define and implement process improvement initiatives.
Adhere to internal operational controls, procedures and governance standards while ensuring high levels of data quality and accuracy.


Eligibility Requirements


Ideally 1–5 years of experience in Data Management, Reference Data, Operations, Middle Office, Collateral Management or a similar Financial Services environment.
Good understanding of data quality management, data governance and operational processes within financial services.
Previous experience in Operations, Collateral Management or ISDA Documentation would be advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail and a robust control mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly to stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.
Good understanding of front-to-back operational processes and the impact of data across the organisation.
Experience working with global teams in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
Experience using reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Qlik would be highly advantageous.
Ability to work effectively under pressure while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics or a related discipline is preferred.
Fluent in English and/or German.
Swiss work permit or EU passport required.


What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is highly analytical, detail-oriented and proactive, with a strong control mindset and a passion for data quality. The ideal candidate enjoys investigating complex data issues, collaborating with global stakeholders and driving continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining exceptional levels of accuracy.

If you enjoy solving data challenges, improving operational processes and contributing to high-quality service delivery within a global financial services environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Be sure to include any relevant experience that aligns with the role.

Title: RFP Data Analyst
HTML:
Job Description

The RFP Data Analyst is part of LGT Capital Partners’ Product and Client Solutions (PACS) team in Pfäffikon SZ and plays an active role in both the firm's client engagement activities and its data infrastructure. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible.

The role has a strong focus on data analysis within a client servicing and investor relations context. The successful candidate will work with fund, performance, portfolio and firm-level data that supports RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-facing materials. This is a role for someone who enjoys working analytically with data, understands the importance of accuracy in client-facing communication, and is able to translate quantitative inputs into clear, reliable and well-structured content.

The person will also help improve the team’s workflows by using AI and other tools to maintain the knowledge base and strengthen content and data processes. A key expectation is that the person acts as a bridge between the data and the wider PACS team, ensuring that analytical inputs are accurate, consistent and suitable for use in external client and investor communication.

As part of the PACS team, the successful candidate will contribute to data-driven client servicing across the following areas:

  • Take ownership of the analytical inputs used in RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and investor materials, including pulling, cross-checking, analyzing and formatting performance, fund, portfolio and firm-level data from multiple sources;
  • Complete RFP, RFI and DDQ processes from prospective and existing clients across private and public markets, working within stated deadlines;
  • Generate high-quality, tailored responses and continuously improve the firm's standard content library;
  • Collaborate directly with business development, investment management and other internal teams to gather inputs and ensure responses reflect LGT CP's current positioning accurately;
  • Act as the link between client-facing teams and the PACS Data team, translating investor relations and client servicing needs into clear data requirements and helping ensure timely, accurate delivery;
  • Operate as a power user of the firm's RFP platform (Responsive), data workflows and AI-assisted tools, contributing to the continuous improvement of data quality, content maintenance, automation and process efficiency.

Requirements

  • University degree in quantitative finance, finance, business analytics, economics or a related field; CFA, CAIA or an equivalent qualification is a plus;
  • Minimum two years of relevant experience in data analysis, ideally within investor relations, RFP/DDQ, product management, or a related function in asset management;
  • Excellent written English; French, German or other languages an asset;
  • Prior exposure to data workflows or digital tools, with eagerness to develop these skills further;
  • Curiosity and confidence in using AI-assisted tools;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple concurrent deadlines without losing precision and attention to detail;
  • Clear, proactive communicator with the confidence to flag issues and ask clarifying questions across teams;
  • Team-oriented, with a high sense of ownership and follow-through.

What You Can Expect

  • We provide modern working conditions, including work-from-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;
  • A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;
  • We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills;
  • We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;
  • Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family’s long-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;
  • You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners’ investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.

Contact Information

If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.

For further information please contact us.

Cassandra Fritschi

Human Resources

LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon

Title: EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst
Description:
Our Company

JOB DESCRIPTION

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities


EPM OneStream Developer
Business analyst and power user of MI data
Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting
Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management
Take active role in the business performance dialogues
Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process
Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business
Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership


Skills And Experience


Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry
OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert
Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis
Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting
Quick learner, accurate and efficient
Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands
Good communication skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
Fluent in Italian and English


Our Values


Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.
