Title: SAP Business Intelligence & Data Analytics Specialist (m/w/d)
Description:
Ihre Rolle in unserem Team

Als Data Scientist (m/w/d) treiben Sie die datengetriebene Entscheidungsfindung in unserem Unternehmen voran. Sie konzipieren und entwickeln neue Datenprodukte für unseren Servicebereich, insbesondere für ein gruppenweites Reporting. Perspektivisch unterstützen Sie zudem die Organisationsentwicklung durch die Einführung und Nutzung von Process-Mining-Tools zur Prozessanalyse und -optimierung. Darüber hinaus verantworten Sie weitere datenbezogene Entwicklungsinitiativen und liefern mit Ihren Analysen wertvolle Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Ihre Arbeit stärkt eine Kultur des Datendenkens und macht datengesteuerte Services umsetzbar, wodurch Sie einen direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des gesamten Unternehmens haben.

Verantwortlichkeiten



Konzeption und Entwicklung von Datenmodellen auf Basis von SAP Datasphere
Erstellung von Analyse-Dashboards und Reports mit definierten KPIs in der SAP Analytics Cloud sowie Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen
Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Einführung der entwickelten Datenmodelle
Steuerung datengetriebener Projekte und Initiativen als Projekt- oder Programmmanager:in
Aufbau und Einführung eines Process-Mining-Tools für Root-Cause-Analysen



Ihr Profil



Sie haben abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
Sie begeistern sich für Daten, Analysen und Prozesse und besitzen ein ausgeprägtes konzeptionelles Denkvermögen
Sie verfügen über starke technische Fähigkeiten und können komplexe Geschäftsprobleme strukturiert lösen
Sie verstehen den geschäftlichen Kontext und besitzen die Fähigkeit den möglichen Einsatz von Datenanalysen zur Verbesserung von Abläufen zu erkennen
Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse von Methoden und Modellen der Datenanalyse
Sie fühlen sich sicher im Umgang mit großen Datenmengen und haben Erfahrung mit Datenbanken sowie Datenvisualisierungstools
Sie besitzen gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL sowie Erfahrung mit SAP; Kenntnisse in Python sind von Vorteil
Sie sind in der Lage die Erkenntnisse Ihrer Arbeit verständlich, adressatengerecht und überzeugend gegenüber den Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren



Ihre Vorteile



Sie arbeiten in einem internationalen, kollaborativen und angenehmen Arbeitsumfeld
Sinnvolle und herausfordernde Aufgaben in einer schnell wachsenden Branche
Vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur weiteren Entwicklung
Ein Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – vertrauliche Beratung und Unterstützung bei gesundheitlichen, beruflichen und persönlichen Herausforderungen
Attraktives Vergütungspaket
Modernes Büro, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zu Remote Work

Title: SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYTICS & INSIGHTS | INTERNATIONAL APPAREL & LIFESTYLE COMPANY | CENTRAL SWITZERLAND
Description:
We are currently recruiting for a fast-growing international Apparel & Lifestyle Company, looking for a Senior Manager Business Analytics & Insights to strengthen its data-driven decision-making capabilities.




This is a key role for a highly analytical, hands-on, and commercially minded professional who can personally own business-critical analyses and translate data into decisions across Sales, Demand, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, and Customer.

The successful candidate will operate in a D2C and/or omnichannel consumer environment, working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Beyond reporting and dashboarding, the role requires someone who can challenge assumptions, identify business opportunities and risks, and clearly explain the commercial implications of analytical findings.




Key Responsibilities:




Own end-to-end business analyses that directly support decision-making across Sales, Demand Planning, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, and Customer.
Translate complex business questions into structured analytical approaches, independently driving analyses from problem definition through to actionable recommendations.
Analyze business performance across markets, channels, products, categories, and customer segments, identifying key drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.
Develop analytical models to support commercial, pricing, product, demand, inventory, purchasing, and strategic decisions.
Drive and improve demand forecasting methodologies, identifying key drivers and opportunities to increase forecast accuracy.
Analyze inventory performance, product availability, stock levels, sell-through, and working capital, identifying opportunities for inventory optimization and improved purchasing decisions.
Provide Sales, Commercial, and Leadership teams with actionable insights to support revenue growth, profitability, and business planning.
Challenge existing assumptions and business decisions through data, providing fact-based recommendations and alternative perspectives.
Translate analytical findings into clear commercial implications and recommendations for senior stakeholders and Executive Management.
Develop dashboards, KPIs, automated reporting, and scalable analytical tools that improve business visibility and decision-making.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, data quality, analytical methodologies, and the overall use of data across the organization.
Partner closely with Executive Management, Finance, Sales, Product, Marketing, Digital, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Purchasing teams.
Act as a trusted analytical partner to leadership, combining strong technical capabilities with sound commercial judgment.




The Ideal Candidate:

5+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related analytical roles.
Proven experience in a D2C, omnichannel, e-commerce, retail, apparel, consumer goods, or other SKU-intensive consumer business.
Demonstrated track record of personally owning analyses that have directly influenced business decisions, ideally across Sales, Demand, Inventory, and/or Purchasing.
Strong understanding of commercial and operational drivers, with the ability to connect analytical findings to revenue, margin, inventory, availability, and profitability.
Strong hands-on analytical capabilities, with experience in data modelling, forecasting, business performance analysis, and large datasets.
Advanced knowledge of Excel and SQL, combined with experience using Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Ability to work independently from business question to analysis, insight, recommendation, and implementation.
Strong communication skills and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and influence stakeholders through data.
Comfortable presenting complex analyses to senior leadership and Executive Management, clearly explaining the commercial implications and recommended actions.
Proactive, curious, pragmatic, and comfortable operating across multiple business functions in a fast-paced international environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are considered a plus.




What We Offer:

A unique opportunity to shape the analytics function of an ambitious international consumer brand.
Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
A broad cross-functional role spanning Sales, Demand, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, Customer, and Commercial Analytics.
The opportunity to own analyses that have a direct and measurable impact on business decisions.
A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where data plays a central role in driving growth and innovation.
The opportunity to make a tangible impact on the company’s next stage of international expansion.

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a motivated Sales Analyst to join our growing team in the Sales Department. This role is ideal for young individuals who are interested in sustainable energy, data analysis, and commercial development. You will support the sales team by analyzing market trends, customer data, pricing conditions, and sales performance to drive data-backed decision-making.

Main Duties And Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, customer profiles, and market insights.
Conduct thorough research and monitor biofuel market trends, including pricing, supply-demand indicators, regulatory changes, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to support sales planning and forecasting.
Support sales managers with customer quotations, pricing analysis, and contract administrative tasks.
Identify and profile key stakeholders in the biofuel ecosystem, including airlines, aircraft manufacturers, government agencies, and environmental organizations.
Stay updated on biofuel-related regulations, incentives, and policies that may impact the market and customer behavior.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (operations, logistics, finance) to ensure data accuracy and timely information flow.
Prepare and present research findings, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, including management and product development teams.
Assist in developing CRM updates, pipeline tracking, and sales performance metrics.
Participate in ad hoc analysis and projects to support commercial strategy.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, or related disciplines.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret data effectively.
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with data tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, or CRM systems) is an advantage.
Interest in renewable fuel, sustainability principles, or commodities markets is highly preferred.
Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
A passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the aviation sector.
Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship experience is a plus.

Services industriels

Master HES en management/informatique ou formation équivalente
Formation complémentaire en conduite de projets
5 ans d'expérience dans une entreprise de type utilities, dans la gestion d'un système de reporting BI
Bonnes connaissances des solutions BI au sein d'un environnement SAP (SAP IS-U, SAP SD, SAP FI-CA, SAP BW et SAP CRM)
Capacité à travailler en autonomie et à prendre des initiatives, orientation résultats, précision et rigueur
Excellent esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, capacité à piloter ou superviser des projets, créativité et aisance dans la communication
Maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office, de SharePoint et Visio ou produits similaires, ainsi que d'un système de gestion et de traitement des demandes tel que Jira

Title: Business Analyst/Financial Data Engineer
HTML:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Die SNB führt eine Einzelwertschriftenerhebung (Security-by-Security) ein. Im Team Wertschriftendaten helfen Sie bei der Konzeption der Erhebung sowie der Entwicklung von Datenpipelines und Datenanalysen und arbeiten im späteren Betrieb mit.

Ihre Aufgaben

 

  • Erstellung des Datenmodells für granulare Wertschriftendaten sowie Definition der zugehörigen fachlichen Datentransformationsregeln (Anreicherungen, Reconcilliation, Aggregationen usw.);
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung von Datenprozessen zur Bearbeitung und Qualitätskontrolle der erhobenen Daten im engen Austausch mit internen Fachbereichen;
  • Konzeption und Erstellung von Dashboards und Reports zur Visualisierung und Analyse der erhobenen Daten.
Ihr Profil

 

  • Hochschulabschluss (Master) in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften (mit quantitativem Fokus), Finanzmathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang;
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung;
  • Gutes Verständnis von Finanzinstrumenten, insbesondere Wertschriften und deren Datenstrukturen;
  • Mehrjährige Arbeitserfahrung im Datenbereich, inkl. relationale Datenmodelle, Datenarchitektur und Datenanalyse;
  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python oder R, idealerweise Kenntnisse von Spark / SQL;
  • Arbeitserfahrung in interdisziplinären Projekten;
  • Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und hohe Selbstständigkeit;
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englisch- oder Französischkenntnisse.
Unser Angebot

Wir bieten Ihnen eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe im Dienst des Gesamtinteresses der Schweiz - mit spürbarem Beitrag zu Wirtschaft, Bevölkerung und einem stabilen Finanzsystem.

Sie erwarten vielfältige Themen, anspruchsvolle Fragestellungen und die Möglichkeit, mit Ihrer Expertise etwas zu bewegen. Wir leben eine Kultur der Offenheit, des Respekts und des kollegialen Miteinanders. Chancengleichheit, fortschrittliche Rahmenbedingungen und die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben sind für uns selbstverständlich.

Mit gezielter Förderung, zeitgemässen Arbeitsmodellen und einem Umfeld des Vertrauens unterstützen wir Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung.

Title: CDD Premier Emploi - Spécialiste des données - Programme éco21
Description:
CDD 1 an - 80-100%

Nous allons réaliser ensemble

En qualité de Spécialiste des données - Programme éco21, vous contribuerez, via le développement d’outils informatiques, à l’atteinte des objectifs cantonaux de réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre, de la consommation d’électricité ainsi qu’à la préservation des ressources et à la réduction des quantités de déchets du canton. Le Programme éco21 de SIG a pour objectif d’inciter l’ensemble des entreprises, propriétaires immobiliers et collectivités publiques genevoises à mettre en œuvre des actions permettant de réduire les consommations thermiques, électriques et d’eau du canton de Genève, ainsi que de réduire la production de déchets.

Votre énergie au service d’une Genève durable

Dans le cadre de votre fonction, vous serez notamment en charge de :


Caractériser et aiguiller les demandes des responsables de Plans et Solutions éco21 (aiguillage des bugs, tests outils, feedback, besoins en développements);
Formaliser les processus de gestion des incidents;
Accompagner les équipes dans la résolution de leurs problèmes techniques quotidiens et documenter les problématiques rencontrées;
Élaborer des datasets et des dataflows en vue de déployer la BI pour éco21;
Proposer et élaborer des rapports BI pour un meilleur suivi opérationnel.


Votre personnalité et vos compétences

Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de proactivité et de rigueur. Orienté·e résultats, vous avez le sens du service et de la communication et appréciez le travail en équipe. Vous disposez de compétences en développement d’outils informatiques et en résolution de bugs, ainsi que dans la Business Intelligence, la structuration et l’intégrité des bases de données. Une forte capacité analytique et la gestion de projets techniques font également partie de vos atouts. Vous maîtrisez les modélisations en étoile pour la BI et possédez une bonne connaissance en Python ou SQL. La connaissance de Microsoft DevOps et des notions en data translating constituent un plus. Une formation dans le domaine informatique (EPFL) ou équivalent est souhaitée. Dans le cadre de cette fonction, certaines vérifications spécifiques pourront être requises.

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base d’un traitement annuel de référence répartis sur treize salaires, en fonction de votre diplôme :


Bachelor : CHF 75'000.-- brut (base 100 %) répartis sur treize salaires.
Master : CHF 78’000.-- brut (base 100 %) répartis sur treize salaires.
SIG accueille régulièrement des jeunes diplômé·e·s pour leur offrir une première expérience professionnelle significative dans le cadre d'un contrat déterminé d'une année. Il est entendu dans le terme "jeunes diplômé·e·s" des personnes ayant achevé leur cycle d'études dans les 18 derniers mois, en recherche d'une première expérience professionnelle en lien avec leur cursus académique.


Merci de nous adresser une candidature en français.

Rejoindre SIG, c’est participer au changement !

SIG est une entreprise publique de proximité au service de la population, des entreprises et des collectivités publiques genevoises. Elle fournit un large panel de prestations dans la distribution des énergies, de l’eau et de la valorisation des déchets. Elle s'engage, en tant que bras industriel de l'Etat de Genève, en faveur d'une transition écologique ambitieuse.

Soucieuse de promouvoir l’égalité entre femmes et hommes ainsi que la diversité au sein de ses équipes, notre institution encourage les candidatures de toutes et tous, indépendamment de leur genre, de leur origine ou de toute autre caractéristique personnelle.

Dans les domaines où les femmes sont actuellement sous-représentées, les candidatures féminines sont particulièrement encouragées.

Title: Analyste Digital
Description:
Rejoindre Assura, c’est évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif et dynamique où chacun joue un rôle essentiel et contribue à une mission qui fait sens. Chaque jour, nous mettons notre énergie et notre expertise au service de nos clients, pour les accompagner dans leurs décisions de santé. Envie de nous rejoindre ? Alors, nice to meet you!




Analyste Digital – 100%

Lausanne




Au sein de l’équipe Développement et Marketing, tu analyses et optimises les parcours clients du site web, portail client et application mobile. Tu transformes les données en recommandations concrètes et identifies des opportunités d’optimisation pour améliorer l’expérience utilisateur. Tu optimises les campagnes lancées par notre service marketing et tu proposes des ajustements.




Ce que tu fais au quotidien

Tu gères la collecte, la qualité et la gouvernance des données digitales afin de garantir la fiabilité des analyses et des mesures de performance. Tu conçois, implémentes et maintiens les plans de taggage, les solutions de tracking analytics ainsi que les mécanismes de mesure nécessaires au pilotage des activités digitales. Tu assures également l’administration de la plateforme de gestion du consentement (CMP) et veilles à la conformité des dispositifs de collecte de données.




Tu reconstitues et analyses les parcours utilisateurs sur les plateformes web et mobiles afin d’identifier les points de friction et les axes d’amélioration. Tu formules des recommandations pour optimiser l’expérience utilisateur, les parcours clients et les taux de conversion. En parallèle, tu produis et automatises les reportings de performance digitale, marketing et commerciale afin de fournir des indicateurs fiables et pertinents à la prise de décision.




Tu analyses la performance des campagnes d’acquisition et la qualité du trafic généré par les différents canaux marketing. Sur la base des données recueillies, tu identifies les opportunités d’optimisation liées au ciblage, aux messages publicitaires, aux landing pages et aux stratégies d’acquisition afin d’améliorer l’efficacité des actions marketing.




Ce que tu apportes à l’équipe

Tu es au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure (Bachelor ou Master) en data analytics ou dans un domaine équivalent. Tu disposes d’une expérience confirmée de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction similaire, incluant une pratique concrète des outils d’analytics, de tracking et de gestion des données.




Tu maîtrises les outils et méthodologies liés à l’analyse de données et à la mesure de la performance digitale, notamment Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), BigQuery, SQL, R et Looker Studio. Tu possèdes de solides compétences en tracking digital, plans de taggage, data engineering, automatisation des données, reporting et suivi des KPI business. Tu es également à l’aise avec l’analyse de la performance digitale et marketing, l’optimisation des parcours clients (CRO), le SEO Analytics ainsi que les enjeux de gouvernance des données, de gestion du consentement (CMP) et de conformité RGPD/LPD. Tu maitrises les outils d’A/B testing, notamment VWO.




Finalement, tu fais preuve d’un excellent esprit analytique et de synthèse, et d’une forte capacité à résoudre des situations complexes. Orienté(e) business et résultats, tu sais transformer les données en recommandations concrètes et accompagner les parties prenantes grâce à une communication claire.




Tes avantages

Semaine de travail de 40 heures (à 100%)
Minimum 5 semaines de vacances
Possibilité de télétravail
Participation mensuelle aux frais de déplacement si abonnement de transports publics
Prestations sociales attractives et importante réduction sur l’assurance-maladie
Welcome Day et formation interne métier




Date d’entrée : 1er novembre 2026

Taux d’activité : 100%

Title: Marketing Analytics Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
Description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group and a premium brand in global wealth management with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients. In order to strengthen our leading position and shape the future of wealth management, both a comprehensive range of first-class solutions and committed teams behind them are essential. We therefore celebrate and value the individual qualities of our employees, enabling them to be entrepreneurial and empowered to create value beyond wealth.

Brand & Marketing power our firm's short- and long-term success by positioning, promoting and protecting our unique brand. We design intuitive digital user journeys, enhanced by data-driven insights, and produce impactful content through website, publications and social media, showcasing Julius Baer's outstanding investment expertise and offering. Our global client engagement initiatives, backed by unified standards and scalable tools, deliver meaningful experiences and drive measurable business impact.

Within the Digital Channels & Analytics team, we are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist who is passionate about delivering data-driven marketing insights and continuous improvements to our marketing measurement capabilities.

YOUR CHALLENGE

In your role, you will:


Analyse impact-generating customer journeys across public digital touchpoints to identify trends, behavioural patterns, and optimisation opportunities
Monitor and analyse marketing touchpoint and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes
Create recurring reports, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions using Adobe Analytics, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery), and related data sources
Consolidate and integrate data from multiple digital and offline marketing channels to create a holistic view of marketing performance and customer engagement
Translate datasets into business recommendations, tailored to operational teams, marketing stakeholders, and senior leadership
Support data validation and (A/B) testing activities
Partner with stakeholders across internal and external stakeholders to define KPIs, measurement approaches, and reporting requirements
Collaborate closely with the Data Specialist to leverage and continuously enhance data quality, measurement standards, tracking concepts, and analytics capabilities
Serve as the first-level technical support for analytics tools and dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Adobe) within Brand & Marketing


YOUR PROFILE


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field
2-3 years of experience in marketing analytics or a similar analytical role
Experience analysing marketing performance and impact across digital and offline marketing channels
Experience in dashboard development and data visualisation, using Tableau and Power BI
Working knowledge of SQL and experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Adobe Analytics and BigQuery. Python is a plus
Understanding marketing objectives, A/B testing, conversion funnels, customer journey analytics, and marketing performance measurement
Familiarity with AI-powered analytics, automation, and self-service reporting solutions is an advantage
Experience working with Scrum methodology and tools such as Jira
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate data into practical business recommendations
Excellent written and spoken German and English


Mindset & Skills:


Curious and eager to learn new technologies, analytics methodologies, automation approaches, and AI-supported capabilities
Passionate about data, user behaviour, marketing performance, and emerging analytics technologies
Structured and detail-oriented working style with a strong focus on quality and accuracy
Hands-on mentality with the ability to independently drive dashboarding and analytical tasks
Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain analytical findings
Ability to balance technical implementation with business needs and user experience
Strong business acumen and a practical understanding of marketing funnels and performance measurement

Title: Data Oversight & Transformation Lead
Description:
Company Description

At Swissquote, we’re all in.

All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.

We’re Switzerland’s leading digital bank — 1,500+ people across Europe, the Middle East and Asia, building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. From trading and investing to everyday banking, we cover the full picture. We move fast, but we build things we’re genuinely proud of. Have a look behind the scenes by checking Humans of Swissquote on Instagram.

Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can’t offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there’s space for both here.

We’ve ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.

Feeling it? It’s a good start. Apply.

About The Function

Business Risk Management (BRM) is Swissquote’s first-line risk function, overseeing client onboarding, periodic reviews, and ongoing controls throughout the client lifecycle. Operating across Gland and Zurich, BRM works closely with Front Office, Compliance, and Legal to ensure regulatory compliance while supporting business objectives through a pragmatic, risk-based approach.

Job Description

Role Overview

As Data, Oversight & Transformation Lead, you will drive BRM's data and transformation agenda, building the reporting infrastructure and dashboards that give management a complete, real-time view of the department's activity, and turning that data into insight that feeds strategic decision-making. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Risk Management, you will work closely with operational teams to structure and validate the data BRM generates, and with Swissquote's technical teams on strategic projects, including related workflow and automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities


Organize and structure case management data to provide a complete, real-time view of volumes, backlogs, workload, and SLA / productivity across the department.
Build dashboards and reports for management use (e.g., via Tableau or similar tools), turning raw case data into clear, decision-ready views.
Translate management’s reporting and measurement priorities into practical data structures and dashboards.
Analyse processes to identify and implement tactical automation opportunities, working with Swissquote's technical teams on relevant enterprise workflow initiatives.
Act as single point of contact for all dat-related matters, including provision of audit and regulatory-driven data extractions and reporting as needed.


Qualifications


Master's degree in a Quantitative field, Computer Science or Data Science
At least 5 years' experience in a data analytics or reporting role, ideally within financial services or a regulated environment.
Strong hands-on proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI or equivalent)
Strong Excel skills; working knowledge of SQL to query and extract data from case management systems.
Working knowledge of process mapping and low code / no-code workflow automation tools
Ability to translate operational / case data into clear, management-ready dashboards and reports.
Understanding and/ or solid appetite to learn more about Risk & Compliance topics within a Swiss bank
Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, etc.)
Excellent communication skills in English, with French being an asset.


Additional Information

“Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.”

Title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant H/F (Geneva)
Description:
fifty-five is a new kind of data company that helps brands transform with data and AI to improve their marketing operations through a combination of specialized consultancy and technology services.

As the strategic data pillar of The Brandtech Group, we offer services that combine strategy consulting, cloud services, media consulting and customer experience.

We are made up of over +320 digital experts. Digital consultants, tracking and media specialists, engineers and data scientists all work in close collaboration to provide senior-level marketing consultancy and technical support to our clients, in every type of industry, all around the world.

As a partner to advertisers from data collection to activation and exploitation, we help organizations become truly omnichannel entities that control the efficiency of their digital ecosystem and its synergies with the physical world.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

Within the consulting team based in Geneva, you will actively take part in delivering fifty-five's data-led projects to multiple clients. Those projects will be driven by client objectives relating to data collection, customer acquisition, onsite conversion optimisation, media-mix optimisation and digital business consulting. During these projects, you will contribute to promoting a customer-centred vision of digital marketing, based on the systematic and methodical use of data to support decisions. You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.


You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.


You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Based on your good understanding of our projects and our clients' needs, you will collaborate with all our teams to develop fifty-five's offer, both in terms of marketing and in terms of technical and operational delivery.



Responsibilities


Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)


Education and Experience


Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
1 to 3 years experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media

Skills and Interests


Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding
Client-facing skills
Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport

Summary

Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport Convention Center & Hyatt Place Zurich Airport The Circle are just a few steps from the terminals and within The Circle district, an urban location with various shops, restaurants, the iconic Convention Center and an extensive park. The Circle Convention Center is the ideal venue for an international congress, an extravagant reception or a car presentation. As a Revenue Analyst, you will support the hotel’s revenue and profitability goals through pricing, forecasting, market analysis, and inventory management. Support pricing and inventory strategies across market segments and distribution channels.

Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations.
Ensure revenue management practices are aligned with Hyatt standards and business objectives.


Your Profile:


A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Revenue Management, Revenue Analysis, Commercial Analysis, or a similar hospitality role.
Good understanding of hotel performance indicators, including Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, market segmentation, booking pace, and demand trends.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence using reporting and analytical tools.
Fluent English, both written and spoken. German would be considered an advantage.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable turning data into clear business recommendations.


You are a match to the above? Then we look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Automotive Marketing Analyst (Graduate) Global
Description:
About us:

A global leader in audio signal processing, ARKAMYS creates innovative audio software solutions for automotive. Join us in one of our locations in Switzerland, Germany, France, Japan, South Korea, China, India or the United States.




About the role

This is a global role at the intersection of coding, artificial intelligence and marketing. You’ll implement marketing through AI - building the prompts, pipelines and tooling that turn models and data into campaigns, content, insight and personalised customer experiences at scale, across our international markets.

You’ll spend as much time writing Python and designing LLM workflows as you do thinking about product/brand positioning, pricing and customer journeys. Coding and AI fluency are mandatory - they are the core of the job, on a par with marketing expertise. Because the remit spans regions, you’ll work across cultures, time zones and markets, so the ability to operate and communicate seamlessly in a global, English-language environment is essential.




What you’ll do

Code and build AI

Write production-quality Python to automate marketing analytics pipelines, connect to internal data and third-party APIs, and turn one-off analyses into repeatable tools used across regions.
Query and shape data with SQL, and build dashboards and lightweight web interfaces (HTML/CSS/JS) so non-technical colleagues in any market can use what you build.
Engineer prompts and LLM workflows that generate, adapt and localise marketing content for multiple markets and languages, extract insight from customer and review data, and personalise the configurator-to-showroom journey - designing, testing and iterating prompts for accuracy, brand voice and relevance.
Build AI-powered tooling for marketing teams worldwide: retrieval-augmented (RAG) assistants over product, owner and competitor knowledge; automated research and summarisation; creative-asset and copy generation; and customer-insight extraction from unstructured text.




Drive marketing strategy and analytics

Quantify opportunities — market- and segment-sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), demand forecasts and entry cases for new models and geographies.
Optimise marketing investment — recommend how budget is allocated across digital, social, search and dealer co-op spend in each market, accounting for the long automotive consideration cycle and multi-touch attribution.
Price and position — economic-value-to-customer (EVC), break-even, sensitivity and NPV analyses for trims, options and connected-service subscriptions, against competitors region by region.
Grow customer value — CLV / owner equity across the ownership lifecycle (sales, finance, service, renewal, connected services), churn diagnosis, and CRM / loyalty interventions.
Generate consumer and competitive insight — buyer personas, the See–Think–Do–Care journey, competitor benchmarking, and brand-trust and consideration tracking across markets — increasingly powered by the AI tooling you build.
Run statistical and econometric analysis in R and/or Python — marketing-mix and regression modelling (log-log elasticities, adstock / carry-over, channel synergies), with honest validation on hold-out data.




What we’re looking for:




Essential — Coding and AI:

Strong coding ability, especially Python (data, automation, APIs); comfortable with SQL; able to build simple front-ends (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) to ship tools to non-technical users.
Hands-on prompt engineering and applied generative-AI experience — you’ve designed and iterated prompts and built or prototyped LLM-based workflows, and you understand how to evaluate and improve their output.
Statistical and econometric analysis in R and/or Python: regression modelling, hypothesis testing, and data visualisation.




Essential — marketing:

A master’s in Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Strategic Marketing, Business Analytics or a closely related quantitative discipline, plus an undergraduate degree in computer science, information management or another field with a strong quantitative grounding.
Working knowledge of core marketing frameworks — marketing-mix modelling, CLV / customer equity, EVC / value-based pricing, brand equity, and a digital funnel model such as See–Think–Do–Care.
The ability to take an ambiguous commercial question, structure it into an analysis or a tool, and land a defensible recommendation.




Essential — global and language:

Genuine, near-native fluency in English — not only as a working language, but with demonstrated study or professional experience in an English-speaking country. This role is spoken and written in English with international colleagues, and that fluency must be real and tested.
Comfort operating in a global, multicultural environment across time zones, markets and regulatory contexts.
Experience with LLM APIs, vector databases / RAG, agent frameworks, or MLOps; familiarity with version control (Git).




Nice to have:

Experience living, studying or working across multiple countries — international mobility and cross-cultural adaptability are a strong plus in a global role.
A genuine interest in automotive, mobility and connected vehicles.
Exposure to consulting or project-management environments and multi-stakeholder delivery.
Survey design and primary-research experience.
Additional languages beyond English — a meaningful asset across our international markets.




You’ll thrive here if you

Reach for code and AI by default — your instinct is to build the tool, not just write the report.
Are equally credible writing a prompt, debugging a Python pipeline, and defending a pricing recommendation to a director.
Move easily between cultures and markets, and communicate with total fluency in a global, English-language team.
Are sceptical of your own work — you validate models, evaluate AI outputs, and flag weak elasticities, small samples and hallucination risk rather than overselling results.
Care about why people choose, trust and stay loyal to a brand — and about engineering the systems that scale that understanding worldwide.




How to apply

Please send us your CV with a short cover note.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

In dieser neu ausgerichteten Funktion unterstützen Sie die Optimierung und Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Reporting, Business und IT. Der Fokus liegt auf der Weiterentwicklung, Integration und dem Betrieb verschiedener Finanzsysteme sowie der Sicherstellung eines zuverlässigen Datenflusses über die gesamte Systemlandschaft hinweg.

Kundendetails

Unser Kunde ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe mit Sitz in Zug. Verantwortung für das Microsoft Business Central ERP-System inklusive Administration, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Prozessen und Workflows
Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Integration von LucaNet als Konzernkonsolidierungs- und Planungslösung
Sicherstellung der Datenintegration zwischen ERP, CRM, Reporting-, BI- und weiteren Finanzsystemen
Aufbau, Pflege und Überwachung von Datenschnittstellen sowie Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und Konsistenz
Erstellung, Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung von Finanz- und Management-Reports
Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Reporting-, Forecasting- und Controlling-Prozesse
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance, Data Engineering, IT und internationalen Stakeholdern
Unterstützung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen aus Systemsicht
Erstellung von Dokumentationen, Tests sowie Schulungen für Endanwender
Mitarbeit bei Digitalisierungs-, Automatisierungs- und Continuous-Improvement-Initiativen


Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Finance oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
Idealerweise 2 bis 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion im Bereich Finance Systems, Business Analysis, Reporting oder Financial Controlling
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von ERP-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Erfahrung mit Finanz- und Reportingprozessen sowie gutes Verständnis von Bilanz, Erfolgsrechnung und Konzernreporting
Kenntnisse in LucaNet, Power BI oder vergleichbaren Reporting- und Konsolidierungslösungen von Vorteil
Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Bereich Datenaufbereitung, Power Query und Reporting
Hohe Affinität für Systeme, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Prozessautomatisierung

Title: Lead Portfolio and Performance Analytics
Description:
Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a Lead, Portfolio and Performance Analytics in our newly established CUO Office team for Continental Europe.

Reporting directly to the Chief Underwriting Officer (CUO) for Continental Europe, this role offers a unique opportunity to lay the groundwork for a central function that supports portfolio monitoring and sustainable profitability across Sompo’s commercial insurance operations in Continental Europe. As a foundational member of the CUO Office, you will play a pivotal role in shaping its capabilities, focusing on building robust analytical frameworks and performance monitoring tools from the ground up.

This hands-on position requires a proactive and detail-oriented individual who thrives on creating structure and driving meaningful change. While business decisions will remain the responsibility of underwriters, you will serve as a critical voice in influencing underwriting strategies and supporting data-driven decision-making processes. Your contributions will be instrumental in optimizing portfolio performance, enhancing risk management practices, and aligning operations with strategic objectives.

As the CUO Office evolves, this role offers the potential to expand its scope and contributes to the development of a team that will further enhance the organization’s portfolio analytics capabilities. This is an exciting chance to make a lasting impact on the organization’s success and shape the future of portfolio analytics within a dynamic and globally connected environment.

Location: This position will be based preferably out of our Zurich office, but potential candidates might also sit in our other European office locations in Paris, Milan, Cologne or Munich. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environment where our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity

What You’ll Be Doing


Portfolio Performance Analysis: Regularly evaluate underwriting performance, identify trends, and analyze profitability, risk quality, and portfolio composition to drive growth and improvement. Prepare quarterly and ad-hoc performance reviews for leadership.
Underwriting Portfolio Steering: Refine risk appetite, recommend strategies for growth or remediation, support underwriting plans, and monitor execution against targets.
Risk Aggregation & Management: Analyze risk accumulation across perils and geographies, monitor exposure limits, and integrate data into reinsurance and capital modeling.
Catastrophe & Scenario Analysis: Conduct catastrophe loss scenarios, assess tail risks, and support stress testing, capital planning, and reinsurance structuring.
Pricing & Profitability Support: Collaborate with pricing teams to analyze rate adequacy, validate assumptions, and recommend underwriting and renewal actions.
Predictive Analytics: Develop predictive models and leverage advanced analytics to support underwriting automation and decision-making tools.
Reporting & Dashboards: Create executive dashboards, automate underwriting metric reporting, and provide data-driven insights for decision-makers.
Reinsurance Strategy Support: Provide exposure and performance data to inform treaty and facultative decisions and improve retention strategies.
Regulatory & Capital Requirements: Support regulatory filings, collaborate on risk assessments, and align portfolio decisions with capital efficiency.
Innovation & Technology: Pilot AI models, integrate new data sources, and drive digitization of portfolio management processes.


What You’ll Bring

This role requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of commercial insurance, strong analytical capabilities, industry expertise, and a passion for driving innovation to optimize portfolio performance and deliver value to internal and external stakeholders.


Advanced degree in Finance, Actuarial Science, Data Analytics, Risk Management, Business Administration, or a related field
Minimum 5 to 10 years of experience in commercial insurance, with a focus on large corporate industry portfolios.
Strong knowledge of underwriting principles, risk aggregation, catastrophe modeling, and reinsurance structures.
General understanding of insurance product coverages, resulting exposures and their triggering portfolio impacts.
Proficiency in data analytics tools and predictive modeling (Python or R)
Expertise in regulatory compliance (e.g., Solvency II, NAIC), capital modeling, and risk management.
Proven leadership and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and executive management.
Innovative and investigative mindset with experience in leveraging technology, advanced analytics, and digitization for portfolio optimization
Natural curiosity with a drive to uncover insights and understand underlying patterns


Our Benefits

We continuously evaluate and update our benefit programs to ensure that our plans meet the needs of our employees and their dependents. Below are a few highlights of our inclusive benefit programs:


Expansive Health & Wellness Benefits
Generous Retirement & Savings Plans
Global Parental Leave & Adoption Assistance


In today’s world, what do we stand for?

We strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders while maintaining Sompo as an attractive place to work. We foster an environment of ongoing, open dialogue between managers and their direct reports, and believe in an organizational environment where everyone belongs. We proudly are a multi-racial, multi-cultural, global enterprise. We reject all forms of racism, bigotry, prejudice and injustice and continue to invest in building out an inclusive and diverse work environment.

About Us

Expert Partners.

Clarity in complexity.

Unwavering commitment.

We are Sompo, a global provider of property, casualty, and specialty insurance and reinsurance.

Building on Sompo Holding’s 135 years of innovation, we seek to deliver a unified approach to servicing and providing customized solutions for our clients, ensuring that we meet their needs effectively and consistently.

We strive to strengthen engagement with our clients and business partners every day by using the in-depth knowledge and insights of our experts to swiftly navigate the ever-shifting risk landscape in a fast and agile way – providing them with the products and coverages they need – underpinned by exceptional levels of service.

Our values

As we continue to evolve and grow, our core values serve as the foundation for our company’s identity, purpose and culture.


Accountability: Raising the bar on what we deliver
Agility: Keeping it simple as we grow
Collaboration: Building relationships with clients and colleagues
Development: Being curious and having a growth mindset
Integrity: Being trustworthy and doing what’s right


Around the world, our 9,500+ employees use their expertise to learn, improve and find clear answers for your complex challenges. Because when you choose Sompo, you choose the ease of expertise.

Sompo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To learn more about visit our website at www.sompo-intl.com

Title: Sales Analyst
Description:
We are seeking a motivated Sales Analyst to join our growing team in the Sales Department. This role is ideal for young individuals who are interested in sustainable energy, data analysis, and commercial development. You will support the sales team by analyzing market trends, customer data, pricing conditions, and sales performance to drive data-backed decision-making.

Main Duties And Responsibilities


Assist in collecting, organizing, and analyzing sales data, customer profiles, and market insights.
Conduct thorough research and monitor biofuel market trends, including pricing, supply-demand indicators, regulatory changes, and competitor activities.
Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and presentations to support sales planning and forecasting.
Support sales managers with customer quotations, pricing analysis, and contract administrative tasks.
Identify and profile key stakeholders in the biofuel ecosystem, including airlines, aircraft manufacturers, government agencies, and environmental organizations.
Stay updated on biofuel-related regulations, incentives, and policies that may impact the market and customer behavior.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (operations, logistics, finance) to ensure data accuracy and timely information flow.
Prepare and present research findings, insights, and recommendations to internal stakeholders, including management and product development teams.
Assist in developing CRM updates, pipeline tracking, and sales performance metrics.
Participate in ad hoc analysis and projects to support commercial strategy.


Qualifications And Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Environmental Science, Energy Management, or related disciplines.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to interpret data effectively.
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with data tools (e.g., Power BI, SQL, or CRM systems) is an advantage.
Interest in renewable fuel, sustainability principles, or commodities markets is highly preferred.
Good communication skills and ability to present findings clearly.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.
A passion for environmental sustainability and a commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in the aviation sector.
Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship experience is a plus.

Title: SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYTICS & INSIGHTS | INTERNATIONAL APPAREL & LIFESTYLE COMPANY | CENTRAL SWITZERLAND
Description:
We are currently recruiting for a fast-growing international Apparel & Lifestyle Company, looking for a Senior Manager Business Analytics & Insights to strengthen its data-driven decision-making capabilities.




This is a key role for a highly analytical, hands-on, and commercially minded professional who can personally own business-critical analyses and translate data into decisions across Sales, Demand, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, and Customer.

The successful candidate will operate in a D2C and/or omnichannel consumer environment, working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Beyond reporting and dashboarding, the role requires someone who can challenge assumptions, identify business opportunities and risks, and clearly explain the commercial implications of analytical findings.




Key Responsibilities:




Own end-to-end business analyses that directly support decision-making across Sales, Demand Planning, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, and Customer.
Translate complex business questions into structured analytical approaches, independently driving analyses from problem definition through to actionable recommendations.
Analyze business performance across markets, channels, products, categories, and customer segments, identifying key drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.
Develop analytical models to support commercial, pricing, product, demand, inventory, purchasing, and strategic decisions.
Drive and improve demand forecasting methodologies, identifying key drivers and opportunities to increase forecast accuracy.
Analyze inventory performance, product availability, stock levels, sell-through, and working capital, identifying opportunities for inventory optimization and improved purchasing decisions.
Provide Sales, Commercial, and Leadership teams with actionable insights to support revenue growth, profitability, and business planning.
Challenge existing assumptions and business decisions through data, providing fact-based recommendations and alternative perspectives.
Translate analytical findings into clear commercial implications and recommendations for senior stakeholders and Executive Management.
Develop dashboards, KPIs, automated reporting, and scalable analytical tools that improve business visibility and decision-making.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, data quality, analytical methodologies, and the overall use of data across the organization.
Partner closely with Executive Management, Finance, Sales, Product, Marketing, Digital, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Purchasing teams.
Act as a trusted analytical partner to leadership, combining strong technical capabilities with sound commercial judgment.




The Ideal Candidate:

5+ years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related analytical roles.
Proven experience in a D2C, omnichannel, e-commerce, retail, apparel, consumer goods, or other SKU-intensive consumer business.
Demonstrated track record of personally owning analyses that have directly influenced business decisions, ideally across Sales, Demand, Inventory, and/or Purchasing.
Strong understanding of commercial and operational drivers, with the ability to connect analytical findings to revenue, margin, inventory, availability, and profitability.
Strong hands-on analytical capabilities, with experience in data modelling, forecasting, business performance analysis, and large datasets.
Advanced knowledge of Excel and SQL, combined with experience using Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
Ability to work independently from business question to analysis, insight, recommendation, and implementation.
Strong communication skills and the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and influence stakeholders through data.
Comfortable presenting complex analyses to senior leadership and Executive Management, clearly explaining the commercial implications and recommended actions.
Proactive, curious, pragmatic, and comfortable operating across multiple business functions in a fast-paced international environment.
Fluent in English; additional languages are considered a plus.




What We Offer:

A unique opportunity to shape the analytics function of an ambitious international consumer brand.
Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
A broad cross-functional role spanning Sales, Demand, Inventory, Purchasing, Product, Customer, and Commercial Analytics.
The opportunity to own analyses that have a direct and measurable impact on business decisions.
A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where data plays a central role in driving growth and innovation.
The opportunity to make a tangible impact on the company’s next stage of international expansion.

Title: Retail Business Analytics Manager
Description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics


Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.
Provide regular performance analysis by:
Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment
Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.
Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.


KPI Framework & Reporting


Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:
Sales performance
Conversion rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Sales per square meter / selling space
Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.


Demand & Inventory Analytics


Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.
Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.
Provide recommendations for:
Allocation
Replenishment
Stock balancing
Inventory optimization
Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.


Commercial Control & Profitability


Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.
Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.
Evaluate profitability by:
Category
Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique


Assortment & Category Insights


Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.
Analyze:
Product productivity
SKU contribution
Collection performance
Brand performance
Price architecture
Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.
Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.


Inventory Productivity


Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.


Data Management & Tools


Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.
Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions


Your Journey so far


5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.


Your Essentials


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).
Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.
Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.
Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.


You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.


You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)

Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
1 to 3 years experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media

Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written

Title: Junior Financial Systems & Data Analyst (m/w/d) 100%
Description:
In dieser neu ausgerichteten Funktion unterstützen Sie die Optimierung und Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Finance, Reporting, Business und IT. Der Fokus liegt auf der Weiterentwicklung, Integration und dem Betrieb verschiedener Finanzsysteme sowie der Sicherstellung eines zuverlässigen Datenflusses über die gesamte Systemlandschaft hinweg.

Kundendetails

Unser Kunde ist eine international tätige Unternehmensgruppe mit Sitz in Zug. Zur Verstärkung des Finance Teams suchen wir eine analytisch starke und technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, welche die Weiterentwicklung der Finanzsystemlandschaft sowie die Optimierung gruppenweiter Reporting- und Datenprozesse vorantreibt.

Stellenbeschreibung


Verantwortung für das Microsoft Business Central ERP-System inklusive Administration, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Prozessen und Workflows
Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Integration von LucaNet als Konzernkonsolidierungs- und Planungslösung
Sicherstellung der Datenintegration zwischen ERP, CRM, Reporting-, BI- und weiteren Finanzsystemen
Aufbau, Pflege und Überwachung von Datenschnittstellen sowie Sicherstellung der Datenqualität und Konsistenz
Erstellung, Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung von Finanz- und Management-Reports
Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Reporting-, Forecasting- und Controlling-Prozesse
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance, Data Engineering, IT und internationalen Stakeholdern
Unterstützung bei Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen aus Systemsicht
Erstellung von Dokumentationen, Tests sowie Schulungen für Endanwender
Mitarbeit bei Digitalisierungs-, Automatisierungs- und Continuous-Improvement-Initiativen


Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Finance oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
Idealerweise 2 bis 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Funktion im Bereich Finance Systems, Business Analysis, Reporting oder Financial Controlling
Sehr gute Kenntnisse von ERP-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Erfahrung mit Finanz- und Reportingprozessen sowie gutes Verständnis von Bilanz, Erfolgsrechnung und Konzernreporting
Kenntnisse in LucaNet, Power BI oder vergleichbaren Reporting- und Konsolidierungslösungen von Vorteil
Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Bereich Datenaufbereitung, Power Query und Reporting
Hohe Affinität für Systeme, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Prozessautomatisierung
Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Das Angebot

Sie möchten die Zukunft von Finance, Reporting und Datenmanagement aktiv mitgestalten und sich in einer vielseitigen Schnittstellenfunktion weiterentwickeln? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Title: Automotive Marketing Analyst (Graduate) Global
Description:
About us:

A global leader in audio signal processing, ARKAMYS creates innovative audio software solutions for automotive. Join us in one of our locations in Switzerland, Germany, France, Japan, South Korea, China, India or the United States.




About the role

This is a global role at the intersection of coding, artificial intelligence and marketing. You’ll implement marketing through AI - building the prompts, pipelines and tooling that turn models and data into campaigns, content, insight and personalised customer experiences at scale, across our international markets.

You’ll spend as much time writing Python and designing LLM workflows as you do thinking about product/brand positioning, pricing and customer journeys. Coding and AI fluency are mandatory - they are the core of the job, on a par with marketing expertise. Because the remit spans regions, you’ll work across cultures, time zones and markets, so the ability to operate and communicate seamlessly in a global, English-language environment is essential.




What you’ll do

Code and build AI

Write production-quality Python to automate marketing analytics pipelines, connect to internal data and third-party APIs, and turn one-off analyses into repeatable tools used across regions.
Query and shape data with SQL, and build dashboards and lightweight web interfaces (HTML/CSS/JS) so non-technical colleagues in any market can use what you build.
Engineer prompts and LLM workflows that generate, adapt and localise marketing content for multiple markets and languages, extract insight from customer and review data, and personalise the configurator-to-showroom journey - designing, testing and iterating prompts for accuracy, brand voice and relevance.
Build AI-powered tooling for marketing teams worldwide: retrieval-augmented (RAG) assistants over product, owner and competitor knowledge; automated research and summarisation; creative-asset and copy generation; and customer-insight extraction from unstructured text.




Drive marketing strategy and analytics

Quantify opportunities — market- and segment-sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), demand forecasts and entry cases for new models and geographies.
Optimise marketing investment — recommend how budget is allocated across digital, social, search and dealer co-op spend in each market, accounting for the long automotive consideration cycle and multi-touch attribution.
Price and position — economic-value-to-customer (EVC), break-even, sensitivity and NPV analyses for trims, options and connected-service subscriptions, against competitors region by region.
Grow customer value — CLV / owner equity across the ownership lifecycle (sales, finance, service, renewal, connected services), churn diagnosis, and CRM / loyalty interventions.
Generate consumer and competitive insight — buyer personas, the See–Think–Do–Care journey, competitor benchmarking, and brand-trust and consideration tracking across markets — increasingly powered by the AI tooling you build.
Run statistical and econometric analysis in R and/or Python — marketing-mix and regression modelling (log-log elasticities, adstock / carry-over, channel synergies), with honest validation on hold-out data.




What we’re looking for:




Essential — Coding and AI:

Strong coding ability, especially Python (data, automation, APIs); comfortable with SQL; able to build simple front-ends (HTML/CSS/JavaScript) to ship tools to non-technical users.
Hands-on prompt engineering and applied generative-AI experience — you’ve designed and iterated prompts and built or prototyped LLM-based workflows, and you understand how to evaluate and improve their output.
Statistical and econometric analysis in R and/or Python: regression modelling, hypothesis testing, and data visualisation.




Essential — marketing:

A master’s in Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Strategic Marketing, Business Analytics or a closely related quantitative discipline, plus an undergraduate degree in computer science, information management or another field with a strong quantitative grounding.
Working knowledge of core marketing frameworks — marketing-mix modelling, CLV / customer equity, EVC / value-based pricing, brand equity, and a digital funnel model such as See–Think–Do–Care.
The ability to take an ambiguous commercial question, structure it into an analysis or a tool, and land a defensible recommendation.




Essential — global and language:

Genuine, near-native fluency in English — not only as a working language, but with demonstrated study or professional experience in an English-speaking country. This role is spoken and written in English with international colleagues, and that fluency must be real and tested.
Comfort operating in a global, multicultural environment across time zones, markets and regulatory contexts.
Experience with LLM APIs, vector databases / RAG, agent frameworks, or MLOps; familiarity with version control (Git).




Nice to have:

Experience living, studying or working across multiple countries — international mobility and cross-cultural adaptability are a strong plus in a global role.
A genuine interest in automotive, mobility and connected vehicles.
Exposure to consulting or project-management environments and multi-stakeholder delivery.
Survey design and primary-research experience.
Additional languages beyond English — a meaningful asset across our international markets.




You’ll thrive here if you

Reach for code and AI by default — your instinct is to build the tool, not just write the report.
Are equally credible writing a prompt, debugging a Python pipeline, and defending a pricing recommendation to a director.
Move easily between cultures and markets, and communicate with total fluency in a global, English-language team.
Are sceptical of your own work — you validate models, evaluate AI outputs, and flag weak elasticities, small samples and hallucination risk rather than overselling results.
Care about why people choose, trust and stay loyal to a brand — and about engineering the systems that scale that understanding worldwide.




How to apply

Please send us your CV with a short cover note.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Description:
136760 | 70 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid

Möchtest du das Portfolio Management von morgen mitgestalten? Bei uns verwandelst du Daten gemeinsam im Team in echte Erkenntnisse – und entwickelst mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern Lösungen, die unser Geschäft wirklich voranbringen.

Als Underwriting Portfolio Analyst – Motor & Haushalt bist du Teil des Geschäftsbereichs P&C Underwriting im Team Portfolio Management und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Zurich Schweiz aktiv mit. Dabei bringst du deine Fähigkeiten ein, um gemeinsam mit uns aus Daten wertvolle Einblicke zu gewinnen und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Underwriting-Strategien zu unterstützen. Du verbindest analytisches Denken mit deinem Wissen über den Markt und unsere Produkte, um zusammen mit dem Team fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und unser Portfolio optimal zu steuern. Im engen Austausch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus verschiedenen Bereichen gestaltest du strategische Initiativen aktiv mit und trägst so dazu bei, unser Portfolio nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln.

Das erwartet dich


Du bringst deine analytischen Fähigkeiten und dein Wissen über den Markt und Nichtlebensversicherungsprodukte ein, um gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams Lösungen zu entwickeln und das Privatkundenportfolio zu steuern
Du analysierst unser Versicherungsportfolio im Detail und identifizierst im Austausch mit anderen gezielt Optimierungsmöglichkeiten
Du entwickelst und implementierst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Methoden und Tools, die die Portfolio-Analyse und -Optimierung voranbringen
Du unterstützt die Definition und Erstellung von Metriken, KPIs und Dashboards, um die datenbasierte Steuerung der Abteilung im Team zu stärken
Du gewinnst wertvolle Erkenntnisse aus Daten und nutzt diese, um gemeinsam die Underwriting-Strategie weiterzuentwickeln und die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen


Das zeichnet dich aus


Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschafts- oder Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik, Statistik, Data Science oder (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungswirtschaft
Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Nichtlebensversicherungsgeschäft, idealerweise in Portfolioanalyse oder Produktmanagement, sowie tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Werttreiber und Steuerungs-Kennzahlen (KPIs); ergänzende Erfahrung im Underwriting willkommen
Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, hohe Präsentationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen klar zu strukturieren und adressatengerecht für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufzubereiten
Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, grossen Datenmengen und mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z.B. SQL oder Python), Erfahrung in der Aufbereitung von Daten für fundierte Business-Entscheidungen; aktuarielles Wissen von Vorteil
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Laufendes oder abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Statistik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Begeisterung für Daten, Analytics, Automatisierung und künstliche Intelligenz sowie die Fähigkeit, KI-gestützte Tools und Technologien gewinnbringend einzusetzen
