Title: AI Automation & Analytics Specialist
Description:
AI Automation & Analytics Specialist

Zoetis Southern Europe is seeking a results-driven AI Automation & Analytics Specialist to join our Business Analytics team. This role will be responsible for collecting and processing large datasets to uncover valuable insights that drive business decisions. This role involves using ETL tools, statistical methods, Machine Learning and data visualization techniques to interpret complex data and present findings to stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

· Data Engineering & Quality

o Design and maintain automated data pipelines (ETL/ELT) from diverse internal and external sources

o Implement robust data validation, monitoring, and documentation to ensure high data quality and lineage

· Analytics & Modeling

o Apply statistical analysis and machine learning to identify trends, segments, forecasts, and drivers of performance

o Build reproducible analytical assets with clear versioning and governance

· AI

o Leverage AI to automate and improve data analysis, uncovering trends and drivers and embedding insights into workflows

o Identify and deliver high-impact AI use cases, integrating model outputs into workflows and dashboards with clear KPIs and explainability

o Operationalize AI/ML solutions, ensuring Responsible AI practices

o

· Visualization & Insight Communication

o Develop dynamic, user-centric dashboards and reports; optimize and integrate existing assets for clarity and performance

o Translate analytics into concise, business-ready narratives and recommendations for stakeholders

· Performance Management

o Automate target-setting, KPIs, and monitoring workflows

· Collaboration & Stakeholder Enablement

o Partner with Business Units, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Care to deliver data-driven solutions

o Support ad‑hoc deep dives and decision forums with timely, accurate analyses

· Continuous Improvement & Governance

o Identify opportunities to streamline processes, enhance scalability, and enforce data/analytics best practices

o Contribute to data governance, integration, security, and compliance standards

Qualifications

· Bachelor's or Master's in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

· 3-5 years in analytics, BI, or data engineering roles; experience in commercial/retail/pharma or animal health is a plus.

· Proficiency in:

o Databases & languages: SQL, Python or R

o ETL/ELT & orchestration: Azure Data Factory and Knime/Alteryx; building and monitoring production pipelines

o Cloud data platforms: hands-on with Azure SQL and modern analytical stores (cloud data warehouse / lakehouse)

o Dashboards: Power BI; DAX and dashboard performance optimization

o AI & automation: practical experience applying AI/ML to commercial analytics and process automation; ability to translate business needs into scalable AI-enabled solutions, with clear business rationale and appropriate controls

· Strong grasp of statistics and ML fundamentals

· Excellent communication skills; able to convert complex analyses into clear business actions.

· Native Italian, Proficiency in English. Spanish is a plus

· Collaborative mindset, team worker.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Permanent contract

Level B2, Chemical - Pharmaceutical NCBA

Starting salary (annual gross): € 44.446,78 - depending on candidate experience

Variable pay

Local benefit package

At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. We know our people drive our success. Our award-winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. Title: Junior - Artificial Intelligence & Data
Description:
Junior – Artificial Intelligence and Data

Stiamo cercando una figura junior da inserire nel team di Artificial Intelligence and Data di Deloitte Consulting nella sede di Roma/Milano, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid.

Nel Team di Artificial Intelligence & Data avrai l’occasione di aiutare, in ambito Analytics, le aziende a valorizzare i dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee trasformandoli in informazioni accurate e immediatamente utilizzabili, elementi indispensabili per quelle aziende che vogliono fare decision-making fact-driven. La Offering Artificial Intelligence & Data è pertanto l’opzione best in class nell’individuazione, progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni di Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Big Data Management, con un approccio agnostico dal punto di vista tecnologico.

Your Role

La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di:


Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti
Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti
Elaborare teaser e presentazioni per supportare il top management
Individuare potenziali rischi e criticità e condividerli tempestivamente con il resto del team
Collaborare efficacemente in team eterogenei ed internazionali


What We Offer

La retribuzione prevista per la posizione di Analyst è compresa tra EUR 26.500 e EUR 31.000 lordi annui.

In caso di stage, è prevista un’indennità di tirocinio.

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.

La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Winning Requirements


Brillante percorso accademico con laurea specialistica in materie STEM
Familiarità con la modellazione e linguaggio di interrogazione dei data base; conoscenza di uno o più linguaggi di accesso al dato e programmazione (Python, R, Java, SQL); ottima conoscenza degli applicativi MS Word, MS Excel e MS Power Point; nozioni accademiche di modelli statistici per l’analisi dei dati
Forte propensione/interesse per le nuove tecnologie e per l’informatica
Elevata attitudine a lavorare sia autonomamente che in team, capacità analitiche e di problem solving, gestione dello stress, flessibilità, precisione e uno spiccato orientamento al raggiungimento dei risultati
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta, anche all’estero

Impresoft Syscons aiuta i clienti a creare soluzioni digitali su misura, guidandoli attraverso il concetto di Composable Enterprise e a un adattamento rapido alle dinamiche del mercato.

Analisi delle esigenze, del business e dell’infrastruttura dati del cliente
Disegno, sviluppo ed implementazione di soluzioni di Business Intelligence, tramite piattaforma Microsoft Azure
Progettazione e creazione di report e dashboard
Gestione del rapporto tecnico verso il cliente
Ruolo di mentore tecnico verso le risorse junior, in relazione alle tecnologie Microsoft ed alle best practices metodologiche

Laurea o Master in discipline tecnico-scientifiche
Esperienza di almeno 3 anni come Data Analyst e/o Data Engineer
Esperienza su piattaforma MS Azure, inclusi Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse e Data Factory
Esperienza di sviluppo e manutenzione di architetture dati basate su piattaforma MS Azure (Ingestion, ELT, Storage)

Esperienza di disegno, implementazione e manutenzione Pipeline tramite orchestratore MS Data Factory
Esperienza di disegno e implementazione soluzioni DWH su MS Synapse (relational, tabular model)
Conoscenza di base o avanzata di deployment tramite piattaforma DevOps.
Conoscenza base o avanzata di Python / R
Conoscenza base o avanzata in ambiente Data Bricks / Sparks
Competenza base o avanzata su PowerBI e applicazioni integrate Power App
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (B2-C1)
Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office
Ottima attitudine relazionale, approccio orientato al problem solving, capacità di pianificazione e orientamento ai risultati

Inserimento in una realtà giovane, dinamica e in forte crescita
Orario di lavoro ibrido (2 giorni in smart working)
Formazione continua e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning.

Title: Senior Quantitative Analyst
Description:
About Schumacher

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our Competitive Advantage In The Industry Is Our People. We Believe That Our Employees Are Our Most Important Assets. F. Schumacher & Co Is Deeply Anchored In Our Company Core Values Which Are As Follows


Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit
Take Ownership & Accountability
Be Solutions-Oriented
Demonstrate Courage
Practice Adaptability
Embrace Collaboration


We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a 12 month contract and is a part of Data Insights & AI team

Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis.

This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait.

What You’ll Do


Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly
Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift
Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance
Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics
Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders
Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity
Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio


What We're Looking For


2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses
Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying)
A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives
Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner
Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible
Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact
Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data
Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls
Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset


Nice to Have


Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake
Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods


What We Offer


Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience
Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year)
Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions
Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

Title: Fleet Intelligence Analyst
Description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

Ayvens, Società del Gruppo Société Générale, è il nuovo brand globale della mobilità sostenibile, nato dall’unione di ALD Automotive e LeasePlan. L’azienda è uno dei leader globali nei servizi di noleggio a lungo termine e gestione flotte ed offre servizi di noleggio e soluzioni di mobilità integrata a clienti di ogni dimensione, dalle grandi alle piccole e medie aziende, dai professionisti ai privati e alla PA, verso una mobilità a zero emissioni attraverso innovazione e servizi tecnologici d’avanguardia. In Ayvens le Persone fanno la differenza, in un viaggio in cui siamo guidate/i da 4 principi fondamentali che caratterizzano la nostra Cultura: Collaboration, Commitment, Curiosity, Authenticity. Siamo alla ricerca di nuove risorse desiderose di inserirsi in un contesto multinazionale, strutturato, dinamico e inclusivo. Se sei appassionato/a del settore Automotive, Ayvens sta cercando proprio te!

Scopo Della Posizione

Assicurare la produzione di analisi economiche e di fattibilità tecnica nell’ambito di progetti aziendali con particolare riferimento al recupero della profittabiltà.

Tipologia di contratto: contratto a tempo indeterminato

Principali Attività


Contribuire nelle attività di analisi di flotta e termination finalizzate alla proposizione di estensioni e modifica di contratto, di ricalcoli ad hoc e di campagne di upselling.
Confrontarsi proattivamente con il proprio responsabile, attraverso la produzione di reportistiche specifiche, necessarie a monitorare l'andamento degli obiettivi di profittabilità nell’ambito delle campagne di modifiche elaborate (es. Fidelity).
Sviluppare proposte di modifiche contrattuali e campagne commerciali specifiche (ES: programma Fidelity/Campagna upselling) nel rispetto degli obbiettivi in termini di volumi e profit stabiliti da BP.
Fornire le elaborazioni, la validazione e ratifica delle modifiche contrattuali fuori dal perimetro di gestione dei singoli canali commerciali o delle piattaforme di sales support/Backoffice specifiche; in sinergia con tutti gli attori coinvolti, ivi compreso eventuali fornitori esterni, rispettando le regole di modificabilità definite dalla direzione commerciale.
Fornire costante e completa attività di supporto alle aree commerciali per tutte le anomalie inerenti le contract modification, supportando in tempi rapidi e secondo gli SLA di reparto la proposizione di modifiche contrattuali in linea con la strategia aziendale
Adottare un atteggiamento proattivo nei confronti dei rischi, segnalando anomalie e situazioni a rischio, proponendo azioni di mitigazione, rispettando rigorosamente le politiche di Ayvens.


Competenze/conoscenze Soft e Tecnico-specialistiche


Laurea in discipline economiche, scientifiche, statistiche;
Attitudine all'analisi dei dati;
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (rif. livello B2);
Ottima conoscenza di Excel e SAP BO;
Flessibilità e dinamismo;
Spirito di squadra


Inquadramento e Retribuzione


RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda) = fascia 36.000 € – 38.000 €, determinata su criteri oggettivi e neutri sotto il profilo del genere, al netto di welfare e benefits
La posizione prevede un inquadramento nel livello B2 secondo le declaratorie previste dal CCNL Autonoleggio (ANIASA)


Why Ayvens?

With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.

At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

Title: Power BI Specialist
Description:
sedi: Milano, Roma, Bologna, Torino, Padova, Napoli, Firenze, Cagliari




Se sei interessat* ad una formazione approfondita che ti permetta di portare le tue abilità di Business Intelligence ad un altro livello, utilizzare le moderne tecniche di data mining, data visualization e data modeling per fornire ai clienti informazioni strategiche, questa è la posizione in cui potrai veramente fare ciò che conta.

Entra a far parte della nostra squadra!

Nel ruolo di Senior PowerBI Specialist per la role family di Analytics Experience, contribuirai attivamente alla progettazione e realizzazione di piattaforme complesse di BI e reporting, con focus particolare sulla scalabilità ed efficienza della soluzione in contesto Cloud e On Premise.




I clienti si rivolgono a noi per l'innovazione: avrai accesso privilegiato alle più recenti tecnologie Microsoft, incluso Microsoft Fabric, oltre alla possibilità di lavorare con Databricks come strumento di ETL e gestione dei dati, così da padroneggiare le loro richieste e rimanere sempre aggiornato.

Together we do what matter.




Cosa farai:

Disegno e implementazione di modelli dati volti a garantire performance di lettura elevate/on top di tali modelli
Realizzazione di dashboard e reportistica utilizzando Power BI e tool di data visualization (Tableau, Qlik) per estrarre approfondimenti di cui i clienti necessitano
Delineazione di approcci per la governance e implementazione di Power BI, attraverso una consulenza tecnica/strategica per affrontare le sfide aziendali grazie all'analisi dei dati
Generazione di report ad hoc e set di dati per gli utenti finali
Utilizzo di piattaforme dati avanzate come Microsoft Fabric e Databricks per la gestione, modellazione e integrazione dei dati

.

Competenze ed Esperienze

Esperienza comprovata di almeno 2- 3 anni nell’implementazione di soluzioni di data visualization/dashboards/reportistica, con sviluppo di modelli semantici tabulari, utilizzando Power BI (DAX), Power BI Paginated reports, SSAS, SSRS
Competenza maturata su almeno uno dei maggiori Cloud provider (Azure/AWS/GCP), con utilizzo di modelli di servizio in cloud (PaaS, SaaS e IaaS), le principali architetture big data e i processi di ETL in contesti cloud e on-prem
Conoscenza di patterns/best practices nel disegno logico di una soluzione DWH e su store relazionali quali MS SQL
Competenze in ambito Data modeling (3NR, Star schema, Snowflake, Data Vault)
Gradita esperienza nell’utilizzo di piattaforme dati come Microsoft Fabric e Databricks




Il tuo profilo:

Analitico, curioso e appassionato di tecnologia
Team player collaborativo e ottimo comunicatore
Problem-solver, flessibile e orientato alla qualità
Propositivo e proattivo
Mindset innovativo e storyteller convincente
Requisito preferenziale avere certificazioni in ambito Microsoft Azure Data&AI / Power BI
Inglese: B2




Vivi al meglio la tua carriera:

In Avanade troverai un'azienda meritocratica che investe sulla crescita delle persone attraverso percorsi di studio mirati e che prevedono una continua formazione - grazie alle partnership privilegiate con Microsoft e con alcuni dei più importanti player del settore - e il conseguimento di numerose certificazioni.




Retribuzione:

La retribuzione in Avanade varia in base a un’ampia gamma di fattori, tra cui, ad esempio, il ruolo, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze e l’esperienza maturata. Stiamo assumendo per i seguenti livelli contrattuali e qualsiasi offerta sarà allineata alla fascia retributiva in base al livello al quale verrai valutato:

• Livello 2 / 3 Contratto Collettivo Nazionale per i dipendenti da aziende del terziario, distribuzione e servizi: € 28.000 a € 38.000

• Livello 2 /1 Contratto Collettivo Nazionale per i dipendenti da aziende del terziario, distribuzione e servizi: € 34.000 a € 46.000




Il luogo ideale in cui lavorare:

Il nostro ambiente di lavoro è aperto e inclusivo, potrai quindi esprimere le tue idee e lavorare a progetti innovativi attraverso l’ultima tecnologia disponibile sul mercato, confrontarti con migliaia di consulenti in Italia e nel mondo. Inoltre, potrai godere di programmi di flexible e smart-working e di benefit personalizzati in base alle tue esigenze professionali e individuali, che comprendono agevolazioni, servizi e piani di corporate Well-Being. Scopri e dai un'occhiata più da vicino qui!




Ulteriori informazioni:

Per saperne di più, dai un'occhiata ai nostri blog:

• Inclusion & Diversity;

• Avanade Stories;

• Avanade Insights.

Se pensi che questa possa essere l'opportunità giusta per te, come and join us!

Title: Net Revenue Management Specialist
Description:
Life tastes better with ice cream

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.

What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.

We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.

We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.

The role

At The Magnum Ice Cream Company, Revenue Growth Management is a critical capability that helps us drive profitable growth through data-driven pricing, promotion, assortment and trade investment decisions.

The Revenue Growth Management Specialist will play a key role in translating market, customer and performance data into actionable recommendations that improve net revenue, profitability and sustainable growth. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Category teams, you will help shape commercial strategies and deliver insights that influence key business decisions across the Italian Ice Cream business.

What You'll Be Responsible For


Support the development and execution of Revenue Growth Management strategies across pricing, promotions, assortment and mix.
Analyze sales, market and customer data to identify growth opportunities and profitability improvements.
Monitor promotional effectiveness and recommend actions to maximize return on trade investments.
Develop business cases and financial analyses to support pricing and portfolio decisions.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Finance teams to embed RGM principles into commercial planning.
Build dashboards, reports and performance tracking tools to monitor key RGM KPIs.
Support annual planning cycles, forecast reviews and customer business planning processes.
Generate actionable insights from internal and external data sources to support strategic decision-making.
Provide fact-based recommendations and challenge commercial assumptions to improve revenue and profit delivery.


We're Looking For Someone Who


Has 3+ years of experience in Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Finance, Category Management or Business Analytics within FMCG or Consumer Goods.
Brings strong skills in data analysis, financial modelling, pricing analytics and stakeholder management.
Has advanced knowledge of Excel and Power BI; experience with Nielsen Circana or similar market data sources is an advantage.
Demonstrates strong analytical thinking and the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations.
Can translate data into compelling business stories and influence stakeholders across functions.
Thinks end-to-end and takes ownership for results.
Is comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving organisation.
Values collaboration, clarity and low-ego ways of working.


What You'll Get

Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes


Market-competitive pay (Range € 43200, 00 - € 54000,00) depending on
experience and qualifications, plus performance-related rewards
Flexible ways of working
Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
Time off to rest and recharge
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
Meal vouchers


Why join us?

This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.


Roles with real accountability and visible impact
Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
Continuous learning and development as the business grows
Reward linked to performance and contribution.


Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.

Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?

If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.

If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.

Additional Information

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Description:
Application deadline:

Location: Roma 00144, Lazio, Italy

Contract type: Temporary

Job ID: 4026

Role Description

Are you ready to start an exciting career where you can learn, grow, and make a real difference? LEO Pharma is looking for a Business Insight and SFE Specialist to join our team. In this role, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work alongside cross-functional teams, and contribute to impactful projects within a leading pharmaceutical company. This is your chance to embark on your professional journey in a dynamic and innovative environment. Let’s shape the future of healthcare together!

Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines.

In Finance & Commercial Excellence department we share a “challenge accepted” mindset and are guided by our winning behaviours of simplification, collaboration, and accountability, to achieve our goals.

Your role

As a Business Insight and SFE Specialist, you’ll play a key role in supporting the operational and strategic activities of our commercial and business operations functions. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Providing operational support in commercial activities, including key projects and market data analysis.
Collaborating with the sales and marketing teams to monitor performance and help develop action plans to improve outcomes.
Contributing to cross-functional projects by coordinating with different departments to implement innovative and effective solutions.
Analyzing data and insights using advanced tools to provide actionable recommendations for business strategies.
Preparing detailed reports and support materials for management to assist in decision-making processes.
Identifying opportunities for process improvement and presenting ideas to simplify internal operations and enhance efficiency.
Working on internal systems and platforms to upload, download and analyze data.


Your Qualifications

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

A degree in Economics, Management Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related fields.
Proficiency in MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent knowledge of English, both written and spoken.


LEO Pharma is built on collaboration, innovation and curiosity. Is this you? Can you bring this and strong analytical abilities, attention to detail, and organizational skills to help drive meaningful impact and contribute to our mission?

Your new team

At LEO Pharma, you’ll join a team of passionate and experienced professionals who are dedicated to shaping the future of healthcare. As a Business Insight and SFE Specialist, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on meaningful projects, work alongside talented colleagues, and gain hands-on experience in a global organization that’s committed to making a difference. Our inclusive and innovative culture ensures you’ll feel supported and inspired every step of the way.

Your application

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

The annual gross base salary for new hires in this role ranges from EUR 30.000 to EUR 35.000. This range has been established by considering multiple factors such as the candidate’s experience, educational background, unique skill set, and the market value for the position. Employment for this position is governed by the CCNL Chimico Farmaceutico.

More detailed information about the full compensation and benefits package will be shared during the recruitment process.

Compensation is offered within the established range and is calculated based on the candidate’s skills, professional background, and level of expertise. The higher end of the range is typically allocated to individuals with substantial experience or outstanding qualifications that meet the specific demands of the role.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Title: Fraud Analyst
HTML:
Fraud Analyst


Alfa Group è una tech company italiana attiva dal 1996, specializzata in soluzioni innovative per la Cybersecurity, la prevenzione delle frodi digitali e la gestione dei processi.

Con tecnologie proprietarie e un approccio integrato che combina persone, dati e processi, Alfa Group supporta oltre 120 istituti finanziari, monitora circa 23 milioni di utenti digitali e mette in sicurezza più di 450.000 asset IT attraverso i servizi di Cyber Exposure Management.

Attraverso il servizio gestito N.O.V.A. e la tecnologia proprietaria RHD per la gestione dei processi, l’azienda sfrutta l’Intelligenza Artificiale per la governance dei rischi di frode e cyber. Il team opera attualmente da Roma, Milano, Bologna, Porto San Giorgio, Cagliari, Londra e Amersfoort.

Alfa Group. Where Expertise Meets Innovation.


La posizione:

Il candidato sarà introdotto in un training on the job che lo porterà alla piena autonomia operativa sia per quanto riguarda i contenuti tecnologici che la capacità di analisi degli scenari e formulazione di soluzioni di contrasto alle frodi.


Principali attività:

  • Supporto nella raccolta e analisi di dati per identificare schemi fraudolenti. (Fraud Prevention);
  • Analisi di transazioni e comportamenti sospetti. (Fraud detection);
  • Monitoraggio e supporto alla configurazione dei sistemi di analisi comportamentale dei clienti (Policy management);
  • Gestione, manutenzione e monitoraggio del corretto comportamento dei sistemi di Machine learning dedicati al contrasto delle frodi. (Application Management);
  • testing degli aggiornamenti dei sistemi antifrode.


Requisiti:

  • Percorso di studi in ambito informatico, perito informatico, statistico o similare;
  • Conoscenza di: linguaggio Sql, sistema operativo Linux e Windows.


Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza acquisita in almeno uno dei seguenti ambiti:

  • analisi dati;
  • analisi comportamentale;
  • machine learning;
  • gestione dei pagamenti elettronici;
  • Cyber Threat intelligence.


Completano il profilo le seguenti competenze trasversali:

  • Pensiero critico e capacità di problem solving;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese;
  • Buone doti di pianificazione e organizzazione;
  • Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali.


Sede di lavoro: Roma


Sono possibili brevi trasferte presso le altre sedi del Cliente e del Gruppo.

Title: Advisory (Senior) Analyst, Italian Power Markets
Description:
Department: Advisory

Location: Rome, Italy



Description

Joining our Rome advisory team, you will contribute to the firm developing analysis and conveying insights to enhance clients’ decision making. You will play an active role in all aspects of client engagement: helping identify issues, forming hypotheses, conducting analysis, and synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. In doing so, you will help to guide utilities, investors, and government through the fundamental transition European power markets are facing.

The successful applicant will combine strong quantitative ability with a track record of performance in team-oriented environments. You will work in a dynamic, intellectually stimulating, and demanding yet supportive environment. You will enjoy autonomy, the opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector, and to grow into an industry expert under the guidance of directors with deep experience addressing major strategic issues at the world’s leading advisory firms.

The position suits a recent graduate of a bachelor’s or master’s programme. Exact entry position will be dependent on experience and educational level. international expansion and creating new data and software-based solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Develop timely and rigorous quantitative analyses to enhance clients’ decision making
Work closely with our modelling team, structuring economic problems into quantifiable analyses and deriving insights from the model results
Contribute to Aurora’s product development, by identifying new opportunities and expanding our capabilities
Engage with clients to thoroughly understand their requirements
Communicate findings to clients, turning analysis to insight by creating compelling presentations


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required attributes:
A university degree in either:
- a quantitative subject, coupled with a keen interest in policy developments
- a social science, environmental studies or a related field, coupled with an interest in quantitative analysis
An ability to collect, analyse and interpret complex quantitative data and information
An ability to communicate and collaborate with both technical and non-technical parties
Evidence of strong performance in team-oriented environments
Proficiency (C1 level) in English and Italian
Desirable attributes:
Demonstrated success in project management (e.g. at university) preferred
Strong interest in energy markets, previous professional or academic exposure to energy beneficial
Proficiency (C1 level) in one additional European language
Highly desirable to be fluent in a third language


What we offer

Some of the benefits we include are:
Meal Vouchers
Private medical insurance
Commuting allowance
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
At AER, we are committed to offering flexibility in the way we work. Most of our roles are hybrid with a mix of in-office/home working and potentially adjustable working hours. Let’s discuss what works for you and AER during the interview process.

The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity.

To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.

Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

Title: Workforce Specialist
Description:
Hai esperienza nell’analisi dei dati e desideri mettere le tue competenze al servizio di un contesto dinamico, contribuendo alla raccolta, analisi e documentazione dei requisiti funzionali?

Potresti essere la persona che stiamo cercando.

Entrerai a far parte della nostra Area Operations, nel Team di Centrale Operativa, occupandoti di analizzare e prevedere i volumi di lavoro, supportando la pianificazione e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse necessarie al raggiungimento dei KPI aziendali.

In qualità di Workforce Specialist contribuirai alla gestione e all’analisi dei dati, alla predisposizione di report e dashboard e al monitoraggio della copertura del personale, adattando la pianificazione in funzione delle esigenze operative.

Cosa farai davvero

Identificherai gli obiettivi dell'analisi dei dati con il Management

Raccoglierai i dati da fonti interne ed esterne

Organizzerai e strutturerai dati

Analizzerai i dati e individuerai schemi e trend

Creerai report e documenti con i risultati delle analisi da presentare ai responsabili

Rileverai e correggerai eventuali errori nei sistemi di raccolta e conservazione dei dati

Preparerai e produrrai report e dashboard di previsione sul volume del lavoro atteso per determinare i livelli del personale necessario al raggiungimento dei Kpi aziendali e produrre la turnistica relativa.

Verificherai e adatterai le previsioni prodotte per garantire\ottimizzare in tempo reale la copertura del personale nei casi di absence (ferie, malattia, formazione, ecc.).

Quali Conoscenze Ed Esperienze Cerchiamo

Conoscenza avanzata di MS Excel e Power Point

Conoscenza di strumenti e processi di Business Intelligence e Workforce Management

Capacità organizzative

Attenzione ai dettagli

Capacità di problem solving

Proattività, Passione e Creatività

Chi Stiamo Cercando

Una persona con esperienza nell’analisi dati, dotata di precisione, accuratezza e ottime capacità di analisi e organizzazione.

Una persona orientata al problem solving e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi, capace di lavorare con attenzione, precisione e spirito di collaborazione.

Completano il profilo: un’ottima gestione dello stress, flessibilità, orientamento al risultato e al cliente interno.

Cosa Troverai

Un percorso di onboarding, induction training e affiancamento continuo, pensato per supportare il tuo inserimento e la tua crescita professionale

Inquadramento: 3 livello CCNL Istituti di Vigilanza Privata

Title: Forward Deployed Data Scientist (On-site)
Description:
About Translated

Translated is a leading provider of AI-powered language solutions. Founded in 1999 by a linguist and a computer scientist, we are on a mission to allow everyone to understand and be understood in their own language.

We envision a world where people from different cultures can communicate seamlessly, gaining unprecedented access to knowledge, cultural exchange, and opportunity. To make this possible, we combine proprietary translation AI (Lara Translate) with advanced text, audio, and video translation technologies (Matecat, Matesub, and Matedub) and the world’s largest network of vetted, native-speaking language professionals.

We welcome complex technical challenges from our customers and engineer tailored solutions that often become part of our core products, whether integrated into our enterprise localization platform, the tools designed to support translators, or Lara Translate, our online AI translator for teams and individuals.

Everything we build reflects a simple principle: technology should amplify human potential, not replace it.

We believe in humans.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Scientist to work closely with our customers, product teams, and leadership, transforming complex business challenges into data-driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with business acumen and the ability to work directly with stakeholders. You will investigate customer and product data, develop analyses and models, and help deploy solutions that generate measurable business impact.

The Role: Forward Deployed Data Science

Forward Deployed Data Scientists operate at the intersection of data science, product, engineering, and customer success.

You will collaborate directly with Translated’s enterprise customers and internal teams to understand their objectives, investigate their data, identify opportunities, and develop solutions tailored to their operational needs. These solutions may include analytical models, forecasting systems, performance metrics, experiments, dashboards, and data products.

Rather than working only on predefined datasets or isolated research questions, you will follow projects through their complete lifecycle: from problem definition and data discovery to implementation, validation, deployment, and communication of results.

You will gradually develop a deep understanding of Translated’s business, products, and technology, working across areas such as translation quality, operational efficiency, customer behavior, demand forecasting, marketing performance, and financial outcomes.

Successful projects may become reusable capabilities integrated into Translated’s products, enterprise platform, or internal decision-making systems.

Responsibilities


Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into well-defined data problems
Identify, access, and evaluate relevant internal and external data sources
Conduct initial data investigations and exploratory data analysis
Develop metrics, statistical analyses, machine learning models, and other data-driven solutions
Design experiments and measurement frameworks to evaluate product and business initiatives
Analyze customer behavior, operational performance, translation quality, revenue, costs, and other key business indicators
Build prototypes and collaborate with engineering teams to turn successful analyses into reliable production solutions
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that make complex findings accessible and actionable
Present recommendations and results clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and customers
Define success criteria, measure outcomes, and continuously improve deployed solutions
Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, AI researchers, sales teams, and customer-facing teams
Help develop reusable analytical methods, tools, and best practices across the company
Stay informed about developments in data science, machine learning, analytics, and applied AI


Requirements


3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Applied Machine Learning, or a related quantitative role
Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, and experimental design
Excellent programming skills in Python
Strong experience with SQL and working with large, complex datasets
Experience with data exploration, statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation
Ability to transform ambiguous business questions into structured, measurable analytical problems
Experience defining business and product metrics and using data to support decision-making
Familiarity with modern data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytical workflows
Experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool, such as Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or a similar platform
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach
Ability to manage projects involving multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements
Excellent written and spoken English
BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or another relevant quantitative field


Bonus Points If…


You have worked in a customer-facing, consulting, solutions engineering, or forward deployed role
You have experience taking data science projects from initial discovery through deployment and business adoption
You have worked with enterprise customers and complex operational processes
You have experience with AWS and data technologies such as S3, Redshift, Redis, Spark, or similar systems
You have experience with distributed data processing or large-scale computing tools
You have worked with product analytics, forecasting, optimization, experimentation, or causal inference
You have experience analyzing data from third-party platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, or other marketing and product systems
You understand business metrics and channels such as revenue, gross margin, retention, conversion, SEO, SEM, paid acquisition, and mobile applications
You have experience building dashboards and presenting insights to senior stakeholders or customers
You have experience with NLP, Large Language Models, or multilingual technologies
You have worked with data quality, monitoring, model observability, or production machine learning systems


Headquarter

Translated is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature where six luxury villas in Rome, Italy, have been converted into functional offices designed to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.

Our Offer

Depending on expertise, the offered salary typically ranges between €40,000 and €60,000. Compensation generally grows quickly as experience leads to greater contributions. Exceptionally strong candidates may be offered salaries above this range to acknowledge their higher potential impact.

We offer a flexible remote work policy, combined with a requirement for periodic presence at our Rome headquarters.

Benefits and Perks

At Translated, we see our people as athletes, and Pi Campus as the place where they can reach their full potential. This vibrant environment fosters talent aggregation and continuous growth of mind, body, and spirit.

We nurture and support the team’s personal and professional development every day through growth-oriented initiatives like personalized learning paths and networking events with industry leaders, health-oriented initiatives like massages, sauna, and workouts in our gym and swimming pool, as well as relaxation rooms, open meeting rooms, a cafeteria, and fully equipped kitchens in every villa. In case of need, every team member has access to psychological, legal, and financial support.

Learn more about our company: https://translated.com/work-at-translated-onboarding.

Application Process

We will conduct an initial screening based on the information you provide about yourself and your experience.

If the screening is successful, we will send you a practical case study designed to assess how you approach an applied data problem. The exercise should require no more than one working day, and you will have one week to complete it. We may also arrange a call beforehand to answer questions and provide additional context.

Once submitted, we will review your work and provide feedback. Successful candidates will then be invited to an interview to discuss the exercise, their technical approach, and their experience working with data and stakeholders.

If everything goes well, we will make you an offer to join our team.

Diversity Statement

At Translated, we proudly embrace and celebrate the unique qualities each individual brings to our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other difference.

We recognize that diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported in reaching their full potential.

You will collaborate directly with Translated’s enterprise customers and internal teams to understand their objectives, investigate their data, identify opportunities, and develop solutions tailored to their operational needs. These solutions may include analytical models, forecasting systems, performance metrics, experiments, dashboards, and data products.

Rather than working only on predefined datasets or isolated research questions, you will follow projects through their complete lifecycle: from problem definition and data discovery to implementation, validation, deployment, and communication of results.

You will gradually develop a deep understanding of Translated’s business, products, and technology, working across areas such as translation quality, operational efficiency, customer behavior, demand forecasting, marketing performance, and financial outcomes.

Successful projects may become reusable capabilities integrated into Translated’s products, enterprise platform, or internal decision-making systems.


Responsibilities

  • Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into well-defined data problems.
  • Identify, access, and evaluate relevant internal and external data sources.
  • Conduct initial data investigations and exploratory data analysis.
  • Develop metrics, statistical analyses, machine learning models, and other data-driven solutions.
  • Design experiments and measurement frameworks to evaluate product and business initiatives.
  • Analyze customer behavior, operational performance, translation quality, revenue, costs, and other key business indicators.
  • Build prototypes and collaborate with engineering teams to turn successful analyses into reliable production solutions.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that make complex findings accessible and actionable.
  • Present recommendations and results clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and customers.
  • Define success criteria, measure outcomes, and continuously improve deployed solutions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, AI researchers, sales teams, and customer-facing teams.
  • Help develop reusable analytical methods, tools, and best practices across the company.
  • Stay informed about developments in data science, machine learning, analytics, and applied AI.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Applied Machine Learning, or a related quantitative role.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, and experimental design.
  • Excellent programming skills in Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL and working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with data exploration, statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation.
  • Ability to transform ambiguous business questions into structured, measurable analytical problems.
  • Experience defining business and product metrics and using data to support decision-making.
  • Familiarity with modern data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytical workflows.
  • Experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool, such as Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or a similar platform.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
  • Ability to manage projects involving multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or another relevant quantitative field.


Bonus Points If…

  • You have worked in a customer-facing, consulting, solutions engineering, or forward deployed role.
  • You have experience taking data science projects from initial discovery through deployment and business adoption.
  • You have worked with enterprise customers and complex operational processes.
  • You have experience with AWS and data technologies such as S3, Redshift, Redis, Spark, or similar systems.
  • You have experience with distributed data processing or large-scale computing tools.
  • You have worked with product analytics, forecasting, optimization, experimentation, or causal inference.
  • You have experience analyzing data from third-party platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, or other marketing and product systems.
  • You understand business metrics and channels such as revenue, gross margin, retention, conversion, SEO, SEM, paid acquisition, and mobile applications.
  • You have experience building dashboards and presenting insights to senior stakeholders or customers.
  • You have experience with NLP, Large Language Models, or multilingual technologies.
  • You have worked with data quality, monitoring, model observability, or production machine learning systems.


Headquarter

Translated is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature where six luxury villas in Rome, Italy, have been converted into functional offices designed to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.


Our Offer

Depending on expertise, the offered salary typically ranges between €40,000 and €60,000. Compensation generally grows quickly as experience leads to greater contributions. Exceptionally strong candidates may be offered salaries above this range to acknowledge their higher potential impact.

We offer a flexible remote work policy, combined with a requirement for periodic presence at our Rome headquarters.


Benefits and Perks

At Translated, we see our people as athletes, and Pi Campus as the place where they can reach their full potential. This vibrant environment fosters talent aggregation and continuous growth of mind, body, and spirit.

We nurture and support the team’s personal and professional development every day through growth-oriented initiatives like personalized learning paths and networking events with industry leaders, health-oriented initiatives like massages, sauna, and workouts in our gym and swimming pool, as well as relaxation rooms, open meeting rooms, a cafeteria, and fully equipped kitchens in every villa. In case of need, every team member has access to psychological, legal, and financial support.

Learn more about our company: https://translated.com/work-at-translated-onboarding.


Application Process

We will conduct an initial screening based on the information you provide about yourself and your experience.

If the screening is successful, we will send you a practical case study designed to assess how you approach an applied data problem. The exercise should require no more than one working day, and you will have one week to complete it. We may also arrange a call beforehand to answer questions and provide additional context.

Once submitted, we will review your work and provide feedback. Successful candidates will then be invited to an interview to discuss the exercise, their technical approach, and their experience working with data and stakeholders.

If everything goes well, we will make you an offer to join our team.


Diversity Statement

At Translated, we proudly embrace and celebrate the unique qualities each individual brings to our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other difference.

We recognize that diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported in reaching their full potential.

Title: Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist
Description:
POSITION SNAPSHOT

JobReq ID: 55578

Type of work: Hybrid

Type of contract: Open-ended/permanent

Full/Part Time: Full time

Salary Range:

Location:

ROMA, IT Zaventem, BE

About Us

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, and Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA), headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, operate collectively as a “Bridgestone West” strategic region. This region services the strategic business needs of teams across the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa. BSAM and BSEMEA are subsidiaries of Bridgestone Corporation, globally headquartered in Japan. Bridgestone and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market a wide range of Bridgestone, Firestone and associate brand products and solutions to address the needs of a broad range of customers and industries.

About The Role

Job Purpose

As part of the Procurement Operations, Digitalization & Strategic Excellence team, the Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining the data foundations that enable modern, data-driven procurement operations.

The role ensures procurement data is accurate, reliable, governed, and accessible in real time to support operational excellence, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with procurement, IT, data engineering, and business stakeholders, the specialist will transform procurement data into a strategic asset that drives better decision-making and continuous improvement

Also, Bridgestone Europe is embedding AI across multiple ERP (mostly SAP - S/4HANA, BDC) landscapes and platforms. Within Procurement, this role delivers the data products that make those use cases possible: clearly defined, properly modelled, documented, and trusted.

Responsibilities

Data Governance & Stewardship



Act as the Procurement Data Steward for master and transactional procurement data.
Define, implement and continuously improve procurement data standards, governance and quality rules.
Monitor data quality KPIs and drive corrective actions with business and IT teams.
Ensure data consistency across SAP and connected procurement applications.



Data Foundation & Architecture



Data Attribute Definition: Define and document data attributes, business rules, calculation logic, and field-level definitions for all procurement data products — spend, suppliers, contracts, and purchasing KPIs.
Collaborate with IT and Data Platform teams to ensure procurement data is available, secure and scalable.
Support the integration of SAP data with enterprise data platforms and analytical environments.
Contribute to the evolution of procurement data architecture.
Source-to-Target Validation: mappings from SAP S/4HANA and various data sources into SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks, ensuring data flows correctly and completely.



Analytics & Business Intelligence



Develop and maintain procurement dashboards, KPIs and self-service reporting solutions.
Translate business requirements into actionable reporting and analytics.
Support procurement category managers and leadership with insightful data analysis.
Promote data-driven decision making throughout the procurement organization.



AI Enablement



Ensure procurement data is AI-ready by improving its quality, structure and accessibility.
Support the deployment of AI and Generative AI use cases within procurement.
Partner with Digital and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and predictive analytics.



Qualifications & Experience Required

Education, Master, other certification:



Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
SAP certifications or proven experience in S/4HANA, BTP, Datasphere / Business Data Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, or hyperscaler data platforms are a strong advantage.
Training in data modelling, data governance, or AI and machine learning fundamentals is a plus.



Experience (years):



3-5 years in a data, analytics, procurement operations, or procurement technology role.
SAP is essential: hands-on experience with S/4HANA procurement data structures, plus exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BTP, and SAP Business AI.
Proven end-to-end delivery of data products, from definition to production, not one-off extracts.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Python, and SQL within a lakehouse or cloud data platform.
Experience with integration and harmonisation of data across multiple or heterogeneous ERP systems.
Experience preparing and governing data for AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics use cases.
International, multi-country transformation programmes are a plus.



Technical Skills:



SAP S/4HANA procurement data objects and master data: vendor, material, info records, source lists, contracts, purchase orders.
SAP Business Data Cloud: data products, spaces, replication, consumption models; awareness of SAP Business AI, Joule, and AI Foundation on SAP BTP.
Data modelling: relational and dimensional, semantic layers, canonical cross-system models, master data harmonisation.
SQL and Python, including pandas and PySpark, for transformation, analysis, and automation.
Databricks: notebooks, Delta Lake, workflows.
Common data technologies beyond SAP: cloud data warehouses, ETL/ELT and orchestration, APIs, event-based integration.
Architectural design at comprehension level: layering, lakehouse versus warehouse, batch versus real-time, and related trade-offs.
Data governance: lineage, cataloguing, data contracts, and quality frameworks.
SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Tableau; advanced Excel and PowerPoint.



Languages Skills:



Fluent English, written and spoken.
Additional European languages are a plus.



Soft/Behavioral Skills:



Structured and precise, with rigour on definitions and documentation.
Systems thinking: connects business process, data structure, and technology.
Explains data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Turns ambiguous business needs into scoped, deliverable data requirements.
Curious about emerging data and AI technologies; comfortable with change and ambiguity.
Strong ownership across multiple stakeholders and parallel deliverables.



Salary range: € 37,601.10 - 54,000

The salary range is based on gender-neutral criteria: applicable CCNL requirements, responsibilities, working conditions and market benchmarks for the role and location. Final compensation will be determined based on gender-neutral criteria: experience, skills, and internal equity.

What We Offer

At Bridgestone, what really matter is to foster co-creation opportunities and empowering you to be creative and curious to make mobility safer, more efficient, and more sustainable for future generations. Whatever role you fill, when you represent Bridgestone, you are a valued teammate, and part of our larger mission to “Serve Society with Superior Quality”, for that, we offer you more than just a competitive payment; we will provide you:



A supportive and engaging onboarding experience to ensure a smooth transition into our team.
The opportunity to develop and grow, through training and regular mentorship.
Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
A truly global, dynamic and challenging work environment.
Agility and work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being.
A diverse and inclusive team.



We are committed to create an even more inclusive culture that advances equity, embraces individuality, and helps our increasingly diverse teammates, customers, and communities thrive, by providing equal opportunities in employment. This means that all job applicants and members of staff will receive equal treatment and that we will not discriminate on grounds of gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, color, nationality, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, religion or age.

Title: Brand Marketing Insights
Description:
Posizione

Mission

Within the Brand Marketing department, the candidate will work closely with the Project Management and Research & Insights teams to assess the effectiveness of global marketing and retail initiatives, support project brief development and implementation, and translate market and competitive insights into clear, actionable recommendations aimed at strengthening brand desirability and business performance.

Responsabilità del lavoro

Main Accountabilities

Post-Project Insights and Analysis:


Evaluate the performance of key brand activations, including global campaigns, product launches and events, by synthesizing qualitative and quantitative data into comprehensive post-project reports and actionable recommendations to optimize future marketing strategies and maximize ROI.
Monitor ongoing KPIs for key projects, ensuring timely sharing of relevant insights with Brand Marketing, Project Managers and senior management.


Project Planning


Contribute actively to project brief development and KPI definition.
Ensure consistent alignment and sharing of key project information, updates and timelines within and beyond the team, supporting cross-functional coordination and operational efficiency.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders on the development of project launch packages


Competitive Marketing Monitoring & Strategic Insights


Monitor and analyze key competitors’ marketing strategies, campaigns and experiential activations, delivering regular competitive intelligence reports and strategic insights in collaboration with central and local teams.
Provide relevant insights to support project brief development.
Develop and share quarterly reports on key competitors, highlighting relevant trends and strategic implications.
Consolidate and share key market and consumer insights to support brand and business decision-making.
Conduct detailed monthly monitoring of key competitors’ paid media activities to support the development of strategic marketing frameworks.


Profilo

Technical Skills


University degree in Marketing, Market Research, Business Analytics or related field
3–5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury industry
Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with proven ability to interpret complex data, identify meaningful patterns and translate findings into clear insights and recommendations
Solid understanding of marketing strategies, media channels and performance metrics
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint
Fluency in written and spoken Italian and English is required


Soft Skills


Strategic and Critical Thinking
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
Effective communication skills
High degree of flexibility and adaptability
Proactive approach and collaborative mindset
Accuracy and attention to detail


Informazioni aggiuntive per i candidati

For new joiners in this role in Italy, the initial annual gross salary is EUR 48.000

This salary has been determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria and corresponds to the compensation normally granted for this position at the time of publication of this job posting. Actual compensation may vary depending on factors such as your unique combination of experience and skills, seniority, and current organizational needs.

In addition to the benefits provided by law, further benefits may be granted in accordance with current company policies.

The employment relationship will be governed by the provisions of the applicable national collective bargaining agreement (CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi), as applied by Bulgari in Italy.

Title: Pricing & Costing Specialist
Description:
Il Partner




Per nota realtà leader nei servizi di ristorazione, Manpower Professional ricerca un/una Costing & Pricing Specialist.




Il Profilo




La risorsa inserita nella funzione AFC a diretto riporto del Costing & Pricing Manager supporterà le attività di analisi e determinazione dei costi relativi ai prodotti e ai servizi erogati. Nello specifico si occuperà di:




Raccogliere e analizzare dati relativi a materie prime, ingredienti, packaging, trasporti e manodopera coinvolti nella produzione dei pasti.
Collaborare alla costruzione e all'aggiornamento dei modelli di costing, monitorando l'impatto delle variazioni di costo sulla marginalità.
Contribuire alla definizione dei prezzi di vendita attraverso l'analisi delle componenti di costo e dei requisiti contrattuali dei clienti.
Supportare le valutazioni economiche legate a nuove commesse, rotte e opportunità commerciali.
Collaborare con il team Sales nella predisposizione delle analisi economiche a supporto delle offerte commerciali rivolte alle compagnie aeree.
Interfacciarsi quotidianamente con Procurement, Executive Chef, Operations e Finance per garantire l'accuratezza delle informazioni utilizzate nelle analisi.
Predisporre reportistica e dashboard a supporto del monitoraggio dei costi e della redditività.




Requisiti

Laurea in Economia, o discipline affini.

Esperienza di 1-3 anni in ruoli analitici quali Business Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Cost Controller, Financial Analyst, Supply Chain Analyst o similari;

Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Excel (funzioni avanzate, tabelle pivot, analisi dati).

Interesse per l'analisi dei costi, la marginalità e i processi operativi.

Capacità di comprendere e interpretare dati provenienti da funzioni aziendali differenti.

Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata.




Si ricerca una persona precisa, proattiva e orientata all’analisi, con spiccata attenzione ai dettagli e forte predisposizione all’apprendimento




Ottime capacità analitiche e attenzione ai dettagli.
Capacità di problem solving e approccio strutturato.
Predisposizione al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione con diverse funzioni aziendali.




Offerta

Contratto a tempo Indeterminato CCNL trasporto aereo / Livello F

RANGE RAL 30.000 – 35.000 Euro

Buoni pasto da 7 euro

Lavoro in presenza

Sede Fiumicino

Inserimento previsto per Novembre

Title: Fabric Analytics Engineer
Description:
Noi di AGIC, Solution Partner di Microsoft, siamo una realtà che punta sull'innovazione e sulla crescita delle persone. Crediamo che il successo nasca dalla collaborazione e dalla passione per la tecnologia. Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Fabric Analytics Engineer che voglia unirsi al nostro team Data Intelligence per progettare, realizzare e governare soluzioni analitiche enterprise su Microsoft Fabric, accompagnando i nostri clienti nel percorso verso una cultura data driven.




I nostri punti di forza sono 4: le persone, le competenze, Microsoft e la crescita.




Siamo una grande squadra, orientata allo sviluppo di nuovi talenti e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi comuni.




Se vuoi far parte di un ambiente dinamico e stimolante, questa è l'opportunità giusta per te!




La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni Microsoft Fabric su progetti di Data Integration, Data Migration, Data Management e Data Analytics.




La risorsa avrà modo di:

Progettare e realizzare soluzioni analitiche end-to-end su Microsoft Fabric, con architetture lakehouse e warehouse organizzate a livelli
Preparare, trasformare e arricchire i dati provenienti da sorgenti eterogenee, costruendo pipeline e dataflow affidabili e monitorabili
Progettare, implementare e ottimizzare report e modelli semantici, curandone performance, granularità, relazioni e misure DAX
Mettere in sicurezza e mantenere gli asset analitici: permessi, row-level e object-level security, etichette di riservatezza, ciclo di vita e deployment degli ambienti
Raccogliere i requisiti tecnici e funzionali dal cliente, stimare i tempi e redigere documentazione tecnica
Mantenere aggiornate le competenze sulle tecnologie Microsoft e sulle best practice di data management e analytics




I nostri candidati ideali:

Cerchiamo persone appassionate e motivate, in possesso di:

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Business Intelligence o Data Analytics in ambito Microsoft
Almeno 1 anno di esperienza con Microsoft Fabric e partecipazione attiva ad almeno un progetto realizzato con la piattaforma e rilasciato in produzione
Conoscenza approfondita di Power BI (Desktop e Service) e dei componenti Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory e notebook Spark
Conoscenza di SQL, DAX, e PySpark, unita a solide basi di modellazione dati
Esperienza nella gestione della sicurezza e della governance degli asset analitici
Attitudine al lavoro in team e orientamento al cliente
Laurea in discipline tecnico-scientifiche o esperienza equivalente
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata




Skill chiave:

Capacità di analisi e problem solving
Competenze nella progettazione di architetture dati e BI
Abilità di presentazione e storytelling dei dati
Elevata flessibilità tecnica nel navigare l'intero ecosistema Microsoft Fabric, dall'architettura OneLake alla data visualization in Power BI
Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro e convincente con interlocutori tecnici e business
Approccio consulenziale, con spiccata flessibilità e dinamicità




Requisiti graditi:

Certificazione Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) e/o DP-700
Conoscenza degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale applicati al dato: Copilot, Fabric Data Agent, preparazione di dati AI-ready
Conoscenza di Azure Data Services (Data Lake, Synapse, Data Factory) e di Databricks o Spark
Esperienza di lavoro in contesti DevOps e Agile, con pratiche di CI/CD applicate agli asset analitici




Cosa offriamo:

Un ambiente dinamico e informale
Numerosi eventi aziendali e occasioni di team building
Possibilità di smart working e flessibilità oraria
Attenzione alle persone e orientamento ai risultati
Percorsi di crescita professionale, formazione continua e supporto al percorso di certificazione Microsoft




Tipologia di inserimento: tempo indeterminato RAL: 30.000€ - 40.000€.




Sede di lavoro: Roma, Milano, Napoli, Francavilla. Ibrido.




La ricerca è rivolta a candidati ambosessi (L. 903/77).

Invia la tua candidatura!
